units.zh: 魏文帝黃初四年三月癸卯，月犯心大星。
units.en: On guimao in the third month of Huangchu 4 under Emperor Wen of Wei (Cao Pi), the moon transgressed Antares, the bright star of the Heart mansion.
units.literal: In the third month of the fourth Huangchu year of Emperor Wen of Wei, on the day guimao, the Moon transgressed the great star of the Heart [lodge].

units.zh: 占曰：「心為天王位，王者惡之。」
units.en: The prognostication reads: “The Heart asterism marks Heaven’s throne—sovereigns dread such a sign.”
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Heart is the seat of the Celestial King; the king finds it ill-omened.

units.en: In the sixth month, on jiashen, Venus appeared in broad daylight.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the day jiashen, the Great White [Venus] was seen in daytime.

units.zh: 案劉向《五紀論》曰：「太白少陰，弱，不得專行，故以己未為界，不得經天而行。
units.en: Examining Liu Xiang’s Treatise on the Five Regulators, it says, "Venus is Lesser Yin; being weak, it cannot travel independently. Therefore it takes jiwei as the boundary and may not cross the sky in its course.
units.literal: Investigating [this], Liu Xiang’s “Treatise on the Five Regulators” says: “The Great White is Lesser Yin; being weak, it cannot travel alone; therefore with jiwei as the boundary, it must not cross the sky [by day].

units.zh: 經天則晝見，其占為兵喪，為不臣，為更王；
units.en: If it crosses the sky, then it appears by day; its prognostication is war and mourning, disloyal ministers, and a changed king;
units.literal: When it crosses the sky, then it is seen by day; its interpretation is military losses, disloyal subjects, and change of king;

units.en: strong states become weak, and small states become strong."
units.literal: strong states weaken, small states strengthen.

units.zh: 是時孫權受魏爵號，而稱兵距守。
units.en: Sun Quan had accepted Wei’s patent of nobility yet still mobilized armies and stood on the defensive.
units.literal: At this time Sun Quan accepted titles from Wei, yet raised troops and held out on the defensive.

units.zh: 其十二月丙子，月犯心大星。
units.en: In the twelfth month, on bingzi, the moon again crossed Antares in the Heart.
units.literal: That twelfth month, on the day bingzi, the Moon transgressed the great star of the Heart.

units.en: The diviners cited the same gloss as above.
units.literal: The interpretation is the same as above.

units.zh: 五年十月乙卯，太白晝見。
units.en: In the tenth month of Huangchu 5, on yimao, Venus appeared in daylight.
units.literal: In the fifth year, tenth month, on the day yimao, the Great White was seen in daytime.

units.en: The prognostication matched the foregoing.
units.literal: The interpretation is the same as above.

units.zh: 又歲星入太微逆行，積百四十九日乃出。
units.en: Jupiter also entered the Supreme Palace and traced a retrograde arc, lingering one hundred forty-nine days before departing.
units.literal: Moreover the Year Star [Jupiter] entered the Supreme Palace enclosure and moved retrograde; it accumulated one hundred forty-nine days there before emerging.

units.zh: 占曰：「五星入太微，從右入三十日以上，人主有大憂。」
units.en: The gloss runs: “If the five planets enter the Supreme Palace from the right and remain upward of thirty days, the sovereign faces grave distress.”
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When the Five Planets enter the Supreme Palace, entering from the right and staying thirty days or more, the ruler has great sorrow.

units.en: A variant reading adds: “A general amnesty is coming.”
units.literal: Another saying: “An amnesty will arrive.

units.zh: 七年五月，帝崩，明帝即位，大赦天下。
units.en: In the fifth month of the seventh year the emperor died; Emperor Ming took the throne and issued an empire-wide amnesty.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the seventh year the emperor died; Emperor Ming succeeded and proclaimed a great amnesty for all under Heaven.

units.zh: 六年五月壬戌，熒惑入太微，至壬申，興歲星相及，俱犯右執法，至癸酉乃出。
units.en: On renxu in the fifth month of the sixth year Mars entered the Supreme Palace; by renshen it had closed with Jupiter, both crossing the Right Enforcer asterism, and they exited on guiyou.
units.literal: In the sixth year, fifth month, on the day renxu, Spark-Delight [Mars] entered the Supreme Palace; by renshen it came together with the Year Star [Jupiter], both transgressing the Right Enforcer; on guiyou they emerged.

units.zh: 占曰：「從右入三十日以上，人主有大憂。」
units.en: The interpretation states: “Remaining from the right beyond thirty days brings great sorrow to the sovereign.”
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Entering from the right and staying thirty days or more, the ruler has great sorrow.

units.zh: 又曰：「月、五星犯左右執法，大臣有憂。」
units.en: It also said, "When the moon or the five planets trespass against the Left or Right Enforcer, great ministers will have anxiety."
units.literal: It also says: “When the Moon or the Five Planets transgress the Left or Right Enforcer, great ministers have sorrow.

units.zh: 一曰：「執法者誅，金、火尤甚。」
units.en: A further gloss adds that “execution reaches the officials who ‘enforce the law,’ worst when Venus or Mars is involved.”
units.literal: Another saying: “The enforcers are executed; metal and fire [planets] make it especially severe.

units.zh: 十一月，皇子東武陽王鑒薨。
units.en: In the eleventh month the imperial son, Prince Jian of Dongwuyang, passed away.
units.literal: In the eleventh month the imperial son, Prince Jian of Dongwuyang, died.

units.zh: 七年正月，驃騎將軍曹洪免為庶人。
units.en: The following first month General of Agile Cavalry Cao Hong was stripped of rank and reduced to common status.
units.literal: In the first month of the seventh year Cao Hong, General of Agile Cavalry, was dismissed and made a commoner.

units.zh: 四月，征南大將軍夏侯尚薨。
units.en: In the fourth month Xiahou Shang, general who conquered the south, died.
units.literal: In the fourth month Xiahou Shang, General Who Conquers the South, died.

units.en: In the fifth month the emperor died.
units.literal: In the fifth month the emperor died.

units.zh: 《蜀記》稱明帝問黃權曰：「天下鼎立，何地為正？」
units.en: The Records of Shu says that Emperor Ming asked Huang Quan, "With the realm standing like a tripod, which land is legitimate?"
units.literal: The “Records of Shu” relates that Emperor Ming asked Huang Quan: “The realm stands tripod-wise—which region holds the true legitimacy?

units.en: Quan replied, "It should be verified by celestial patterns.
units.literal: He replied: “One must verify it against astronomy.

units.zh: 往者熒惑守心而文帝崩，吳、蜀無事，此其徵也。」
units.en: Formerly Mars guarded Heart and Emperor Wen collapsed, while Wu and Shu had no incident; this is the proof."
units.literal: Formerly Spark-Delight stationed at the Heart and Emperor Wen died, yet Wu and Shu were untroubled—this was its proof.

units.zh: 案三國史並無熒惑守心之文，疑是入太微。
units.en: Scrutiny shows none of the Three Kingdoms annals records Mars ‘stationing at the Heart’; the event was probably entry into the Supreme Palace.
units.literal: Investigating the histories of the three states, there is no text of Spark-Delight stationing at the Heart; it is suspected that [the planet] entered the Supreme Palace.

units.zh: 八月，吳遂圍江夏，寇襄陽，大將軍宣帝救襄陽，斬吳將張霸等，兵喪更王之應也。
units.en: In the eighth month Wu besieged Jiangxia and struck Xiangyang; General-in-Chief Xuandi (Sima Yi) rescued Xiangyang and slew Wu generals such as Zhang Ba, matching the omens of war, mourning, and shifting sovereignty.
units.literal: In the eighth month Wu then besieged Jiangxia, raided Xiangyang, and Grand Marshal Xuandi relieved Xiangyang, beheading Wu generals including Zhang Ba—the response of military losses and change of ruler.

units.zh: 明帝太和五年五月，熒惑犯房。
units.en: In Taihe 5 under Emperor Ming, the fifth month, Mars crossed the Room mansion.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the fifth Taihe year of Emperor Ming, Spark-Delight transgressed the Room [lodge].

units.zh: 占曰：「房四星，股肱臣將相位也，月、五星犯守之，將相有憂。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "The four stars of Room are the positions of the arm-and-leg ministers, generals, and chancellors; when the moon or the five planets trespass against or guard them, generals and chancellors will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The four stars of Room are the arms and legs—ministers and generals in council; when the Moon or the Five Planets invade or station there, generals and ministers will suffer.

units.zh: 其七月，車騎將軍張郃追諸葛亮，為亮所害。
units.en: In the seventh month General of Chariots and Cavalry Zhang He pursued Zhuge Liang and was killed by Liang.
units.literal: That seventh month General of Chariots and Cavalry Zhang He pursued Zhuge Liang and was killed by Liang’s troops.

units.en: In the twelfth month Grand Commandant Hua Xin died.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Grand Commandant Hua Xin died.

units.zh: 其十一月乙酉，月犯軒轅大星。
units.en: On yiyou in the eleventh month the moon crossed Regulus, the great star of the Chariot Shaft.
units.literal: That eleventh month, on yiyou, the Moon transgressed the great star of the Chariot Shaft [Regulus region].

units.en: The prognostication said, "The female ruler will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The principal consort will suffer.

units.zh: 六年三月乙亥，月又犯軒轅大星。
units.en: On yihai in the third month of the sixth year the moon repeated its transit across Regulus.
units.literal: In the third month of the sixth year, on yihai, the Moon again transgressed the great star of the Chariot Shaft.

units.zh: 十一月寅，太白晝見南斗，遂歷八十餘日，恆見。
units.en: On the yin day of the eleventh month Venus blazed by day within the Southern Dipper and remained visible more than eighty days running.
units.literal: In the eleventh month on the yin day, the Great White was seen in daytime in the Southern Dipper; it then lasted more than eighty days, constantly visible.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Wu will have war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Wu will have soldiers.

units.zh: 明年，孫權遣張彌等將兵萬人，錫授公孫文懿為燕王，文懿斬彌等，虜其眾。
units.en: The following year Sun Quan dispatched Zhang Mi and others with ten thousand men to seal Gongsun Yuan as King of Yan; Yuan slew the envoys and impressed their troops.
units.literal: The next year Sun Quan sent Zhang Mi and others with ten thousand troops to invest Gongsun Wenyi as King of Yan; Wenyi executed Mi and seized his soldiers.

units.zh: 青龍三年正月，太后郭氏崩。
units.en: In Qinglong 3’s first month Empress Dowager Guo passed away.
units.literal: In the first month of Qinglong 3, Empress Dowager Guo died.

units.zh: 青龍三年三月辛卯，月犯輿鬼。
units.en: On xinmao in the third month of Qinglong 3 the moon crossed the Ghosts mansion.
units.literal: In the third month of Qinglong 3, on xinmao, the Moon transgressed the Ghosts [lodge].

units.en: Astrologers assign executions and slaughter to the Ghosts asterism.
units.literal: The Ghosts govern beheading and killing.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Many people will be ill, and the state will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Many people fall ill; the state has sorrow.

units.en: It also said, "Great ministers will have anxiety."
units.literal: It also says: “Great ministers will suffer.

units.en: Pestilence swept that summer and winter.
units.literal: That year, summer and winter, great pestilence [raged].

units.en: In the fifth month of the fourth year Minister of Education Dong Zhao died.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year Minister of Education Dong Zhao died.

units.zh: 其五月丁亥，太白晝見，積三十餘日。
units.en: On dinghai that fifth month Venus stayed visible in daylight for over thirty days.
units.literal: That fifth month, on dinghai, the Great White was seen in daytime, lasting more than thirty days.

units.zh: 以晷度推之，非秦魏，則楚也。
units.en: Shadow-measurement placed the sign either with Qin-Wei or with the old Chu domain.
units.literal: By gnomon-shadow reckoning of its position, [the omen applied] not to Qin or Wei, then to Chu.

units.zh: 是時，諸葛亮據渭南，宣帝與相持；
units.en: Zhuge Liang was entrenched south of the Wei as Xuandi faced him in stalemate;
units.literal: At this time Zhuge Liang held the south bank of the Wei River while Xuandi confronted him;

units.zh: 孫權寇合肥，又遣陛議、孫韶等人淮沔，天子親東征。
units.en: Sun Quan struck at Hefei and dispatched Bi Yi, Sun Shao, and others along the Huai and Han; the emperor personally led the eastern expedition.
units.literal: Sun Quan raided Hefei and also sent Bi Yi, Sun Shao, and others into the Huai and Han rivers; the Son of Heaven campaigned east in person.

units.zh: 蜀本秦地，則為秦魏及楚兵悉起矣。
units.en: Because Shu occupied the heartland of ancient Qin, the portent manifested as simultaneous campaigning across the Qin, Wei, and Chu theaters.
units.literal: Shu was fundamentally the old Qin territory, so Qin, Wei, and Chu armies all rose together.

units.en: On jisi in the seventh month the moon crossed the Key-and-Bolt asterism.
units.literal: That seventh month, on jisi, the Moon transgressed Key-and-Bolt.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be fire disaster."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be fire disasters.

units.en: In the seventh month of the third year Chonghua Hall caught fire.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the third year Chonghua Hall burned.

units.zh: 三年六月丁未，填星犯井鉞。
units.en: On dingwei in the sixth month of the third year Saturn crossed the battle-axe stars attached to the Well.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the third year, on dingwei, the Station Star [Saturn] transgressed the Well’s Battle-Axe.

units.en: On wuxu Venus likewise crossed those stars.
units.literal: On wuxu the Great White again transgressed them.

units.zh: 占曰：「凡月、五星犯井鉞，悉為兵災。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "Whenever the moon or five planets trespass against the Well Axe, all of it means military disaster."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Whenever the Moon or the Five Planets transgress the Well’s Battle-Axe, there are wholly military calamities.

units.en: One reading said, "Axes of punishment will be used, and great ministers will be executed."
units.literal: Another saying: “Battle-axes are employed; great ministers are executed.

units.zh: 七月己丑，填星犯東井距星。
units.en: On jichou in the seventh month Saturn crossed the separator stars of the Eastern Well.
units.literal: On jichou in the seventh month the Station Star transgressed the separator stars of the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "When Saturn enters Well, great men will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When the Station Star enters the Well, great men suffer.

units.en: Passing near the separator stars is termed moving along the yin track.
units.literal: Moving close to the separator stars counts as traveling the ‘yin’ side.

units.en: Its prognostication said, "There will be great flood, and the five grains will not ripen."
units.literal: Its interpretation says: “Great floods; the five grains do not ripen.

units.zh: 景初元年夏，大水，傷五穀。
units.en: The summer of Jingchu 1 brought floods that ruined the harvest.
units.literal: In the summer of the first Jingchu year great floods damaged the five grains.

units.zh: 其年十月壬申，太白晝見，在尾，歷二百餘日，恆晝見。
units.en: On renshen in the tenth month Venus shone by day in the Tail for over two hundred successive daylight apparitions.
units.literal: That year, tenth month, on renshen, the Great White was seen in daytime in the Tail [lodge], lasting more than two hundred days, always visible in daytime.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Tail is Yan; there will be war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Tail is Yan; there will be soldiers.

units.en: On wuchen in the twelfth month the moon crossed Hook-and-Hasp by the Heart.
units.literal: On wuchen in the twelfth month the Moon transgressed Hook-and-Hasp.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The king will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The king will suffer.

units.zh: 四年閏正月己巳，填星犯井鉞。
units.en: On jisi in the intercalary first month of the fourth year Saturn again crossed the Well’s axe.
units.literal: In the intercalary first month of the fourth year, on jisi, the Station Star transgressed the Well’s Battle-Axe.

units.en: On guimao in the third month Saturn entered the Eastern Well.
units.literal: On guimao in the third month the Station Star transgressed the Eastern Well.

units.zh: 己巳，太白與月加景晝見。
units.en: On jisi Venus and the Moon shone with compounded brilliance and were visible in daylight.
units.literal: On jisi the Great White together with the Moon “added radiance” [jiajing] and was seen in daytime.

units.zh: 五月壬寅，太白犯畢左股第一星。
units.en: On renyin in the fifth month Venus crossed the first star on the Net’s left leg.
units.literal: On renyin in the fifth month the Great White transgressed the first star on the left thigh of the Net [Hyades].

units.zh: 占曰：「畢為邊兵，又主刑罰。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "Net means frontier troops, and it also governs punishments."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Net means border troops; it also governs punishments.

units.zh: 九月，涼州塞外胡阿畢師使侵犯諸國，西域校尉張就討之，斬首捕虜萬計。
units.en: That autumn tribes beyond Liangzhou sent the envoy Abi Shi to raid the oasis kingdoms; Western Regions commandant Zhang Jiu crushed them, taking tens of thousands of heads and captives.
units.literal: In the ninth month the Hu beyond the Liangzhou frontier, the envoy Abi Shi invaded the various states; Commandant of the Western Regions Zhang Jiu campaigned against them, beheading and capturing by the ten thousands.

units.zh: 其年七月甲寅，太白犯軒轅大星。
units.en: On jiayin in the seventh month Venus crossed Regulus.
units.literal: That seventh month, on jiayin, the Great White transgressed the great star of the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The female ruler will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The principal consort will suffer.

units.en: In Jingchu 1 Empress Mao passed away.
units.literal: In the first Jingchu year Empress Mao died.

units.zh: 景初元年二月乙酉，月犯房第二星。
units.en: On yiyou in the second month of Jingchu 1 the moon crossed the second star of Room.
units.literal: On yiyou in the second month of Jingchu 1 the Moon transgressed the second star of the Room [lodge].

units.en: The prognostication said, "The general will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Generals will suffer.

units.en: That seventh month Minister of Education Chen Jiao died.
units.literal: That seventh month Minister of Education Chen Jiao died.

units.en: In the fourth month of the second year Minister of Education Han Ji died.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the second year Minister of Education Han Ji died.

units.zh: 其七月辛卯，太白晝見，積二百八十餘日。
units.en: On xinmao in the seventh month Venus stayed up by daylight for more than two hundred eighty days.
units.literal: On xinmao in the seventh month the Great White was seen in daytime, lasting more than two hundred eighty days.

units.zh: 時公孫文懿自立為燕王，署置百官，發兵距守，宣帝討滅之。
units.en: Gongsun Yuan had enthroned himself in Yan, set up an entire court, and armed the borders until Xuandi’s expedition annihilated him.
units.literal: At that time Gongsun Wenyi had declared himself King of Yan, appointed a full bureaucracy, and mobilized for defense; Xuandi campaigned and destroyed him.

units.zh: 二年二月己丑，月犯心距星，又犯中央大星。
units.en: On jichou in the second month the moon crossed both the Heart’s separator stars and its central luminary.
units.literal: On jichou in the second month of the second year the Moon transgressed the separator stars of the Heart and also the great central star.

units.zh: 五月乙亥，月又犯心距星及中央大星。
units.en: On yihai in the fifth month the moon repeated those transits.
units.literal: On yihai in the fifth month the Moon again transgressed the separator stars and the great central star.

units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "The king hates it.
units.literal: Investigating the omen-text it says: “The king finds it ill-omened.

units.en: If it trespasses against the front star, the crown prince will have anxiety."
units.literal: Transgressing the front star means the heir apparent will suffer.

units.en: The emperor died in the third year’s first month.
units.literal: In the first month of the third year the emperor died.

units.en: The new sovereign was enthroned yet promptly cast aside.
units.literal: The heir apparent was enthroned but soon deposed.

units.en: On jiawu in the tenth month the moon crossed the Winnowing Basket.
units.literal: That tenth month, on jiawu, the Moon transgressed the Winnowing Basket.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The general will die."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Generals will die.

units.zh: 正始元年四月，車騎將軍黃權薨。
units.en: General of Chariots and Cavalry Huang Quan died in the fourth month of Zhengshi 1.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the first Zhengshi year General of Chariots and Cavalry Huang Quan died.

units.zh: 其閏十一月癸丑，月犯心中央大星。
units.en: On guichou in the intercalary eleventh month the moon crossed the Heart’s central star.
units.literal: On guichou in the intercalary eleventh month the Moon transgressed the great central star of the Heart.

units.zh: 少帝正始元年四月戊午，月犯昴東頭第一星。
units.en: On wuwu in the fourth month of Zhengshi 1 of the Young Emperor the moon clipped the easternmost star of the Hairy Head.
units.literal: On wuwu in the fourth month of Zhengshi 1 of the Young Emperor the Moon transgressed the first star at the eastern end of the Hairy Head [Pleiades region].

units.zh: 十月庚寅，月又犯昴北斗四星。
units.en: On gengyin in the tenth month the moon transited both the Hairy Head and four stars of the Northern Dipper.
units.literal: On gengyin in the tenth month the Moon again transgressed the Hairy Head and the four stars of the Northern Dipper.

units.en: The prognostication said, "When the moon trespasses against Mao, the Hu will be unsettled."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When the Moon transgresses the Hairy Head, the Hu are restless.

units.zh: 二年六月，鮮卑阿妙兒等寇西方，敦煌太守王延破之，斬二萬餘級。
units.en: In the second year’s sixth month Xianbei bands led by Amiao’er struck the western marches; Dunhuang prefect Wang Yan routed them, claiming over twenty thousand heads.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the second year Xianbei under Amiao’er and others raided the west; prefect Wang Yan of Dunhuang defeated them and beheaded more than twenty thousand.

units.zh: 三年，又斬鮮卑大師及千餘級。
units.en: The third year saw another victory that took the Xianbei commander’s head plus more than a thousand others.
units.literal: In the third year another campaign severed the Xianbei commander’s head and over a thousand others.

units.zh: 二年九月癸酉，月犯輿鬼西北星。
units.en: On guiyou in the second year’s ninth month the moon crossed the Ghosts’ northwest star.
units.literal: On guiyou in the ninth month of the second year the Moon transgressed the northwest star of the Ghosts.

units.zh: 三年二月丁未，又犯西南星。
units.en: On dingwei in the third year’s second month it struck the Ghosts’ southwest star.
units.literal: On dingwei in the third year’s second month it again transgressed the southwest star.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be a money ordinance."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be an ordinance on coinage.

units.en: A variant gloss adds: “High ministers face peril.”
units.literal: Another saying: “Great ministers will suffer.

units.en: Grand Commandant Man Chong died in the third month of the third year.
units.literal: In the third month of the third year Grand Commandant Man Chong died.

units.zh: 四年正月，帝加元服，賜群臣錢各有差。
units.en: The fourth year’s first month saw the emperor’s capping ceremony and graded cash gifts to his officials.
units.literal: In the first month of the fourth year the emperor assumed the capping [adult rite] and bestowed cash on the various ministers in graded amounts.

units.zh: 四年十月、十一月，月再犯井鉞。
units.en: During the fourth year’s tenth and eleventh months the moon crossed the Well’s axe twice.
units.literal: In the tenth and eleventh months of the fourth year the Moon twice transgressed the Well’s Battle-Axe.

units.zh: 是月，宣帝討諸葛恪，恪棄城走。
units.en: That month Xuandi attacked Zhuge Ke, who deserted his walls and ran.
units.literal: That same month Xuandi campaigned against Zhuge Ke, who abandoned the city and fled.

units.en: Cao Shuang led a Shu expedition in the fifth year’s second month.
units.literal: In the second month of the fifth year Cao Shuang campaigned against Shu.

units.zh: 五年十一月癸巳，填星犯亢距星。
units.en: On guisi in the fifth year’s eleventh month Saturn crossed the Neck’s separator stars.
units.literal: On guisi in the eleventh month of the fifth year the Station Star transgressed the separator stars of the Neck [lodge].

units.en: The prognostication said, "Among the feudal lords there will be one who loses his state."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Among the feudal lords there will be one who loses his state.

units.zh: 七年七月丁丑，月犯左角。
units.en: On dingchou in the seventh year’s seventh month the moon crossed the Horn’s left horn-star.
units.literal: On dingchou in the seventh month of the seventh year the Moon transgressed the left horn [of the Horn lodge].

units.zh: 占曰：「天下有兵，左將軍死。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be war under Heaven, and the Left General will die."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Under Heaven there will be soldiers; the general of the left will die.

units.zh: 七月乙亥，熒惑犯畢距星。
units.en: On yihai in the seventh month Mars crossed the Net’s separator star.
units.literal: On yihai in the seventh month Spark-Delight transgressed the separator star of the Net.

units.en: The prognostication reads:
units.literal: The omen-text says:

units.en: "There will be frontier troops."
units.literal: There will be troops on the frontier.

units.en: One reading said, "Punishments will be used."
units.literal: Another saying: “Punishments will be applied.

units.zh: 九年正月辛亥，月犯亢南星。
units.en: On xinhai in the ninth year’s first month the moon crossed the Neck’s southern star.
units.literal: On xinhai in the first month of the ninth year the Moon transgressed the southern star of the Neck.

units.en: The prognostication said, "War will arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Arms will arise.

units.en: One reading said, "The general will die."
units.literal: Another saying: “A general will die.

units.en: On guichou in the seventh month Saturn crossed Key-and-Bolt.
units.literal: On guichou in the seventh month the Station Star transgressed Key-and-Bolt.

units.zh: 占曰：「王者不宜出宮下殿。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "The king should not leave the palace or descend from the hall."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The king should not leave the palace or descend the hall.

units.zh: 嘉平元年，天子謁陵，宣帝奏誅曹爽等。
units.en: Jiaping 1 saw the emperor tend the tombs while Xuandi procured orders to purge Cao Shuang’s faction.
units.literal: In the first Jiaping year the Son of Heaven visited the imperial tombs; Xuandi memorialized to execute Cao Shuang and his party.

units.en: Forced to camp outside the capital, the emperor forfeited real power.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven lodged in the field encampment; thereby he lost authority.

units.zh: 嘉平元年六月壬戌，太白犯東井距星。
units.en: On renxu in Jiaping 1’s sixth month Venus crossed the Eastern Well’s separator stars.
units.literal: On renxu in the sixth month of Jiaping 1 the Great White transgressed the separator stars of the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The state loses its government, and great ministers make disorder."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The state loses good government; great ministers make rebellion.

units.en: On xinsi in the fourth month Venus entered the Ghosts.
units.literal: On xinsi in the fourth month the Great White transgressed the Ghosts.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Great ministers will be executed."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great ministers will be executed.

units.en: One reading said, "War will arise."
units.literal: Another saying: “Arms will arise.

units.zh: 二年三月己未，太白又犯井距星。
units.en: On jiwei in the second year’s third month Venus repeated its crossing of the Well’s separator stars.
units.literal: On jiwei in the third month of the second year the Great White again transgressed the Well’s separator stars.

units.zh: 三年七月，王淩與楚王彪有謀，皆伏誅，人主遂卑。
units.en: In the third year’s seventh month Wang Ling and Prince Biao of Chu were exposed and killed for plotting, humbling the throne.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the third year Wang Ling conspired with Prince Biao of Chu; both were executed; the ruler’s prestige thereafter sank.

units.zh: 吳孫權赤烏十三年夏五月，日北至，熒惑逆行，入南斗。
units.en: During Wu, in Sun Quan’s Chiwu 13, fifth summer month, at the summer solstice Mars retrograded into the Southern Dipper.
units.literal: In Wu, Sun Quan’s thirteenth Chiwu year, summer, fifth month, the sun reached its northern limit and Spark-Delight moved retrograde into the Southern Dipper.

units.zh: 秋七月，犯魁第三星而東。
units.en: That autumn, seventh month, it crossed the Dipper’s third “handle” star and continued east.
units.literal: In autumn, seventh month, it transgressed the third star of the Dipper’s bowl and proceeded eastward.

units.en: The Han-Jin Chunqiu says, "It moved retrograde."
units.literal: The “Han–Jin Spring and Autumn” states “retrograde motion.”

units.zh: 案占：「熒惑入南斗，三月吳王死。」
units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "When Mars enters Southern Dipper, within three months the king of Wu will die."
units.literal: Investigating the prognostication: “When Spark-Delight enters the Southern Dipper, within three months the king of Wu will die.

units.zh: 一曰：「熒惑逆行，其地有死君。」
units.en: One reading said, "When Mars moves retrograde, the land beneath it will have a dead ruler."
units.literal: Another saying: “When Spark-Delight moves retrograde, the region beneath it will lose its ruler.

units.zh: 太元二年，權薨，是其應也，故《國志》書于吳。
units.en: Sun Quan died in Taiyuan 2, matching the omen, which is why the Wu annals preserve the entry.
units.literal: In the second Taiyuan year Sun Quan died—exactly the fulfillment—so the “National Records” records it under Wu.

units.zh: 是時，王淩謀立楚王彪，謂「斗中有星，當有暴貴者」，以問知星人浩詳。
units.en: At this time Wang Ling, plotting to establish Prince Biao of Chu, said, "There is a star in the Dipper; there should be one who suddenly becomes noble," and asked the star-knower Hao Xiang about it.
units.literal: At that time Wang Ling plotted to enthrone Prince Biao of Chu, saying “There is a star in the Dipper—someone will suddenly rise to honor,” and questioned the star-clerk Hao Xiang about it.

units.zh: 詳疑有故，欲悅其意，不言吳有死喪，而言「淮南楚分，吳楚同占，當有王者興」，故淩計遂定。
units.en: Xiang suspected there was a reason, and wishing to please him, did not say that Wu would have death and mourning, but said, "Huainan is the allotment of Chu; Wu and Chu share the same prognostication, so there should be a king who rises." Thus Ling’s plan was settled.
units.literal: Haoxiang suspected ulterior motives and, wishing to please him, avoided speaking of Wu’s mourning omen and instead said “Huainan belongs to Chu’s quarter; Wu and Chu share the same divination—there a new king will arise,” so Wang Ling’s plan hardened.

units.zh: 嘉平二年十二月丙申，月犯輿鬼。
units.en: On bingshen in Jiaping 2’s twelfth month the moon crossed the Ghosts.
units.literal: On bingshen in the twelfth month of Jiaping 2 the Moon transgressed the Ghosts.

units.zh: 三年四月戊寅，月犯東井。
units.en: On wuyin in the third year’s fourth month the moon entered the Eastern Well.
units.literal: On wuyin in the fourth month of the third year the Moon transgressed the Eastern Well.

units.en: On jiayin in the fifth month the moon crossed the Neck’s separator stars.
units.literal: On jiayin in the fifth month the Moon transgressed the Neck’s separator stars.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The general will die."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “A general will die.

units.en: One reading said, "It means war."
units.literal: Another saying: “There will be soldiers.

units.en: That month Wang Ling, Prince Biao, and associates were put to death.
units.literal: That month Wang Ling, Prince Biao of Chu, and their accomplices were executed.

units.en: Empress Zhen died in the seventh month.
units.literal: In the seventh month Empress Zhen died.

units.zh: 四年三月，吳將為寇，鎮東將軍諸葛誕破走之。
units.en: Wu raiders struck in the fourth year’s third month until Zhuge Dan, general who guards the east, drove them off.
units.literal: In the third month of the fourth year Wu generals raided the borders; General Who Guards the East Zhuge Dan routed them.

units.zh: 其年七月己巳，月犯輿鬼。
units.en: On jisi that seventh month the moon crossed the Ghosts again.
units.literal: That seventh month, on jisi, the Moon transgressed the Ghosts.

units.en: On yisi in the ninth month it repeated the transit.
units.literal: On yisi in the ninth month it transgressed them again.

units.zh: 十月癸未，熒惑犯亢南星。
units.en: On guiwei in the tenth month Mars crossed the Neck’s southern star.
units.literal: On guiwei in the tenth month Spark-Delight transgressed the southern star of the Neck.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The ministers will have disorder."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Ministers will revolt.

units.zh: 四年十一月丁未，月又犯鬼積尸。
units.en: On dingwei in the fourth year’s eleventh month the moon crossed the Ghosts’ ‘piled corpses’ stars.
units.literal: On dingwei in the fourth year’s eleventh month the Moon again transgressed the heaped corpses in the Ghosts.

units.zh: 五年六月戊午，太白犯角。
units.en: On wuwu in the fifth year’s sixth month Venus crossed the Horn.
units.literal: On wuwu in the fifth year’s sixth month the Great White transgressed the Horn.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The assembled ministers have a plot, but it does not succeed."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Ministers will plot but not succeed.

units.en: On gengchen the moon crossed the Winnowing Basket.
units.literal: On gengchen the Moon transgressed the Winnowing Basket.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The general will die."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “A general will die.

units.en: That seventh month the moon crossed the Well’s axe.
units.literal: In the seventh month the Moon transgressed the Well’s Battle-Axe.

units.en: On bingwu the moon repeated its strike on the Ghosts’ northwest star.
units.literal: On bingwu the Moon again transgressed the northwest star of the Ghosts.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The state will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The state will have sorrow.

units.zh: 十一月癸酉，月犯東井距星。
units.en: On guiyou in the eleventh month the moon crossed the Eastern Well’s separator stars.
units.literal: On guiyou in the eleventh month the Moon transgressed the separator stars of the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The general will die."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “A general will die.

units.zh: 正元元年正月，鎮東將軍毋丘儉、揚州刺史文欽反，兵俱敗，誅死。
units.en: Zhengyuan 1 opened with Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin’s rebellion—both forces were destroyed and the generals slain.
units.literal: In the first month of the first Zhengyuan year General Who Guards the East Guanqiu Jian and Inspector of Yangzhou Wen Qin rebelled; both armies were crushed and the leaders executed.

units.zh: 二月，李豐及弟翼、後父張緝等謀亂，事泄，悉誅，皇后張氏廢。
units.en: The second month exposed Li Feng, Li Yi, Zhang Ji, and fellow conspirators, who were killed, and Empress Zhang was cast down.
units.literal: In the second month Li Feng, his younger brother Yi, the empress’s father Zhang Ji, and others plotted sedition; the affair leaked and all were executed; Empress Zhang was deposed.

units.en: The ninth month reduced the emperor to Prince of Qi.
units.literal: In the ninth month the emperor was deposed as Prince of Qi.

units.zh: 蜀將姜維攻隴西，車騎將軍郭淮討破之。
units.en: Jiang Wei’s Longxi offensive failed against Guo Huai, general of chariots and cavalry.
units.literal: Shu general Jiang Wei attacked Longxi; General of Chariots and Cavalry Guo Huai defeated him.

units.zh: 高貴鄉公正元二年二月戊午，熒惑犯東井北轅西頭第一星。
units.en: On wuwu in Zhengyuan 2’s second month Mars crossed the westernmost star on the Well’s northern pole.
units.literal: On wuwu in the second month of the second Zhengyuan year of the Duke of Gaoguixiang Spark-Delight transgressed the first western star at the northern yoke of the Eastern Well.

units.zh: 甘露元年七月乙卯，熒惑犯東井鉞星。
units.en: On yimao in the first year of Ganlu’s seventh month Mars crossed the Eastern Well’s axe star.
units.literal: On yimao in the seventh month of the first year of Ganlu Spark-Delight transgressed the battle-axe star of the Eastern Well.

units.en: On renxu the moon repeated the axe transit.
units.literal: On renxu the Moon again transgressed the axe star.

units.en: On xinhai in the eighth month the moon crossed the Winnowing Basket.
units.literal: On xinhai in the eighth month the Moon transgressed the Winnowing Basket.

units.zh: 吳廢孫亮太平元年九月壬辰，太白犯南斗，《吳志》所書也。
units.en: The Wu Treatise entry for Taiping 1, ninth month renchen under Sun Liang records Venus crossing the Southern Dipper.
units.literal: Wu’s deposed emperor Sun Liang, Taiping first year, ninth month, renchen day—what the “Wu Treatise” records—is the Great White transgressing the Southern Dipper.

units.zh: 占曰：「太白犯斗，國有兵，大臣有反者。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "When Venus trespasses against Dipper, the state will have war, and among the great ministers there will be one who rebels."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When the Great White transgresses the Dipper, the state has troops and great ministers rebel.

units.en: Zhuge Dan rose in rebellion the following year.
units.literal: The next year Zhuge Dan rebelled.

units.en: Sun Lin removed Sun Liang the year after.
units.literal: The year after that Sun Lin deposed Sun Liang.

units.en: Both Wu and Wei knew martial crises.
units.literal: Wu and Wei alike saw campaigns.

units.zh: 甘露元年九月丁巳，月犯東井。
units.en: On dingsi in the first year of Ganlu’s ninth month the moon entered the Eastern Well.
units.literal: On dingsi in the ninth month of the first year of Ganlu the Moon transgressed the Eastern Well.

units.zh: 二年六月己酉，月犯心中央大星。
units.en: On jiyou in the second year’s sixth month the moon crossed the Heart’s central star.
units.literal: On jiyou in the sixth month of the second year the Moon transgressed the great central star of the Heart.

units.en: On renzi in the eighth month Jupiter crossed the Well’s axe.
units.literal: On renzi in the eighth month the Year Star transgressed the Well’s Battle-Axe.

units.zh: 九月庚寅，歲星逆行，乘井鉞。
units.en: Jupiter then retrograded onto the battle-axe stars.
units.literal: On gengyin in the ninth month the Year Star moved retrograde and rode atop the battle-axe.

units.zh: 十月丙寅，太白犯亢距星。
units.en: On bingyin in the tenth month Venus crossed the Neck’s separator stars.
units.literal: On bingyin in the tenth month the Great White transgressed the Neck’s separator stars.

units.en: The prognostication said, "A rebellious minister will make disorder, and the ruler of men will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Rebellious ministers make turmoil; the ruler grieves.

units.zh: 景元元年五月，有成濟之變及諸葛誕誅，皆其應也。
units.en: Jingyuan 1’s fifth month brought the Cheng Ji incident and Zhuge Dan’s destruction, matching the signs.
units.literal: In the fifth month of Jingyuan 1 the Cheng Ji coup and Zhuge Dan’s execution fulfilled it.

units.zh: 二年三月庚子，太白犯東井。
units.en: On gengzi in the second year’s third month Venus entered the Eastern Well.
units.literal: On gengzi in the third month of the second year the Great White transgressed the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The state loses its government, and great ministers make disorder."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The state loses good government; great ministers make rebellion.

units.en: That same night Jupiter repeated its entry into the Eastern Well.
units.literal: That night the Year Star again transgressed the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "War will arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Arms will arise.

units.zh: 至景元元年，高貴鄉公敗。
units.en: By Jingyuan 1 the reign of the Duke of Gaoguixiang ended in ruin.
units.literal: By Jingyuan 1 the Duke of Gaoguixiang had been defeated.

units.zh: 三年八月壬辰，歲星犯輿鬼鑕星。
units.en: On renchen in the third year’s eighth month Jupiter crossed the Ghosts’ execution stars.
units.literal: On renchen in the eighth month of the third year the Year Star transgressed the sentencing stars of the Ghosts.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The axe and execution block will be used, and great ministers will be executed."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Axes of punishment are used; great ministers are executed.

units.zh: 四年四月甲申，歲星又犯輿鬼東南星。
units.en: On jiashen in the fourth year’s fourth month Jupiter struck the Ghosts’ southeast star.
units.literal: On jiashen in the fourth year’s fourth month the Year Star again transgressed the southeastern star of the Ghosts.

units.zh: 占曰：「鬼東南星主兵，木入鬼，大臣誅。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "The southeast star of Ghosts governs war; when Jupiter enters Ghosts, great ministers will be executed."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The southeastern star of the Ghosts governs soldiers; when wood enters the Ghosts, great ministers are executed.

units.en: Jingyuan 1 saw Minister Secretary Wang Jing executed.
units.literal: In Jingyuan 1 Minister Secretary Wang Jing was killed.

units.zh: 元帝景元元年二月，月犯建星。
units.en: Emperor Yuan’s Jingyuan 1, second month, the moon crossed the Establishment asterism.
units.literal: In the second month of Jingyuan 1 of Emperor Yuan the Moon transgressed the Establishment Stars.

units.zh: 案占：「月五星犯建星，大臣相譖。」
units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "When the moon or five planets trespass against the Establishment Stars, great ministers slander one another."
units.literal: Investigating the prognostication: “When the Moon or the Five Planets transgress the Establishment Stars, great ministers slander one another.

units.zh: 是後鍾會、鄧艾破蜀，會譖艾。
units.en: Zhong Hui and Deng Ai then destroyed Shu, after which Hui framed Deng Ai.
units.literal: Afterward Zhong Hui and Deng Ai conquered Shu, and Hui slandered Ai.

units.zh: 二年四月，熒惑入太微，犯右執法。
units.en: The second year’s fourth month brought Mars into the Supreme Palace across the Right Enforcer.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the second year Spark-Delight entered the Supreme Palace and transgressed the Right Enforcer.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The ruler of men will have great anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The ruler has great sorrow.

units.en: One version said, "Great ministers will have anxiety."
units.literal: One version: “Great ministers will suffer.

units.en: The fourth year’s tenth month saw Jupiter station in the Room.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the fourth year the Year Star stationed at the Room [lodge].

units.en: The prognostication said, "Generals and chancellors will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Generals and ministers will suffer.

units.en: One version said, "There will be a great amnesty."
units.literal: One version: “There will be a great amnesty.

units.zh: 明年，鄧艾、鍾會皆夷滅，赦蜀土。
units.en: The following year Deng Ai and Zhong Hui’s lineages were wiped out while conquered Shu received clemency.
units.literal: The next year Deng Ai and Zhong Hui were exterminated to the last generation and Shu territory was amnestied.

units.en: The fifth year witnessed the emperor’s abdication.
units.literal: In the fifth year the emperor abdicated.

units.zh: 武帝咸寧四年九月，太白當見不見。
units.en: Emperor Wu’s Xianning 4 ninth month should have shown Venus at dawn yet the planet stayed hidden.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the fourth Xianning year of Emperor Wu the Great White ought to have appeared but did not.

units.zh: 占曰：「是謂失舍，不有破軍，必有亡國。」
units.en: The gloss calls it ‘abandoning its station’: expect either a shattered army or a fallen dynasty.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “This is called ‘missing its lodging’; if not the destruction of an army, then surely the loss of a state.

units.zh: 是時羊祜表求伐吳，上許之。
units.en: Yang Hu tabled a plan to invade Wu and the throne gave its assent.
units.literal: At that time Yang Hu submitted a memorial requesting to attack Wu, and the sovereign approved.

units.zh: 五年十一月，兵出，太白始夕見西方。
units.en: In the eleventh month of the fifth year the armies advanced while Venus made its first evening appearance in the west.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the fifth year troops marched out, and the Great White first appeared in the west at dusk.

units.zh: 太康元年三月，大破吳軍，孫皓面縛請罪，吳國遂亡。
units.en: Taikang 1’s third month shattered Wu’s forces; Sun Hao came bound in surrender and Wu collapsed.
units.literal: In the third month of Taikang 1 Wu’s armies were utterly defeated; Sun Hao bound himself and pleaded guilt, and the state of Wu perished.

units.zh: 太康八年三月，熒惑守心。
units.en: Taikang 8’s third month saw Mars lodge upon Antares.
units.literal: In the third month of Taikang 8 Spark-Delight stationed at the Heart.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The king hates it."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The king finds it ill-omened.

units.zh: 太熙元年四月乙酉，帝崩。
units.en: The emperor died on yiyou in Taixi 1’s fourth month.
units.literal: On yiyou in the fourth month of Tixi 1 the emperor died.

units.zh: 惠帝元康三年四月，熒惑守太微六十日。
units.en: Emperor Hui’s Yuan-kang 3 fourth month held Mars sixty days inside the Supreme Palace.
units.literal: In the fourth month of Yuan-kang 3 of Emperor Hui Spark-Delight stationed in the Supreme Palace for sixty days.

units.zh: 占曰：「諸侯三公謀其上，必有斬臣。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "Feudal lords and the Three Dukes plot against their superior; there will certainly be ministers who are beheaded."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Marquises and the Three Dukes plot against their ruler; there must be executed ministers.

units.en: One reading said, "The Son of Heaven loses the state."
units.literal: Another saying: “The Son of Heaven loses his state.

units.zh: 是春太白守畢，至是百餘日。
units.en: The same spring Venus lodged in the Net for over a hundred days.
units.literal: That spring the Great White stationed at the Net, and by then it had remained more than a hundred days.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be anxiety from urgent ordinances."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be fear of sudden edicts.

units.en: One reading said, "The chancellor will die."
units.literal: Another saying: “The minister will die.

units.en: It further signals disturbed borders.
units.literal: It also means uneasy frontiers.

units.en: Empress Jia later destroyed the crown prince by false accusation.
units.literal: Afterward Empress Jia framed and murdered the heir apparent.

units.zh: 六年十月乙未，太白晝見。
units.en: On yiwei in the sixth year’s tenth month Venus appeared by daylight.
units.literal: On yiwei in the tenth month of the sixth year the Great White was seen in daytime.

units.en: The ninth year’s sixth month again placed Mars on the Heart.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the ninth year Spark-Delight stationed at the Heart.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The king hates it."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The king finds it ill-omened.

units.en: That August Mars entered the imperial guard stars.
units.literal: In the eighth month Spark-Delight entered the Forbidden Guards asterism.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The palace troops will greatly rise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Palace troops will rise in force.

units.zh: 其後，帝見廢為太上皇，俄而三王起兵討趙王倫，倫悉遣中軍兵相距累月。
units.en: The emperor was soon reduced to Retired Emperor; then the three princes rose against Sima Lun, who threw the central corps against them for months.
units.literal: Thereafter the emperor was deposed as Retired Emperor; presently the Three Princes raised troops against Prince Zhao Lun, who dispatched the central army to oppose them for months on end.

units.zh: 永康元年三月，中台星坼，太白晝見。
units.en: Yongkang 1’s third month saw the asterism of the high ministers fracture while Venus shone in daylight.
units.literal: In the third month of Yongkang 1 the central terrace stars split, and the Great White appeared by day.

units.en: The prognostication said, "When the Terrace Stars lose their norm, the Three Dukes will have anxiety.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When terrace stars lose their norm, the Three Dukes grieve.

units.en: When Venus appears by day, it means disloyal ministers."
units.literal: The Great White seen by daylight means disloyal subjects.

units.zh: 是月，賈后殺太子，趙王倫尋廢殺後，斬司空張華。
units.en: That month Empress Jia slew the heir; Sima Lun rapidly ousted and killed her and executed Zhang Hua.
units.literal: That month Empress Jia killed the heir apparent; Prince Zhao Lun soon deposed and murdered the empress and beheaded Minister of Works Zhang Hua.

units.en: The fifth month brought Mars into the Southern Dipper.
units.literal: That fifth month Spark-Delight entered the Southern Dipper.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The chancellor will die, and war will greatly arise.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The chief minister will die; troops rise on a grand scale.

units.en: Dipper is also Wu’s allotment."
units.literal: The Dipper also marks Wu’s celestial field.

units.zh: 是時，趙王倫為相，明年，篡位，三王興師誅之。
units.en: Sima Lun held the premiership, seized the throne the following year, then fell to princely coalitions.
units.literal: At that time Prince Zhao Lun was chancellor; the next year he usurped the throne, and princes raised armies and executed him.

units.en: Tai’an 2 saw Shi Bing overrun Yangzhou.
units.literal: In the second year of Tai’an Shi Bing captured Yangzhou.

units.en: That August Mars entered the Winnowing Basket.
units.literal: That eighth month Spark-Delight entered the Winnowing Basket.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The ruler of men loses his position, and war arises."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The ruler loses his throne; troops arise.

units.en: The following year Sima Lun seized the throne and altered the reign title.
units.literal: The next year Prince Zhao Lun usurped the throne and changed the era name.

units.zh: 二年二月，太白出西方，逆行入東井。
units.en: The second year’s second month brought Venus out in the west, retrograding into the Eastern Well.
units.literal: In the second month of the second year the Great White emerged in the west and moved retrograde into the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The state loses its government, and great ministers make disorder."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The state loses good government; great ministers make rebellion.

units.zh: 是時，齊王冏起兵討趙王倫，倫滅，冏擁兵不朝，專權淫奢，明年，誅死。
units.en: Prince Qi’s coalition destroyed Lun, yet Jiong quartered troops outside the capital, ruled tyrannically, and was killed the next year.
units.literal: At that time Prince Qi Jiong raised troops against Prince Zhao Lun; Lun was destroyed, but Jiong kept his army from court, monopolized power, and indulged in arrogance and luxury; the next year he was executed.

units.zh: 永甯元年，自正月至於閏月，五星互經天，縱橫無常。
units.en: From New Year through the leap month of Yongning 1 every planet transited the zenith by day, zigzagging without pattern.
units.literal: In Yongning 1, from the first month through the intercalary month, all five planets crossed the sky by day, moving irregularly in every direction.

units.en: The Star Canon said, "The sun is yang and is the ruler’s way;
units.literal: The “Star Canon” says: “The sun is yang—the way of the ruler;

units.en: stars are yin and are the minister’s way.
units.literal: stars are yin—the way of ministers.

units.zh: 日出則星亡，臣不得專也。
units.en: When the sun comes out, the stars disappear; ministers may not act independently.
units.literal: When the sun rises the stars vanish; ministers may not monopolize power.

units.zh: 晝而星見午上者為經天，其占為不臣，為更王。」
units.en: When stars are visible above noon in daytime, this is crossing the sky; its prognostication is disloyal ministers and a changed king."
units.literal: Stars seen at noon upon crossing the sky count as ‘crossing heaven’; their interpretation is disloyal subjects and change of king.

units.zh: 今五星悉經天，天變所未有也。
units.en: Never had all five planets simultaneously transited the daytime sky.
units.literal: Now all five planets crossed the sky—a celestial anomaly never recorded before.

units.zh: 石氏說曰：「辰星晝見，其國不亡則大亂。」
units.en: Shi’s explanation said, "When Mercury appears by day, that state, if it does not perish, will be in great disorder."
units.literal: Shi’s explanation says: “When the Dawn Star appears by day, if the state does not perish it suffers great chaos.

units.zh: 是後，台鼎方伯，互執大權，二帝流亡，遂至六夷更王，迭據華夏，亦載籍所未有也。
units.en: Later Three Dukes and provincial governors wrested authority; two sovereigns fled; six successive alien regimes partitioned China—again without precedent in the records.
units.literal: Afterward ministers and regional shepherds seized power in turn; two emperors went into exile; eventually six barbarian peoples enthroned rulers in succession and carved up the Central Plains—another spectacle absent from the annals.

units.en: The fourth month showed Jupiter in daylight.
units.literal: That fourth month the Year Star appeared by day.

units.en: May brought Venus out at noon.
units.literal: In the fifth month the Great White appeared by day.

units.en: The gloss matched earlier entries.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.en: July stationed Jupiter over Emptiness and Rooftop.
units.literal: In the seventh month the Year Star stationed at Emptiness and Rooftop.

units.en: The prognostication said, "When Jupiter guards Emptiness and Rooftop, there will be anxiety over war.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When wood stations at Emptiness and Rooftop there is military sorrow.

units.en: Emptiness and Rooftop are the allotment of Qi."
units.literal: Emptiness and Rooftop mark Qi’s field.

units.en: One reading said, "Guarding Emptiness means famine;
units.literal: Another saying: “Stationing at Emptiness means famine;

units.en: guarding Rooftop means corvee labor is troublesome and excessive, and those below are bent and exhausted."
units.literal: stationing at Rooftop means corvée labor grows vexing and the common people are exhausted.

units.zh: 辰星入太微，占曰「為內亂」，一曰「群臣相殺」。
units.en: When Mercury entered the Supreme Palace, the prognostication said, "It means internal disorder"; one reading said, "The assembled ministers kill one another."
units.literal: The Dawn Star entered the Supreme Palace; the interpretation reads ‘internal rebellion,’ another variant reads ‘ministers slaughter one another.’

units.zh: 太白守右掖門，占曰：「為兵，為亂，為賊。」
units.en: When Venus guarded the Right Gate of the Palace Wing, the prognostication said, "It means war, disorder, and banditry."
units.literal: The Great White guarded the right-side gate of the Forbidden Palace; the interpretation reads ‘soldiers, turmoil, banditry.’

units.zh: 八月戊午，填星犯左執法，又犯上相，占曰「上相憂」。
units.en: In the eighth month, wuwu, Saturn trespassed against the Left Enforcer and also against the Upper Minister; the prognostication said, "The Upper Minister will have anxiety."
units.literal: On wuwu in the eighth month the Station Star transgressed the Left Enforcer and again the Upper Minister; the interpretation reads ‘the upper minister grieves.’

units.zh: 熒惑守昴，占曰「趙魏有災」。
units.en: Mars guarded Mao; the prognostication said, "Zhao and Wei will have disaster."
units.literal: Spark-Delight stationed at the Hairy Head; the interpretation reads ‘calamity for Zhao and Wei.’

units.zh: 辰星守輿鬼，占曰「秦有災」。
units.en: Mercury guarded Carriage Ghosts; the prognostication said, "Qin will have disaster."
units.literal: The Dawn Star guarded the Ghosts; the interpretation reads ‘calamity for Qin.’

units.en: September dingwei brought a lunar transit of the Horn’s left spike.
units.literal: On dingwei in the ninth month the Moon transgressed the left horn.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The ruler of men will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The ruler will suffer.

units.zh: 一曰：「左衛將軍死，天下有兵。」
units.en: One reading said, "The Left Guard General will die, and there will be war under Heaven."
units.literal: Another saying: “The commander of the Left Guards dies; under Heaven there will be troops.

units.zh: 二年四月癸酉，歲星晝見。
units.en: Second year fourth month guiyou showed Jupiter by daylight.
units.literal: On guiyou in the fourth month of the second year the Year Star appeared by day.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means ministers are strong."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Ministers grow powerful.

units.zh: 初，齊王冏定京都，因留輔政，遂專慠無君。
units.en: After Prince Qi Jiong secured the capital, he remained to assist the government and then slid into heedless arrogance.
units.literal: Earlier Prince Qi had pacified the capital and stayed to assist government, then turned arrogant and lordly beyond his king.

units.zh: 是月，成都、河間檄長沙王乂討之，冏乂交戰，攻焚宮闕，冏兵敗，夷滅。
units.en: Chengdu and Hejian called on Prince Changsha to attack Qi; their forces fought through the palace, torched the halls, and annihilated Jiong.
units.literal: That month Chengdu and Hejian issued summons for Prince Changsha Yi to campaign against him; armies of Yi and Jiong clashed, palace gates burned, Jiong’s troops were ruined and exterminated.

units.zh: 又殺其兄上軍將軍寔以下二十餘人。
units.en: More than twenty were put to death with Jiong’s elder brother, General of the Upper Army Shi.
units.literal: They also executed General of the Upper Army Shi—Jiong’s elder brother—along with more than twenty others.

units.zh: 太安二年，成都攻長沙，於是公私饑困，百姓力屈。
units.en: Tai’an 2’s Chengdu–Changsha war emptied granaries and broke the commoners.
units.literal: In Tai’an 2 Chengdu attacked Changsha; public and private stores alike failed until the people had nothing left to give.

units.zh: 太安二年二月，太白入昴。
units.en: Tai’an 2’s second month saw Venus enter the Hairy Head.
units.literal: In the second month of Tai’an 2 the Great White entered the Hairy Head.

units.en: The prognostication said, "All under Heaven will be disturbed, and war will greatly arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Under Heaven is disturbed; troops rise on a grand scale.

units.en: July brought Mars into the Eastern Well.
units.literal: In the seventh month Spark-Delight entered the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "War will arise, and the state will be in disorder."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Arms arise; the state is in turmoil.

units.en: That autumn Venus stationed on the Upper First Minister star.
units.literal: That autumn the Great White guarded the Supreme Palace’s Upper First Minister.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The supreme general will perish through war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The upper first minister perishes by arms.

units.zh: 是年冬，成都、河間攻洛陽。
units.en: Winter saw Chengdu and Hejian strike the capital.
units.literal: That winter Chengdu and Hejian attacked Luoyang.

units.zh: 八月，長沙王奉帝出距二王。
units.en: Prince Changsha escorted the emperor out to face the allied armies.
units.literal: In the eighth month Prince Changsha led the emperor forth to resist the two princes.

units.zh: 三年正月，東海王越執長沙王乂，張方又殺之。
units.en: In the first month of the third year Prince Donghai Yue seized Prince Changsha Yi, and Zhang Fang killed him.
units.literal: In the first month of the third year Prince Donghai Yue seized Prince Changsha Yi, and Zhang Fang murdered him.

units.zh: 三年正月，熒惑入南斗，占同永康。
units.en: Third year’s first month Mars entered the Dipper with the same gloss recorded under Yongkang.
units.literal: In the third year’s first month Spark-Delight entered the Southern Dipper; the interpretation matches the Yongkang case.

units.zh: 七月，左衛將軍陳眕率眾奉帝伐成都，六軍敗績，兵逼乘輿。
units.en: In the seventh month Chen Zhen led troops escorting the emperor against Chengdu; the six armies were routed and soldiers pressed the imperial carriage.
units.literal: In the seventh month Commander of the Left Guards Chen Zhen led troops escorting the emperor to campaign against Chengdu; the six armies were routed and soldiers pressed the imperial carriage.

units.zh: 是時，天下盜賊群起，張昌尤盛。
units.en: Rebels erupted empire-wide, Zhang Chang foremost.
units.literal: At that time bandits sprang up everywhere; Zhang Chang was fiercest.

units.zh: 永興元年七月庚申，太白犯角、亢，經房、心，歷尾、箕。
units.en: Yongxing 1’s seventh month gengshen placed Venus across Horn through Tail.
units.literal: On gengshen in the seventh month of Yongxing 1 the Great White transgressed the Horn and Neck, passed through Room and Heart, and crossed Tail and Winnowing Basket.

units.en: September brought it into the Southern Dipper.
units.literal: In the ninth month it entered the Southern Dipper.

units.en: The prognostication said, "If it trespasses against Horn, there will be great battle under Heaven;
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Transgressing the Horn means great war under Heaven;

units.en: if it trespasses against Neck, there will be great war, and the ruler of men will have anxiety;
units.literal: transgressing the Neck means great armies and the ruler’s sorrow;

units.en: if it enters Room and Heart, it means war and mourning;
units.literal: entering Room and Heart means armies and mourning;

units.en: if it trespasses against Tail and Winnowing Basket, the female ruler will have anxiety."
units.literal: transgressing Tail and Winnowing Basket means the principal consort will suffer.

units.en: One reading said, "All under Heaven will be in great disorder.
units.literal: Another saying: “Under Heaven falls into great chaos.

units.en: If it enters Southern Dipper, there will be war and mourning."
units.literal: Entering the Southern Dipper means armies and mourning.

units.en: One reading said, "The general will make disorder.
units.literal: Another saying: “Generals will rebel.

units.zh: 其所犯守，又兗、豫、幽、冀、揚州之分野。」
units.en: The places it trespasses against or guards are also the allotments of Yan, Yu, You, Ji, and Yang provinces."
units.literal: The lodges it invaded and guarded correspond to Yan, Yu, You, Ji, and Yang provinces’ fields.

units.en: July brought the Dangyin slaughter.
units.literal: That seventh month saw the battle at Dangyin.

units.zh: 九月，王浚殺幽州刺史和演，攻鄴，鄴潰，於是兗豫為天下兵衝。
units.en: September Wang Jun slew He Yan, stormed Ye, and turned Yan-Yu into battle highways.
units.literal: In the ninth month Wang Jun killed Inspector of Youzhou He Yan, attacked Ye, Ye fell, and Yanzhou and Yuzhou became the empire’s military choke points.

units.en: Chen Min next seized the southeast.
units.literal: Chen Min then rebelled across the Yangzhou lands.

units.zh: 劉元海、石勒、李雄等並起微賤，跨有州郡。
units.en: Liu Yuan, Shi Le, Li Xiong, and peers climbed from obscurity to hold regional sway.
units.literal: Liu Yuan, Shi Le, Li Xiong, and others alike rose from humble stations and straddled whole provinces.

units.en: Empress Yang suffered repeated deposition and house arrest.
units.literal: Empress Yang was repeatedly imprisoned and deposed.

units.en: Each event answered the omens.
units.literal: All were its fulfillment.

units.zh: 二年四月丙子，太白犯狼星。
units.en: Second year fourth month bingzi saw Venus cross the Wolf.
units.literal: On bingzi in the fourth month of the second year the Great White transgressed the Wolf Star.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Great war will arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great armies arise.

units.en: September stationed Jupiter on the Eastern Well.
units.literal: In the ninth month the Year Star guarded the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be war, and Well is also Qin’s allotment."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be troops; the Well moreover marks Qin’s field.

units.zh: 是年，苟晞破公師籓，張方破范陽王猇，關西諸將攻河間王顒，顒奔走，東海王迎殺之。
units.en: That year Gou Xi defeated Gongshi Fan, Zhang Fang crushed Prince Fanyang Xiao, western generals attacked Prince Hejian Yong—Yong fled, and Prince Donghai received and executed him.
units.literal: That year Gou Xi defeated Gongshi Fan, Zhang Fang crushed Prince Fanyang Xiao, western passes besieged Prince Hejian Yong—Yong fled, and Prince Donghai welcomed and executed him.

units.zh: 光熙元年四月，太白失行，自翼入尾、箕。
units.en: Guangxi 1’s fourth month showed Venus erratic, sliding from Wings into Tail and Winnowing Basket.
units.literal: In the fourth month of Guangxi 1 the Great White lost proper motion, moving from Wings into Tail and Winnowing Basket.

units.zh: 占曰：「太白失行而北，是謂反生。
units.en: The prognostication said, "When Venus loses its course and goes north, this is called reverse generation.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When the Great White loses proper motion and heads north, this is called ‘reversed birth.’

units.en: If there is not an army destroyed, there will certainly be a city slaughtered."
units.literal: If not the destruction of an army, then surely the slaughter of a city.

units.zh: 五月，汲桑攻鄴，魏郡太守馮嵩出戰，大敗，桑遂害東燕王騰，殺萬餘人，焚燒魏時宮室皆盡。
units.en: In the fifth month Ji Sang attacked Ye; Administrator Feng Song of Wei Commandery gave battle and was utterly defeated; Sang then slew Prince Teng of Eastern Yan, killed more than ten thousand, and burned the Wei-era palaces to ash.
units.literal: In the fifth month Ji Sang attacked Ye; Administrator Feng Song of Wei Commandery gave battle and was utterly defeated; Sang then slew Prince Teng of Eastern Yan, killed more than ten thousand persons, and burned every Wei-era palace structure to ash.

units.en: On dingwei in the ninth month Mars lodged on Antares.
units.literal: That ninth month on dingwei Spark-Delight stationed at the Heart.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The king hates it."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The king finds it ill-omened.

units.en: On jihai Saturn stationed across Room and Heart.
units.literal: On jihai the Station Star guarded Room and Heart.

units.en: The prognostication said, "When Saturn guards Room, there will be many calamities and mournings;
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When the Station guards Room, many calamities and funeral rites;

units.en: when it guards Heart, the state will have internal disorder, and all under Heaven will receive amnesty."
units.literal: when it guards Heart, there is turmoil inside the state and an empire-wide amnesty.

units.zh: 是時，司馬越專權，終以無禮破滅，內亂之應也。
units.en: Sima Yue’s tyranny ended in destruction, matching the inner turmoil reading.
units.literal: At that time Sima Yue monopolized authority and finally perished through insolence—the response of internal rebellion.

units.zh: 十一月，帝崩，懷帝即位，大赦天下。
units.en: November brought the emperor’s death; Emperor Huai mounted the throne with a universal amnesty.
units.literal: In the eleventh month the emperor died; Emperor Huai succeeded and proclaimed a great amnesty.

units.zh: 懷帝永嘉元年十二月丁亥，星流震散。
units.en: Yongjia 1’s twelfth month dinghai saw meteors streak as if lightning shattered.
units.literal: On dinghai in the twelfth month of Yongjia 1 stars streamed like thunder peals scattering.

units.zh: 按劉向說，天官列宿，在位之象；
units.en: Liu Xiang teaches that stellar officers mirror titled ministers;
units.literal: According to Liu Xiang’s explanation, celestial officers and arrayed lodges image those holding court;

units.zh: 其眾小星無名者，眾庶之類。
units.en: countless faint stars stand for commoners.
units.literal: their multitude of small unnamed stars represent the common folk.

units.zh: 此百官眾庶將流散之象也。
units.en: Thus the sky foretells bureaucrats and masses fleeing.
units.literal: This is the image of officials and commoners about to scatter.

units.zh: 是後天下大亂，百官萬姓，流移轉死矣。
units.en: Empire-wide collapse followed—nobles and peasants alike were uprooted and slain.
units.literal: Afterward under Heaven fell into great chaos; officials and myriad households drifted, shifted, and died.

units.zh: 二年正月庚午，太白伏不見，二月庚子，始晨見東方，是謂當見不見，占同上條。
units.en: January gengwu Venus vanished until February gengzi dawn brought its eastern return—the ‘failed apparition’ omen cited earlier.
units.literal: On gengwu in the first month the Great White hid and did not appear; on gengzi in the second month it first appeared at dawn in the east—this is called ‘ought to appear yet absent’; the interpretation matches the preceding article.

units.zh: 其後破軍殺將，不可勝數，帝崩虜庭，中夏淪覆。
units.en: Armies fell endlessly; the sovereign perished among barbarians and north China sank.
units.literal: Afterward armies were shattered and generals killed beyond reckoning; the emperor died in captivity and the Central Plains collapsed.

units.zh: 三年正月庚子，熒惑犯紫微。
units.en: Third year New Year’s gengzi placed Mars across the Purple Palace.
units.literal: On gengzi in the first month of the third year Spark-Delight transgressed Purple Forbidden.

units.zh: 占曰：「當有野死之王，又為火燒宮。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "There should be a king who dies in the wild, and it also means fire burning the palace."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be a king dead in the wilds, and moreover palace fires.

units.zh: 是時太史令高堂沖奏，乘輿宜遷幸，不然必無洛陽。
units.en: Court astronomer Gao Tang Chong urged removing the court or losing Luoyang forever.
units.literal: At that time Astrologer Royal Gao Tang Chong memorialized that the imperial carriage ought to move lest Luoyang be lost entirely.

units.zh: 五年六月，劉曜、王彌入京都，焚燒宮廊，執帝歸平陽。
units.en: Yongjia 5’s sixth month saw Liu Yao and Wang Mi sack Luoyang, torch the halls, and drag the emperor to Pingyang.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the fifth year Liu Yao and Wang Mi entered the capital district, burned palace corridors, seized the emperor, and returned him to Pingyang.

units.en: Year three kept Saturn moored in the Dipper.
units.literal: In the third year the Station Star long guarded the Southern Dipper.

units.zh: 占曰：「填星所居久者，其國有福。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "The state corresponding to the place where Saturn dwells for a long time will have blessing."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Wherever the Station Star lingers long, that region gains blessing.

units.zh: 是時，安東將軍、琅邪王始有揚土。
units.en: At that time the General Who Maintains the East, the Prince of Langye, first held Yangzhou territory.
units.literal: At that time General Who Maintains the East, Prince of Langye, first held Yangzhou soil.

units.zh: 其年十一月，地動，陳卓以為是地動應也。
units.en: November’s tremor—Chen Zhuo read it as heaven’s aftershock.
units.literal: That eleventh month there was an earthquake; Chen Zhuo deemed it the seismic echo of that sign.

units.en: October of the fifth year lodged Mars on Antares.
units.literal: In the fifth year’s tenth month Spark-Delight stationed at the Heart.

units.zh: 六年六月丁卯，太白犯太微。
units.en: Sixth year sixth month dingmao brought Venus through the Supreme Palace.
units.literal: On dingmao in the sixth month of the sixth year the Great White transgressed the Supreme Palace.

units.zh: 占曰：「兵入天子庭，王者惡之。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "Troops enter the Son of Heaven’s court, and the king hates it."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Soldiers enter the Son of Heaven’s courtyard; the king finds it ill-omened.

units.zh: 七月，帝崩於寇庭，天下行服大臨。
units.en: July brought the emperor’s death in captivity and empire-wide mourning.
units.literal: In the seventh month the emperor died among bandits; the realm donned mourning and held grand lamentation.

units.zh: 元帝太興元年七月，太白犯南斗。
units.en: Emperor Yuan’s Taixing 1 seventh month saw Venus cross the Dipper.
units.literal: In the seventh month of Taixing 1 of Emperor Yuan the Great White transgressed the Southern Dipper.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Wu-Yue will have war, and great men will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Wu and Yue will have troops; great men will suffer.

units.zh: 二年二月甲申，熒惑犯東井。
units.en: Second year second month jiashen placed Mars in the Eastern Well.
units.literal: On jiashen in the second month of the second year Spark-Delight transgressed the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "War will arise, and noble ministers will slaughter one another."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Arms arise; noble ministers slaughter one another.

units.zh: 八月己卯，太白犯軒轅大星。
units.en: Eighth month jimao saw Venus cross Regulus.
units.literal: On jimao in the eighth month the Great White transgressed the great star of the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The rear palace will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The rear palace will suffer.

units.zh: 三年五月己戊子，太白入太微，又犯上將星。
units.en: Third year fifth month wuzi sent Venus into the Supreme Palace across the Upper First Minister.
units.literal: On wuzi in the fifth month of the third year the Great White entered the Supreme Palace and again transgressed the Upper First Minister star.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The Son of Heaven personally commands, and the supreme general is executed."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Son of Heaven commands in person; the upper minister is executed.

units.en: September repeated Venus’ Dipper crossing.
units.literal: In the ninth month the Great White transgressed the Southern Dipper.

units.zh: 十月己亥，熒惑在東井，居五諸侯南，踟躕留積三十日。
units.en: October jihai found Mars in the Well south of the Five Feudatories, tarrying a full month.
units.literal: In the tenth month on jihai Spark-Delight stood in the Eastern Well south of the Five Feudatories, hesitating and lingering thirty days.

units.zh: 占曰：「熒惑守井二十日以上，大人憂。
units.en: The prognostication said, "If Mars guards Well for more than twenty days, great men will have anxiety.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When Spark-Delight guards the Well twenty days or more, great men suffer.

units.en: If it guards the Five Feudatories, among the feudal lords there will be those who are executed."
units.literal: Guarding the Five Feudatories means feudatories will suffer executions.

units.zh: 永昌元年三月，王敦率江荊之眾來攻京都，六軍距戰，敗績，人主謝過而已。
units.en: Yongchang 1’s third month Wang Dun struck the capital with the hosts of Jiang and Jing; imperial troops collapsed leaving only contrition.
units.literal: In the third month of Yongchang 1 Wang Dun led the hosts of Jiang and Jing against the capital; the six armies resisted but were routed, and the sovereign could only apologize.

units.zh: 於是殺護軍將軍周顗、尚書令刁協、驃騎將軍戴若思。
units.en: Zhou Yi, Diao Xie, and Dai Ruosi died in the purge.
units.literal: They then killed Protector-General Zhou Yi, Minister Secretary Diao Xie, and General of Agile Cavalry Dai Ruosi.

units.en: Liu Wei escaped north.
units.literal: Moreover General Who Guards the North Liu Wei fled.

units.zh: 四月，又殺湘州刺史譙王司馬承、鎮南將軍甘卓。
units.en: In the fourth month they also killed Inspector of Xiangzhou Prince Sima Cheng of Qiao and General Who Guards the South Gan Zhuo.
units.literal: In the fourth month they also killed Inspector of Xiangzhou Prince Sima Cheng of Qiao and General Who Guards the South Gan Zhuo.

units.en: The intercalary December ended with the emperor’s death.
units.literal: In the intercalary twelfth month the emperor died.

units.zh: 明帝太寧三年正月，熒惑逆行，入太微。
units.en: Emperor Ming’s Taining 3 first month retrograded Mars through the Supreme Palace.
units.literal: In the first month of Taining 3 of Emperor Ming Spark-Delight moved retrograde into the Supreme Palace.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means war and mourning, and the king hates it."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be armies and mourning; the king finds it ill-omened.

units.en: The intercalary eighth month killed the emperor.
units.literal: In the intercalary eighth month the emperor died.

units.zh: 後二年，蘇峻反，攻焚宮室，太后以憂逼崩，天子幽劫于石頭城，遠近兵亂，至四年乃息。
units.en: Two years on Su Jun torched the palace, the empress dowager died of shock, the emperor languished at Stone City, and turmoil raged until year four.
units.literal: Two years later Su Jun rebelled, attacked and burned the palace halls; the empress dowager died of grief and alarm; the Son of Heaven was held hostage at Stone Fortress City; arms convulsed far and near until quiet returned only in the fourth year.

units.zh: 成帝咸和六年正月丙辰，月入南斗。
units.en: In Emperor Cheng’s Xianhe 6, on bingchen of the first month, the moon entered the Southern Dipper.
units.literal: On bingchen in the first month of Xianhe 6 the Moon entered the Southern Dipper.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be troops.

units.zh: 是月，石勒殺略婁、武進二縣人。
units.en: That month Shi Le ravaged Lou and Wujin.
units.literal: That month Shi Le slaughtered and plundered the people of Lou and Wujin counties.

units.zh: 明年，石勒眾又抄略南沙、海虞。
units.en: The following year his riders looted Nansha and Haiyu.
units.literal: The next year Shi Le’s hosts again raided Nansha and Haiyu.

units.en: In that eleventh month Mars guarded Stomach and the Hairy Head.
units.literal: That eleventh month Spark-Delight guarded Stomach and the Hairy Head.

units.en: The gloss assigns warfare to Zhao and Wei.
units.literal: The omen-text says: Zhao and Wei will have troops.

units.zh: 八年七月，石勒死，石季龍自立。
units.en: In the seventh month of the eighth year Shi Le died; Shi Hu seized power.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the eighth year Shi Le died and Shi Jilong seized power.

units.zh: 是時，雖二石僭號，而其強弱常占於昴，不關太微、紫宮也。
units.en: Even as both Shis claimed thrones, fate was divined from Mao, not from the palace enclosures.
units.literal: At that time although both Shi clans assumed royal titles, their rise and fall were always read from the Hairy Head, not from the Supreme Palace or Purple Forbidden.

units.zh: 八年三月己巳，月入南斗。
units.en: Eighth year third month jisi repeated the lunar Dipper entry.
units.literal: On jisi in the third month of the eighth year the Moon entered the Southern Dipper.

units.en: The gloss matched Xianhe 6.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the sixth year’s reading.

units.zh: 其年七月，石勒死，彭彪以譙，石生以長安，郭權以秦州並歸順。
units.en: July saw Shi Le’s death while Peng Biao, Shi Sheng, and Guo Quan offered allegiance from Qiao, Chang’an, and Qinzhou.
units.literal: That seventh month Shi Le died; Peng Biao held Qiao; Shi Sheng held Chang’an; Guo Quan held Qinzhou—all submitted.

units.zh: 於是遣督護喬球率眾救彪，彪敗，球退。
units.en: Superintendent Qiao Qiu marched to aid Peng Biao but retreated after defeat.
units.literal: The court then sent Superintendent Qiao Qiu with troops to rescue Biao; Biao was defeated and Qiu withdrew.

units.zh: 又，石季龍、石斌攻滅生、權。
units.en: Shi Hu and Shi Bin next crushed Sheng and Quan.
units.literal: Moreover Shi Jilong and Shi Bin attacked and destroyed Sheng and Quan.

units.en: July brought Mars into the Hairy Head.
units.literal: That seventh month Spark-Delight entered the Hairy Head.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The Hu king will die."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Hu king will die.

units.en: One reading said, "Zhao territory will have war."
units.literal: Another saying: “There will be troops in Zhao territory.

units.zh: 是月，石勒死，石季龍多所攻沒。
units.en: That month Shi Le passed and Shi Hu seized cities far and wide.
units.literal: That month Shi Le died and Shi Jilong seized many districts.

units.en: August repeated the lunar transit of the Hairy Head.
units.literal: In the eighth month the Moon again transgressed the Hairy Head.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The Hu will be unsettled."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Hu will be restless.

units.zh: 九年三月己亥，熒惑入輿鬼，犯積尸。
units.en: Ninth year third month jihai brought Mars through the Ghosts’ corpse heap.
units.literal: On jihai in the third month of the ninth year Spark-Delight entered the Ghosts and transgressed the heaped corpses.

units.zh: 占曰：「兵在西北，有沒軍死將。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "War is in the northwest; there will be a lost army and a dead general."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Soldiers lie northwest; armies perish and generals die.

units.en: June and August repeated lunar strikes on the Hairy Head.
units.literal: In the sixth and eighth months the Moon again transgressed the Hairy Head.

units.zh: 是時，石弘雖襲勒位，而石季龍擅威橫暴，十一月廢弘自立，遂幽殺之。
units.en: Shi Hong nominally succeeded but Shi Hu tyrannized; November saw Hu usurp the throne and kill Hong.
