units.literal: At that time although Shi Hong inherited Shi Le’s throne, Shi Jilong wielded brutal might; in the eleventh month he deposed Hong and enthroned himself, then imprisoned and murdered him.

units.zh: 咸康元年二月己亥，太白犯昴。
units.en: Xiankang 1 second month jihai crossed Venus over the Hairy Head.
units.literal: On jihai in the second month of Xiankang 1 the Great White transgressed the Hairy Head.

units.en: The prognostication said, "War will arise, and in the middle of the year there will be drought."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Arms arise; drought strikes mid-year.

units.zh: 四月，石季龍略騎至歷陽，加司徒王道大司馬，治兵列戍衝要。
units.en: April brought Shi Hu’s thrust to Liyang, Wang Dao’s marshal baton, and garrisons on all passes.
units.literal: In the fourth month Shi Jilong’s raiders reached Liyang; Steward Wang Dao was promoted Grand Marshal and troops deployed along every choke point.

units.en: Shi Hu meanwhile tightened his siege of Xiangyang.
units.literal: At that time Shi Jilong again besieged Xiangyang.

units.en: June baked under drought.
units.literal: In the sixth month there was drought.

units.en: Third month bingxu placed the moon on the Hairy Head.
units.literal: That third month on bingxu the Moon entered the Hairy Head.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The Hu king will die."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Hu king will die.

units.en: Eighth month wuxu sent Mars into the Eastern Well.
units.literal: On wuxu in the eighth month Spark-Delight entered the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "When there is no war, war arises;
units.literal: The omen-text says: “If there were no troops, troops arise;

units.en: when there is war, war stops."
units.literal: if there were troops, troops cease.

units.en: November repeated a lunar Hairy Head crossing.
units.literal: In the eleventh month the Moon transgressed the Hairy Head.

units.zh: 二年正月辛亥，月犯房南第二星。
units.en: Second year first month xinhai crossed the moon over Room’s second star.
units.literal: On xinhai in the first month of the second year the Moon transgressed the second southern star of Room.

units.en: August repeated the lunar Hairy Head transit.
units.literal: In the eighth month the Moon again transgressed the Hairy Head.

units.zh: 九月庚寅，太白犯南斗，因晝見。
units.en: September gengyin made Venus cross the Dipper and blaze in daylight.
units.literal: On gengyin in the ninth month the Great White transgressed the Southern Dipper and thereby appeared by day.

units.zh: 占曰：「斗為宰相，又揚州分，金犯之，死喪之象。
units.en: The prognostication said, "Dipper is the chancellor and also the allotment of Yangzhou; when Metal trespasses against it, it is the image of death and mourning.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Dipper is the ministerial seat; it also marks Yangzhou’s field; when metal transgresses it, the image is death and mourning.

units.en: Appearing by day means disloyal ministers, and also war and mourning."
units.literal: Appearance by daylight means disloyal subjects and likewise armies and mourning.

units.zh: 其後，石季龍僭稱天王，發眾七萬；
units.en: Shi Hu then styled himself Heavenly King and levied seventy thousand troops.
units.literal: Afterward Shi Jilong arrogated the title Heavenly King and mobilized seventy thousand men.

units.zh: 四年二月自隴西攻殺段遼於薊，又襲慕容皝於棘城，不克，皝擊破其將麻秋，並虜段遼殺之。
units.en: In the second month of the fourth year he marched from Longxi, attacked Duan Liao at Ji, then struck Murong Huang at Jicheng without success; Huang routed his general Ma Qiu and captured Duan Liao, executing him.
units.literal: In the fourth year’s second month he marched from Longxi, attacked and killed Duan Liao at Ji, then struck Murong Huang at Jicheng without success; Huang routed his general Ma Qiu and captured Duan Liao, executing him.

units.zh: 三年七月己酉，月犯房上星。
units.en: Third year seventh month jiyou crossed the moon over Room’s upper star.
units.literal: On jiyou in the seventh month of the third year the Moon transgressed the upper star of Room.

units.zh: 八月，熒惑入輿鬼，犯積尸。
units.en: August brought Mars through the Ghosts’ corpse stars.
units.literal: In the eighth month Spark-Delight entered the Ghosts and transgressed the heaped corpses.

units.en: Jiaxu saw a lunar Eastern Well transit.
units.literal: On jiaxu the Moon transgressed the separator stars of the Eastern Well.

units.en: September wuzi crossed the Establishment asterism.
units.literal: On wuzi in the ninth month the Moon transgressed the Establishment Stars.

units.zh: 四年四月己巳，太白晝見，在柳。
units.en: Fourth year fourth month jisi showed Venus by daylight in the Willow.
units.literal: On jisi in the fourth month of the fourth year the Great White was seen by day in the Willow.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means war and disloyal ministers."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be troops and disloyal subjects.

units.zh: 明年，石季龍大寇沔南，於是內外戒嚴。
units.en: Next year Shi Hu stormed south of the Han, triggering universal mobilization.
units.literal: The next year Shi Jilong raided the Han River south in force; court and camp alike went on full alert.

units.zh: 其五月戊戌，熒惑犯右執法。
units.en: Fifth month wuxu placed Mars on the Right Enforcer.
units.literal: That fifth month on wuxu Spark-Delight transgressed the Right Enforcer.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Great ministers die, and those in charge of government have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great ministers die; those in power grieve.

units.en: September brought another Venus transit of the Right Enforcer.
units.literal: In the ninth month the Great White again transgressed the Right Enforcer.

units.zh: 案占：「五星災同，金火尤甚。」
units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "When the five planets make disasters, they are the same; Metal and Fire are especially severe."
units.literal: Investigating the prognostication: “Calamities of the Five Planets follow the same pattern; metal and fire are especially severe.

units.zh: 十一月戊子，太白犯房上星。
units.en: November wuzi placed Venus on Room’s upper star.
units.literal: On wuzi in the eleventh month the Great White transgressed the upper star of Room.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The Upper Minister will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The upper minister will suffer.

units.zh: 五年四月乙未，月犯畢距星。
units.en: Fifth year fourth month yiwei crossed the moon over the Net’s separator.
units.literal: On yiwei in the fourth month of the fifth year the Moon transgressed the separator star of the Net.

units.en: The prognostication said, "War will arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Arms will arise.

units.en: Seventh month jiyou repeated the lunar strike on Room’s upper star.
units.literal: On jiyou in the seventh month the Moon transgressed the upper star of Room.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Generals and chancellors will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Generals and ministers will suffer.

units.zh: 是月庚申，丞相王導薨，庾冰代輔政。
units.en: Gengshen that month ended Wang Dao; Yu Bing took regency.
units.literal: That month on gengshen Chancellor Wang Dao died; Yu Bing succeeded him in assisting government.

units.en: Grand Commandant Xi Jian died in the eighth month.
units.literal: In the eighth month Grand Commandant Xi Jian died.

units.zh: 又有沔南邾城之敗，百姓流亡萬餘家。
units.en: Defeat at Zhu city south of the Han sent over ten thousand families fleeing.
units.literal: Moreover there was defeat at Zhucheng on the Han south; more than ten thousand households fled.

units.zh: 六年正月，征西大將軍庾亮薨。
units.en: Sixth year’s first month saw Yu Liang’s death.
units.literal: In the first month of the sixth year General Who Conquers the West Yu Liang died.

units.zh: 六年三月甲辰，熒惑犯太微外將星。
units.en: Third month jiachen brought Mars across the Supreme Palace’s outer general.
units.literal: On jiachen in the third month Spark-Delight transgressed the outer general star of the Supreme Palace.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The supreme general will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The upper general will suffer.

units.zh: 四月丁丑，熒惑犯右執法。
units.en: Fourth month dingchou placed Mars on the Right Enforcer.
units.literal: On dingchou in the fourth month Spark-Delight transgressed the Right Enforcer.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Those in charge of government will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Those who wield government will suffer.

units.zh: 六月乙亥，月犯牽牛中央星。
units.en: Sixth month yihai crossed the moon over the Herdsman’s middle star.
units.literal: On yihai in the sixth month the Moon transgressed the central star of the Herdsman.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The great general will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great generals will suffer.

units.zh: 是時，尚書今何充為執法，有譴，欲避其咎，明年求為中書令。
units.en: Minister Secretary He Chong, holding the Enforcer portfolio and under criticism, sought transfer to Palace Secretary the next year to dodge fault.
units.literal: At that time Minister Secretary He Chong held the Enforcer office and faced censure; wishing to escape blame, the next year he requested appointment as Palace Secretary.

units.zh: 其四月丙午，太白犯畢距星。
units.en: Fourth month bingwu saw Venus cross the Net’s separator.
units.literal: That fourth month on bingwu the Great White transgressed the separator star of the Net.

units.en: The prognostication said, "War and arms will arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Armor and weapons arise.

units.en: One reading said, "The female ruler will have anxiety."
units.literal: Another saying: “The principal consort will suffer.

units.zh: 六月乙卯，太白犯軒轅大星。
units.en: Sixth month yimao placed Venus on Regulus.
units.literal: On yimao in the sixth month the Great White transgressed the great star of the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The female ruler will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The principal consort will suffer.

units.en: Empress Du died in the seventh year’s third month.
units.literal: In the third month of the seventh year Empress Du died.

units.en: Seventh year third month renwu brought the moon across Room.
units.literal: On renwu in the third month of the seventh year the Moon transgressed Room.

units.en: Fourth month jichou sent Venus into the Ghosts.
units.literal: On jichou in the fourth month the Great White entered the Ghosts.

units.en: May showed Venus by daylight.
units.literal: In the fifth month the Great White was seen in daytime.

units.en: Eighth month xinchou repeated a lunar Ghosts transit.
units.literal: On xinchou in the eighth month the Moon transgressed the Ghosts.

units.zh: 八年六月，熒惑犯房上第二星。
units.en: Eighth year sixth month Mars crossed Room’s second upper star.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the eighth year Spark-Delight transgressed the second upper star of Room.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The secondary minister will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The secondary minister will suffer.

units.en: Eighth month renyin brought the moon across the Net.
units.literal: On renyin in the eighth month the Moon transgressed the Net.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Those below trespass against those above, and war and arms arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Inferiors offend superiors; armor and weapons arise.

units.en: October the moon occulted the Net’s chief star.
units.literal: In the tenth month the Moon again covered the great star of the Net.

units.en: The gloss matched earlier entries.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.zh: 其建元二年，車騎將軍庾冰薨。
units.en: The second year of Jianyuan saw Yu Bing’s death.
units.literal: In the second year of Jianyuan General of Chariots and Cavalry Yu Bing died.

units.zh: 庾翼大發兵，謀伐石季龍，專制上流，朝廷憚之。
units.en: Yu Yi massed great armies, planning to campaign against Shi Jilong, monopolizing the upper Yangzi while the court feared him.
units.literal: Yu Yi mobilized great armies planning to campaign against Shi Jilong, monopolizing the upper Yangzi while the court feared him.

units.zh: 康帝建元元年正月壬午，太白入昴。
units.en: Emperor Kang’s first year of Jianyuan New Year renwu placed Venus in the Hairy Head.
units.literal: On renwu in the first month of Emperor Kang’s first year of Jianyuan the Great White entered the Hairy Head.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Zhao territory will have war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be troops in Zhao territory.

units.en: It also said, "War will arise under Heaven."
units.literal: It also says: “Under Heaven troops arise everywhere.

units.en: Fourth month yiyou showed Venus by daylight.
units.literal: On yiyou in the fourth month the Great White was seen in daytime.

units.zh: 是年，石季龍殺其子邃，又遣將寇沒狄道，及屯薊東，謀慕容皝。
units.en: That year Shi Jilong killed his son Sui, sent generals to raid and take Didao, camped east of Ji, and plotted against Murong Huang.
units.literal: That year Shi Jilong killed his son Sui, sent generals to raid Didao, camped east of Ji, and plotted against Murong Huang.

units.en: Year two Jupiter crossed Celestial Pass.
units.literal: In the second year the Year Star transgressed Celestial Pass.

units.zh: 安西將軍庾翼與兄冰書曰：「歲星犯天關，占云關梁當分。
units.en: General Who Pacifies the West Yu Yi wrote to his elder brother Bing, saying, "Jupiter trespassed against Celestial Pass; the prognostication says that passes and bridges should be divided.
units.literal: General Who Pacifies the West Yu Yi wrote his elder brother Bing: “The Year Star transgressed Celestial Pass; divination says passes and bridges should split.

units.zh: 比來江東無他故，江道亦不艱難，而石季龍頻年再閉關，不通信使，此復是天公憒憒，無皁白之徵也。」
units.en: Recently east of the Yangzi there has been no other incident, and the river route is also not difficult, yet Shi Jilong repeatedly closed the passes for successive years and did not communicate by envoys. This is again a sign that Heaven is muddled and has no black or white."
units.literal: Lately east of the river there has been no other crisis, nor is the Yangzi passage especially hard; yet Shi Jilong has repeatedly sealed the passes these years and blocked envoys—again Heaven’s confusion without clear black-or-white signs.

units.en: Intercalary yiyou saw Venus cross the Dipper.
units.literal: That intercalary month on yiyou the Great White transgressed the Dipper.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means mourning, and all under Heaven receives titles and salaries."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be mourning; under Heaven receives ranks and stipends.

units.zh: 九月，帝崩，太子立，大赦，賜爵。
units.en: September brought the emperor’s death, the heir’s accession, amnesty, and ennoblements.
units.literal: In the ninth month the emperor died; the heir apparent succeeded, a great amnesty was proclaimed, and noble ranks were bestowed.

units.zh: 穆帝永和元年正月丁丑，月入畢。
units.en: Emperor Mu’s Yonghe 1 dingchou placed the moon in the Net.
units.literal: On dingchou in the first month of Emperor Mu’s Yonghe 1 the Moon entered the Net.

units.en: The prognostication said, "War will greatly arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great armies arise.

units.en: Wuyin saw a lunar transit of Celestial Pass.
units.literal: On wuyin the Moon transgressed Celestial Pass.

units.zh: 占曰：「有亂臣更天子之法。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be disorderly ministers who change the Son of Heaven’s laws."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be rebellious ministers who alter the Son of Heaven’s institutions.

units.zh: 五月辛巳，太白晝見，在東井。
units.en: Fifth month xinsi showed Venus by daylight within the Eastern Well.
units.literal: On xinsi in the fifth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means ministers are strong, and Qin will have war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Ministers grow powerful; Qin will have troops.

units.zh: 六月辛丑，月入太微，犯屏西南星。
units.en: Sixth month xinchou brought the moon into the Supreme Palace across the screen’s southwest star.
units.literal: On xinchou in the sixth month the Moon entered the Supreme Palace and transgressed the southwest star of the screen.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Among the assistant ministers there will be those dismissed from office."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Among assisting ministers some will be dismissed or removed.

units.en: July and August each saw lunar Net transits.
units.literal: In the seventh and eighth months the Moon both transgressed the Net.

units.en: The gloss matched earlier readings.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.en: Jiwei crossing of the Ghosts by the moon.
units.literal: On jiwei the Moon transgressed the Ghosts.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Great ministers will be executed."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great ministers will be executed.

units.en: September gengxu repeated the lunar Net crossing.
units.literal: On gengxu in the ninth month the Moon again transgressed the Net.

units.en: Early that year Yu Yi held Xiangyang.
units.literal: That year early on Yu Yi was at Xiangyang.

units.zh: 七月，翼疾將終，輒以子爰之為荊州刺史，代己任。
units.en: July brought Yi’s deathbed order installing Yuanzhi at Jingzhou.
units.literal: In the seventh month, as Yi’s illness neared its end, he abruptly appointed his son Yuanzhi Inspector of Jingzhou to replace himself.

units.en: Yuanzhi quickly lost his post.
units.literal: Yuanzhi was soon deposed.

units.zh: 明年，桓溫又輒率眾伐蜀，執李勢，送至京都。
units.en: The next year Huan Wen likewise led a host to attack Shu, seized Li Shi, and sent him to the capital.
units.literal: The next year Huan Wen likewise led hosts to conquer Shu, seized Li Shi, and sent him to the capital.

units.en: Shu lay in ancient Qin’s heartland.
units.literal: Shu was fundamentally the old Qin territory.

units.zh: 二年二月壬子，月犯房上星。
units.en: Second year second month renzi crossed Room’s upper star.
units.literal: On renzi in the second month of the second year the Moon transgressed the upper star of Room.

units.zh: 四月丙戎，月又犯房上星。
units.en: Fourth month bingxu repeated the lunar strike on Room’s upper star.
units.literal: On bingxu in the fourth month the Moon again transgressed the upper star of Room.

units.zh: 八月壬申，太白犯左執法。
units.en: Eighth month renshen placed Venus on the Left Enforcer.
units.literal: On renshen in the eighth month the Great White transgressed the Left Enforcer.

units.zh: 三年正月壬午，月犯南斗第五星。
units.en: Third year New Year renwu crossed the Dipper’s fifth star.
units.literal: On renwu in the first month of the third year the Moon transgressed the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The general will die, and close ministers will leave."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Generals will die; intimate attendants depart.

units.zh: 五月壬申，月犯南斗第四星，因入魁。
units.en: Fifth month renshen crossed the Dipper’s fourth star into the bowl.
units.literal: On renshen in the fifth month the Moon transgressed the fourth star of the Southern Dipper and thereby entered the Dipper’s bowl.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be troops.

units.en: One reading said, "There will be a great amnesty."
units.literal: Another saying: “There will be a great amnesty.

units.en: June crossed the Eastern Well’s separators.
units.literal: In the sixth month the Moon transgressed the separator stars of the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The general will die, and the state will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Generals will die; the state has sorrow.

units.en: Wuxu brought the moon across the Five Feudatories.
units.literal: On wuxu the Moon transgressed the Five Feudatories.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Feudal lords will be executed."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Among feudatories some will be executed.

units.zh: 九月庚寅，太白犯南斗第五星。
units.en: September gengyin placed Venus on the Dipper’s fifth star.
units.literal: On gengyin in the ninth month the Great White transgressed the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means mourning and war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be mourning and troops.

units.zh: 四年七月丙申，太白犯左執法。
units.en: Fourth year seventh month bingshen crossed Venus over the Left Enforcer.
units.literal: On bingshen in the seventh month of the fourth year the Great White transgressed the Left Enforcer.

units.en: Jiayin saw the moon cross Room.
units.literal: On jiayin the Moon transgressed Room.

units.zh: 丁巳，月入南斗，犯第二星。
units.en: Dingsi placed the moon in the Dipper on its second star.
units.literal: On dingsi the Moon entered the Southern Dipper and transgressed the second star.

units.en: Yichou repeated Venus on the Left Enforcer.
units.literal: On yichou the Great White transgressed the Left Enforcer.

units.en: Every gloss matched earlier ones.
units.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.

units.en: October jiachen crossed the Neck.
units.literal: On jiachen in the tenth month the Moon transgressed the Neck.

units.en: The prognostication said, "War will arise, and the general will die."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Arms arise; generals die.

units.zh: 十一月戊戌，月犯上將星。
units.en: November wuxu crossed the Upper General star.
units.literal: On wuxu in the eleventh month the Moon transgressed the Upper General star.

units.en: Third year’s sixth month proclaimed sweeping pardon.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the third year there was a great amnesty.

units.zh: 是月，陳逵征壽春，敗而還。
units.en: Chen Kui’s Shouchun expedition failed that month.
units.literal: That month Chen Kui campaigned against Shouchun and returned defeated.

units.zh: 七月，氐蜀餘寇反，亂益土。
units.en: July saw Di and Shu holdouts ravage the southwest.
units.literal: In the seventh month Di and Shu remnant bandits rebelled and threw Yi lands into turmoil.

units.en: September Shi Hu marched on Liangzhou.
units.literal: In the ninth month Shi Jilong campaigned against Liangzhou.

units.zh: 五年，征北大將軍褚裒卒。
units.en: In the fifth year General Who Conquers the North Chu Pou died.
units.literal: In the fifth year General Who Conquers the North Chu Pou died.

units.zh: 四年四月，太白入昴，是時，戎晉相侵，趙地連兵尤甚。
units.en: Fourth year fourth month Venus entered Mao as barbarians and Jin skirmished and Zhao burned with fighting.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the fourth year the Great White entered the Hairy Head; at that time Rong and Jin raided each other and Zhao territory saw continuous warfare worst of all.

units.en: July Venus crossed the Chariot Shaft.
units.literal: In the seventh month the Great White transgressed the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It lies in Zhao, and also means war and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “In Zhao there will moreover be armies and mourning.

units.en: On jiayin the moon transgressed Room.
units.literal: On jiayin the Moon transgressed Room.

units.en: In the tenth month, on jiaxu, the moon transgressed the Neck.
units.literal: On jiaxu in the tenth month the Moon transgressed the Neck.

units.en: The prognostication said, "War will arise, and the general will die."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Arms arise; generals die.

units.zh: 八月，石季龍太子宣殺弟韜，宣亦死。
units.en: August saw Shi Hu’s heir Xuan murder Shi Tao before Xuan himself perished.
units.literal: In the eighth month Shi Jilong’s heir Shi Xuan killed his younger brother Tao; Xuan likewise died.

units.zh: 其十一月戊戌，月犯上將星。
units.en: November wuxu crossed the Upper General star.
units.literal: That eleventh month on wuxu the Moon transgressed the Upper General star.

units.zh: 五年正月，石季龍僭號稱皇帝，尋死。
units.en: Shi Hu crowned himself emperor that fifth-year New Year but died almost immediately.
units.literal: In the fifth year’s first month Shi Jilong arrogated the imperial title yet died soon after.

units.zh: 五年四月丁未，太白犯東井。
units.en: Fourth month dingwei sent Venus through the Eastern Well.
units.literal: On dingwei in the fifth year’s fourth month the Great White transgressed the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Qin will have war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Qin will have troops.

units.en: September wuxu crossed Venus over the Horn’s left spike.
units.literal: On wuxu in the ninth month the Great White transgressed the left horn.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be troops.

units.en: October brought a lunar Hairy Head crossing.
units.literal: In the tenth month the Moon transgressed the Hairy Head.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The Hu will have anxiety, and the general will die."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Hu will suffer sorrow; generals will die.

units.zh: 是年八月，褚裒北征兵敗。
units.en: August saw Chu Pou’s northern campaign fail.
units.literal: That eighth month Chu Pou’s northern expedition was defeated.

units.zh: 十月，關中二十餘舉兵內附。
units.en: October brought twenty-plus interior commanderies shifting allegiance.
units.literal: In the tenth month more than twenty prefectures east of the passes raised troops and submitted.

units.en: Shi Zun seized Nanyang.
units.literal: Shi Zun captured Nanyang.

units.zh: 十一月，冉閔殺石遵，又盡殺胡十餘萬人，於是趙魏大亂。
units.en: November Ran Min slew Shi Zun and massacred Hu north of a hundred thousand, plunging Zhao and Wei into turmoil.
units.literal: In the eleventh month Ran Min killed Shi Zun and slaughtered more than a hundred thousand Hu; Zhao and Wei fell into utter chaos.

units.en: In the twelfth month Chu Pou died.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Chu Pou died.

units.zh: 八年，劉顯、苻健、慕容雋並僭號。
units.en: Year eight saw Liu Xian, Fu Jian, and Murong Jun proclaim kingship.
units.literal: In the eighth year Liu Xian, Fu Jian, and Murong Jun alike arrogated royal titles.

units.en: Yin Hao’s northern march collapsed and cost him office.
units.literal: Yin Hao’s northern expedition failed; he was dismissed.

units.zh: 六年二月辛酉，月犯心大星。
units.en: Sixth year second month xinyou crossed the moon over Antares.
units.literal: On xinyou in the second month of the sixth year the Moon transgressed the great star of the Heart.

units.zh: 占曰：「大人憂，又豫州分野也。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "Great men will have anxiety, and it is also the allotment of Yuzhou."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great men will suffer; it is moreover Yu Province’s field.

units.en: Dingchou saw the moon cross Room.
units.literal: On dingchou the Moon transgressed Room.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Generals and chancellors will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Generals and ministers will suffer.

units.en: Sixth month jichou crossed the moon over the Hairy Head.
units.literal: On jichou in the sixth month the Moon transgressed the Hairy Head.

units.en: Same gloss as above.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.en: Yiwei crossed the Five Feudatories.
units.literal: On yiwei the Moon transgressed the Five Feudatories.

units.en: Again the earlier reading.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.zh: 七月壬寅，月始出西方，犯左角。
units.en: July renyin showed the moon rising westward onto the Horn’s left spike.
units.literal: On renyin in the seventh month the Moon first emerged in the west and transgressed the left horn.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The Great General will die."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Grand Marshal will die.

units.en: One reading said, "There will be war under Heaven."
units.literal: Another saying: “Under Heaven there will be troops.

units.en: Dingwei crossed the Winnowing Basket.
units.literal: On dingwei the Moon transgressed the Winnowing Basket.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The general will die."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Generals will die.

units.en: Bingyin Mars crossed the axe.
units.literal: On bingyin Spark-Delight transgressed the battle-axe star.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Great ministers will be executed."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great ministers will be executed.

units.en: August xinmao repeated the lunar left horn.
units.literal: On xinmao in the eighth month the Moon transgressed the left horn.

units.en: Daylight Venus shone inside the Dipper.
units.literal: The Great White was seen in daytime in the Southern Dipper.

units.en: The moon crossed the Right Enforcer.
units.literal: The Moon transgressed the Right Enforcer.

units.en: Each gloss matched earlier entries.
units.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.

units.zh: 是歲，司徒蔡謨免為庶人。
units.en: Cai Mo lost his noble rank that year.
units.literal: That year Minister of Education Cai Mo was dismissed and made a commoner.

units.en: Seventh year second month Venus crossed Mao.
units.literal: In the seventh year’s second month the Great White transgressed the Hairy Head.

units.en: Same reading as before.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.zh: 三月乙卯，熒惑入輿鬼，犯積尸。
units.en: March yimao brought Mars through the Ghosts’ corpse heap.
units.literal: On yimao in the third month Spark-Delight entered the Ghosts and transgressed the heaped corpses.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Noble men will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Noble men will suffer.

units.zh: 五月乙未，熒惑犯軒轅大星。
units.en: May yiwei crossed Mars over Regulus.
units.literal: On yiwei in the fifth month Spark-Delight transgressed the great star of the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The female ruler will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The principal consort will suffer.

units.en: Venus slid into the Net’s gap and struck its left leg.
units.literal: The Great White entered the mouth of the Net and transgressed the left thigh.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Generals and chancellors will bear it."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Generals and ministers will answer for it.

units.en: June yihai crossed the Winnowing Basket.
units.literal: On yihai in the sixth month the Moon transgressed the Winnowing Basket.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The state will have war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The state will have troops.

units.en: Bingzi crossed the Dipper.
units.literal: On bingzi the Moon transgressed the Dipper.

units.zh: 丁丑，熒惑入太微，犯右執法。
units.en: Dingchou Mars entered the Supreme Palace on the Right Enforcer.
units.literal: On dingchou Spark-Delight entered the Supreme Palace and transgressed the Right Enforcer.

units.en: August gengwu Venus crossed the Chariot Shaft.
units.literal: On gengwu in the eighth month the Great White transgressed the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: Wuzi repeated Venus on the Right Enforcer.
units.literal: On wuzi the Great White transgressed the Right Enforcer.

units.en: Every gloss matched earlier ones.
units.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.

units.zh: 七年，劉顯殺石祗及諸將帥，山東大亂，疾疫死亡。
units.en: In the seventh year Liu Xian slew Shi Zhi and the various commanders; east of the mountains fell into turmoil, with pestilence and death.
units.literal: In the seventh year Liu Xian killed Shi Zhi and sundry commanders; east of the mountains chaos reigned and pestilence carried off countless dead.

units.zh: 八年三月戊戌，月犯軒轅大星。
units.en: Eighth year third month wuxu crossed Regulus.
units.literal: On wuxu in the third month of the eighth year the Moon transgressed the great star of the Chariot Shaft.

units.zh: 癸丑，月入南斗，犯第二星。
units.en: Guichou placed the moon in the Dipper on its second star.
units.literal: On guichou the Moon entered the Southern Dipper and transgressed the second star.

units.en: May crossed lunar Heart stars.
units.literal: In the fifth month the Moon transgressed stars of the Heart.

units.en: June guiyou crossed Room.
units.literal: On guiyou in the sixth month the Moon transgressed Room.

units.zh: 七月壬子，歲星犯東井距星。
units.en: July renzi Jupiter crossed the Eastern Well’s separators.
units.literal: On renzi in the seventh month the Year Star transgressed the separator stars of the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be internal disorder, and war will arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Internal rebellion and troops arise.

units.en: August wuxu Mars entered the Ghosts.
units.literal: On wuxu in the eighth month Spark-Delight entered the Ghosts.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Loyal ministers will die by execution."
units.literal: The omen-text says: Loyal ministers die by execution.

units.zh: 丙辰，太白入南斗，犯第四星。
units.en: Bingchen Venus entered the Dipper on its fourth star.
units.literal: On bingchen the Great White entered the Southern Dipper and transgressed the fourth star.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The general will make disorder."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Generals will rebel.

units.en: One reading said, "The Chancellor will be dismissed."
units.literal: Another saying: “The chancellor will be dismissed.

units.zh: 九年二月乙巳，月入南斗，犯第三星。
units.en: Ninth year second month yisi crossed the Dipper’s third star.
units.literal: On yisi in the second month of the ninth year the Moon entered the Southern Dipper and transgressed the third star.

units.en: March wuchen crossed Room.
units.literal: On wuchen in the third month the Moon transgressed Room.

units.zh: 八月，歲星犯輿鬼東南星。
units.en: August Jupiter struck the Ghosts’ southeast star.
units.literal: In the eighth month the Year Star transgressed the southeastern star of the Ghosts.

units.en: The prognostication said, "War will arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Arms will arise.

units.zh: 是時，帝幼沖，母后稱制，將相有隙，兵革連起，慕容雋僭號稱燕王，攻伐不休。
units.en: The boy emperor and regent mother split the court; warlords feuded; Murong Jun crowned himself Yan king and fought endlessly.
units.literal: At that time the emperor was a child; the empress dowager ruled in regency; generals and ministers nursed grudges; arms rose in succession; Murong Jun styled himself King of Yan and campaigned without rest.

units.zh: 十年正月乙卯，月蝕昴星。
units.en: Tenth year New Year yimao saw the moon occult Mao stars.
units.literal: On yimao in the first month of the tenth year the Moon eclipsed stars of the Hairy Head.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Zhao and Wei will have war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Zhao and Wei will have troops.

units.en: Guiyou Saturn occulted the axe.
units.literal: On guiyou the Station Star covered the battle-axe star.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Axes of punishment will be used."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Axes of punishment are employed.

units.en: February jiashen crossed Antares.
units.literal: On jiashen in the second month the Moon transgressed the great star of the Heart.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The king hates it."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The king finds it ill-omened.

units.en: July gengwu Venus appeared by day.
units.literal: On gengwu in the seventh month the Great White was seen in daytime.

units.en: Gnomon reckoning placed disaster in Qin and Zheng.
units.literal: Shadow measurement infers calamity in Qin and Zheng domains.

units.zh: 九月辛酉，太白犯左執法。
units.en: September xinyou Venus crossed the Left Enforcer.
units.literal: On xinyou in the ninth month the Great White transgressed the Left Enforcer.

units.zh: 是時，桓溫擅命，朝臣多見迫脅。
units.en: Huan Wen dictated policy while ministers lived under duress.
units.literal: At that time Huan Wen monopolized orders and courtiers faced constant coercion.

units.zh: 四月，溫伐苻健，破其嶢柳軍。
units.en: In the fourth month Wen campaigned against Fu Jian and crushed his Yaoliu army.
units.literal: In the fourth month Wen campaigned against Fu Jian and broke his Yaoliu army.

units.en: December Murong Ke struck Qi.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Murong Ke attacked Qi.

units.zh: 十一年三月辛亥，月奄軒轅。
units.en: Eleventh year third month xinhai saw a lunar occultation of the Chariot Shaft.
units.literal: On xinhai in the third month of the eleventh year the Moon occulted the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: Same gloss as above.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.zh: 四月庚寅，月犯牛宿南星。
units.en: April gengyin crossed the Ox’s southern star.
units.literal: On gengyin in the fourth month the Moon transgressed the southern star of the Ox.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The state will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The state will have sorrow.

units.en: August jiwei Venus crossed Celestial River.
units.literal: On jiwei in the eighth month the Great White transgressed Celestial River.

units.en: The prognostication said, "River crossings will not be passable."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “River fords will not open.

units.zh: 十二年六月庚子，太白晝見，在東井。
units.en: Twelfth year sixth month gengzi showed Venus by day in the Well.
units.literal: On gengzi in the twelfth year’s sixth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Eastern Well.

units.en: Same reading as above.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.en: Jiwei crossed the axe star.
units.literal: On jiwei the Moon transgressed the battle-axe star.

units.en: August guiyou occulted the Establishment asterism.
units.literal: On guiyou in the eighth month the Moon occulted the Establishment Stars.

units.zh: 九月戊寅，熒惑入太微，犯西蕃上將星。
units.en: September wuyin Mars crossed the Supreme Palace’s western Upper General.
units.literal: On wuyin in the ninth month Spark-Delight entered the Supreme Palace and transgressed the Upper General of the western bastion.

units.zh: 十一月丁丑，熒惑犯太微東蕃上相星。
units.en: November dingchou Mars struck the eastern bastion’s Upper Minister.
units.literal: On dingchou in the eleventh month Spark-Delight transgressed the Upper Minister star of the eastern bastion of the Supreme Palace.

units.zh: 十二年十一月，齊城陷，執段龕，殺三千餘人。
units.en: Twelfth year’s eleventh month saw Qi fall, Duan Kan captured, and three thousand slain.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the twelfth year Qi city fell; Duan Kan was seized and more than three thousand were killed.

units.zh: 永和三年，鮮卑侵略河、冀。
units.en: Yonghe 3 brought Xianbei strikes on the Yellow River and Ji.
units.literal: In Yonghe 3 Xianbei raided the Yellow River and Ji Province.

units.zh: 升平元年，慕容雋遂據臨漳，盡有幽、并、青、冀之地。
units.en: Shengping 1 placed Linzhang in Murong Jun’s hands across You, Bing, Qing, and Ji.
units.literal: In Shengping 1 Murong Jun seized Linzhang and held You, Bing, Qing, and Ji entirely.

units.zh: 緣河諸將奔散，河津隔絕。
units.en: River commanders collapsed and fords closed.
units.literal: Generals along the Yellow River fled and scattered; river crossings were cut.

units.en: Power sat with governors as every province fought.
units.literal: Authority then rested with regional shepherds while the nine circuits exchanged blows.

units.zh: 升平元年四月壬子，太白入輿鬼。
units.en: Shengping 1 fourth month renzi Venus entered the Ghosts.
units.literal: On renzi in the fourth month of Shengping 1 the Great White entered the Ghosts.

units.zh: 丁亥，月奄井南轅西頭第二星。
units.en: Dinghai occulted the Well’s southern carriage star.
units.literal: On dinghai the Moon occulted the second western star at the southern pole of the Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Qin territory will have war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Qin territory will have troops.

units.en: One reading said, "The general will die."
units.literal: Another saying: “Generals will die.

units.zh: 六月戊戌，太白晝見，在軫。
units.en: June wuxu showed daylight Venus in the Wings.
units.literal: In the sixth month on wuxu the Great White was seen in daytime in the Wings.

units.en: Same gloss as above.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.en: The Wings lodge governs Chu.
units.literal: Wings is Chu’s celestial field.

units.en: Renzi saw the moon cross the Net.
units.literal: On renzi the Moon transgressed the Net.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means frontier war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be frontier troops.

units.en: July xinsi placed Mars on Celestial River.
units.literal: On xinsi in the seventh month Spark-Delight transgressed Celestial River.

units.en: The prognostication said, "River crossings will not be passable."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “River fords will not open.

units.en: November Jupiter crossed Room.
units.literal: In the eleventh month the Year Star transgressed Room.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Yuzhou will have disaster."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Yu Province will suffer disaster.

units.zh: 其年五月，苻堅殺苻生而立。
units.en: May saw Fu Jian slay Fu Sheng and usurp power.
units.literal: That fifth month Fu Jian killed Fu Sheng and took the throne.

units.en: December Murong Jun massed at Ye.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Murong Jun advanced and encamped at Ye.

units.zh: 二年八月，豫州刺史謝奕薨。
units.en: Second year eighth month Xie Yi died in office.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the second year Inspector of Yuzhou Xie Yi died.

units.zh: 二年二月辛卯，填星犯軒轅大星。
units.en: Second year second month xinmao Saturn crossed Regulus.
units.literal: On xinmao in the second month of the second year the Station Star transgressed the great star of the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The ruler of men hates it."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The ruler will find it ill-omened.

units.en: Jiawu crossed the Eastern Well.
units.literal: On jiawu the Moon transgressed the Eastern Well.

units.en: June xinyou crossed Room.
units.literal: On xinyou in the sixth month the Moon transgressed Room.

units.en: October jiwei Venus crossed the Weeping asterism.
units.literal: On jiwei in the tenth month the Great White transgressed the Weeping Stars.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be great weeping."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be great weeping.

units.zh: 三年正月壬辰，熒惑犯楗閉星。
units.en: Third year New Year renchen Mars crossed Key-and-Bolt.
units.literal: On renchen in the first month of the third year Spark-Delight transgressed Key-and-Bolt.

units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "The ruler of men will have anxiety."
units.literal: Investigating the archive gloss: “The ruler will suffer.

units.zh: 三月乙酉，熒惑逆行犯鉤鈐。
units.en: March yiyou retrograde Mars struck Hook-and-Hasp.
units.literal: On yiyou in the third month Spark-Delight retrograded and transgressed Hook-and-Hasp.

units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "The king hates it."
units.literal: Investigating the gloss: “The king finds it ill-omened.

units.en: June Venus crossed the Eastern Well.
units.literal: In the sixth month the Great White transgressed the Eastern Well.

units.en: July yiyou Mars crossed Celestial River.
units.literal: On yiyou in the seventh month Spark-Delight transgressed Celestial River.

units.en: Bingxu Venus entered the Ghosts.
units.literal: On bingxu the Great White transgressed the Ghosts.

units.en: Every gloss matched earlier entries.
units.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.

units.zh: 戊子，月犯牽牛中央大星。
units.en: Wuzi crossed the Herdsman’s central star.
units.literal: On wuzi the Moon transgressed the central great star of the Herdsman.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Herdsman is Heaven’s general.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Herdsman is Heaven’s general.

units.en: If it trespasses against the central great star, the general will die."
units.literal: Transgressing its central great star means generals will die.

units.zh: 八月丁未，太白犯軒轅大星。
units.en: August dingwei Venus crossed Regulus.
units.literal: On dingwei in the eighth month the Great White transgressed the great star of the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: Jiazi crossed the Net’s chief star.
units.literal: On jiazi the Moon transgressed the great star of the Net.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means frontier war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be frontier troops.

units.en: Subjects rebel against lords.
units.literal: Another saying: “Inferiors offend superiors.

units.zh: 三年十月，諸葛恢舟軍入河，敗績。
units.en: October Zhuge Hui’s boats sailed up the river and met disaster.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the third year Zhuge Hui’s river fleet entered the Yellow River and was crushed.

units.zh: 豫州刺史謝萬入潁，眾潰而歸，萬除名。
units.en: Xie Wan’s Ying expedition collapsed and cost him his title.
units.literal: Inspector of Yuzhou Xie Wan marched into Ying; his host routed and he returned stripped of rank.

units.zh: 十一月，司徒會稽王以郗曇、謝萬二鎮敗，求自敗，求自貶三等。
units.en: The Minister of Education, Prince of Kuaiji, citing the defeats of Xi Tan and Xie Wan, asked to take blame for the defeat and to demote himself three grades.
units.literal: In the eleventh month the Minister of Education, Prince of Kuaiji, citing defeats on the Xi Tan and Xie Wan fronts, offered repeatedly to demote himself three grades.

units.zh: 四年正月，慕容雋死，子暐代立。
units.en: Fourth year’s New Year buried Murong Jun; Murong Wei succeeded.
units.literal: In the first month of the fourth year Murong Jun died; his son Wei succeeded.

units.zh: 慕容恪殺其尚書令陽騖等。
units.en: Murong Ke killed Yang Wu and colleagues.
units.literal: Murong Ke executed Minister Secretary Yang Wu and others.

units.zh: 四年正月乙亥，月犯牽牛中央大星。
units.en: On yihai in the first month of the fourth year the moon crossed the Herdsman’s central star.
units.literal: On yihai in the first month of the fourth year the Moon transgressed the central great star of the Herdsman.

units.en: June xinhai Mercury crossed Regulus.
units.literal: On xinhai in the sixth month the Dawn Star transgressed the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The female ruler will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The principal consort will suffer.

units.zh: 己未，太白入太微右掖門，從端門出。
units.en: Jiwei Venus slipped through the Supreme Palace’s right gate out the Vermilion Portal.
units.literal: On jiwei the Great White entered the right-side gate of the Supreme Palace and exited through the Portal Gate.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The noble will lose power."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Nobles will lose power.

units.en: One reading said, "There will be war."
units.literal: Another saying: “There will be troops.

units.en: It also said, "When it exits the Portal Gate, ministers are not ministers."
units.literal: It also says: “Emerging from the Portal Gate means ministers are no longer ministers.

units.en: August wushen Venus crossed the Base.
units.literal: On wushen in the eighth month the Great White transgressed the Base.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The state will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The state will have sorrow.

units.zh: 丙辰，熒惑犯太微西蕃上將星。
units.en: Bingchen Mars struck the western Upper General.
units.literal: On bingchen Spark-Delight transgressed the Upper General on the Supreme Palace’s western bastion.

units.zh: 九月壬午，太白入南斗口，犯第四星。
units.en: September renwu Venus entered the Dipper mouth on its fourth star.
units.literal: On renwu in the ninth month the Great White entered the mouth of the Southern Dipper and transgressed the fourth star.

units.zh: 占曰：「為喪，有赦，天下受爵祿。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "It means mourning, there will be amnesty, and all under Heaven will receive titles and salaries."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be mourning, amnesty, and under Heaven receiving ranks and stipends.

units.en: December jiayin brought Mars across Room.
units.literal: On jiayin in the twelfth month Spark-Delight transgressed Room.

units.en: Bingyin Venus shone by day.
units.literal: On bingyin the Great White was seen in daytime.

units.zh: 庚寅，月犯健閉，占曰：「人君惡之。」
units.en: On gengyin, the moon trespassed against Key-and-Bolt; the prognostication said, "The ruler of men hates it."
units.literal: On gengyin the Moon transgressed Key-and-Bolt; the interpretation says: “The ruler finds it ill-omened.

units.zh: 五年正月乙巳，填星逆行，犯太微。
units.en: Fifth year New Year yisi Saturn retrograded into the Supreme Palace.
units.literal: On yisi in the first month of the fifth year the Station Star moved retrograde and transgressed the Supreme Palace.

units.en: May renyin crossed the Supreme Palace.
units.literal: On renyin in the fifth month the Moon transgressed the Supreme Palace.

units.en: Gengxu crossed the Establishment asterism.
units.literal: On gengxu the Moon transgressed the Establishment Stars.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Great ministers plot against one another."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great ministers plot against one another.

units.zh: 是時，殷浩敗績，卒致遷徙。
units.en: Yin Hao’s defeat brought banishment.
units.literal: At that time Yin Hao’s armies were ruined and he ended in exile.

units.en: Month’s xinhai crossed the Ox.
units.literal: That month on xinhai the Moon transgressed the Ox lodge.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The state will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The state will have sorrow.

units.zh: 六月癸亥，月犯氐東北星。
units.en: June guihai crossed the Base’s northeast star.
units.literal: On guihai in the sixth month the Moon transgressed the northeastern star of the Base.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The great general bears it."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The grand marshal will answer for it.

units.zh: 五年正月，北中郎將郗曇薨。
units.en: Fifth year’s first month Xi Tan died.
units.literal: In the first month of the fifth year General of the Northern Army Xi Tan died.

units.zh: 五月，帝崩，哀帝立，大赦，賜爵，褚後失勢。
units.en: May’s imperial death enthroned Emperor Ai with amnesty while Empress Chu fell from power.
units.literal: In the fifth month the emperor died; Emperor Ai succeeded with great amnesty, titles granted, and Empress Chu losing influence.

units.zh: 七月，慕容恪攻冀州刺史呂護于野王，護奔滎陽。
units.en: July Murong Ke trapped Lu Hu at Yewang until Lu bolted to Xingyang.
units.literal: In the seventh month Murong Ke besieged Inspector of Jizhou Lu Hu at Yewang; Lu fled to Xingyang.

units.zh: 是時，桓溫以大眾次宛，聞護敗，乃退。
units.en: Huan Wen camped at Wan but retired on Lu’s rout.
units.literal: At that time Huan Wen massed at Wan; hearing of Lu’s defeat he withdrew.

units.zh: 五年六月癸酉，月奄氐東北星。
units.en: Fifth year sixth month guiyou occulted the Base’s northeast star.
units.literal: On guiyou in the sixth month of the fifth year the Moon occulted the northeastern star of the Base.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The Great General bears it."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Grand Marshal will answer for it.

units.en: September yiyou occulted the Net.
units.literal: On yiyou in the ninth month the Moon occulted the Net.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be frontier war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be frontier troops.

units.en: October dingwei crossed the Net’s chief star.
units.literal: On dingwei in the tenth month the Moon transgressed the great star of the Net.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Those below trespass against those above."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Inferiors offend superiors.

units.en: It also said, "There will be frontier war."
units.literal: It also says: “There will be frontier troops.

units.en: Fan Wang lost office in August.
units.literal: In the eighth month Fan Wang was dismissed.

units.zh: 隆和元年，慕容暐遣將寇河陰。
units.en: Longhe 1 Murong Wei struck Heyin.
units.literal: In Longhe 1 Murong Wei sent generals to raid Heyin.

units.zh: 哀帝興寧三年七月庚戌，月犯南斗。
units.en: Emperor Ai’s Xingning 3 seventh month gengxu crossed the Dipper.
units.literal: On gengxu in the seventh month of Emperor Ai’s Xingning 3 the Moon transgressed the Southern Dipper.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The female ruler will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The principal consort will suffer.

units.en: Jupiter crossed the Ghosts.
units.literal: The Year Star transgressed the Ghosts.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The ruler of men will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The ruler will suffer.

units.en: October daylight Venus shone in the Neck.
units.literal: In the tenth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Neck.

units.zh: 占曰：「亢為朝廷，有兵喪，為臣強。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "Neck is the court; there will be war and mourning, and ministers will be strong."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Neck is the court; there will be armies and mourning; ministers grow powerful.

units.en: The following May Empress Yu passed away.
units.literal: The next fifth month Empress Yu died.

units.zh: 海西太和二年正月，太白入昴。
units.en: Emperor Hai’s Taihe 2 New Year Venus entered Mao.
units.literal: In the first month of Emperor Hai’s Taihe 2 the Great White entered the Hairy Head.

units.zh: 五年，慕容暐為苻堅所滅，又據司、冀、幽、并四州。
units.en: Year five Fu Jian destroyed Murong Wei and seized four northern provinces.
units.literal: In the fifth year Murong Wei fell to Fu Jian who then held Si, Ji, You, and Bing.

units.zh: 六年閏月，熒惑守太微端門。
units.en: Sixth year’s leap month stationed Mars on the Portal Gate.
units.literal: In the intercalary month of the sixth year Spark-Delight guarded the Portal Gate of the Supreme Palace.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The Son of Heaven will lose the state."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Son of Heaven loses his state.

units.en: It also said, "Feudal lords and the Three Dukes plot against their superior."
units.literal: It also says: “Marquises and Three Dukes plot against their ruler.

units.en: One reading said, "There will be beheaded ministers."
units.literal: Another saying: “There will be executed ministers.

units.en: Xinmao crossed Antares.
units.literal: On xinmao the Moon transgressed the great star of the Heart.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The king hates it."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The king finds it ill-omened.

units.zh: 十一月，桓溫廢帝，並奏誅武陵王，簡文不許，溫乃徙之新安，皆臣強之應也。
units.en: November Huan Wen’s deposition and attempted purge of Prince Wuling illustrated ministerial dominance.
units.literal: In the eleventh month Huan Wen deposed the emperor and memorialized to execute Prince Wuling; Emperor Jianwen forbade it, so Wen banished him to Xin’an—all responses to overpowerful ministers.

units.zh: 簡文咸安元年十二月辛卯，熒惑逆行入太微，二年三月猶不退。
units.en: Xian’an 1 December xinmao began Mars’ retrograde Supreme Palace stay lasting into year two.
units.literal: On xinmao in the twelfth month of Emperor Jianwen’s Xian’an 1 Spark-Delight retrograded into the Supreme Palace and still had not withdrawn by the third month of year 2.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The state will not be at peace, and there will be anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The state is not secure; there is sorrow.

units.en: The emperor lived under Huan Wen’s thumb.
units.literal: At that time the emperor suffered Huan Wen’s coercion.

units.zh: 二年五月丁未，太白犯天關。
units.en: Year two fifth month dingwei Venus crossed Celestial Pass.
units.literal: On dingwei in the second year’s fifth month the Great White transgressed Celestial Pass.

units.en: The prognostication said, "War will arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Arms will arise.

units.en: Jupiter looked like Venus in hue.
units.literal: The Year Star’s color and shape resembled the Great White.

units.en: The prognostication said, "When advance and retreat follow measure, treachery and evil cease;
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Advancing and retreating according to measure means treachery subsides;

units.en: erratic color and course deny the sovereign fortune.
units.literal: Changed colors and chaotic motion mean the ruler lacks blessing.

units.zh: 歲星于仲夏當細小而不明，此其失常也。
units.en: Midsummer Jupiter should be dim—its brilliance broke the rule.
units.literal: The Year Star at midsummer ought to be faint and small; here it failed that norm.

units.en: it also means ministers are strong."
units.literal: It also means ministers grow powerful.

units.en: June daylight Venus shone in the Seven Stars.
units.literal: In the sixth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Seven Stars.

units.en: Yiyou Venus crossed the Ghosts.
units.literal: On yiyou the Great White transgressed the Ghosts.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The state will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The state will have sorrow.

units.zh: 七月，帝崩，桓溫以兵威擅權，將誅王坦之等，內外迫脅。
units.en: July’s imperial death let Huan Wen terrorize the realm and threaten Wang Tanzhi.
units.literal: In the seventh month the emperor died; Huan Wen wielded military awe and usurpatory power, prepared to execute Wang Tanzhi and others, coercing court and camp alike.

units.zh: 又，庾希入京城，盧悚入宮，並誅滅之。
units.en: Yu Xi and Lu Song’s palace intrigues ended in slaughter.
units.literal: Moreover Yu Xi entered the capital district and Lu Song entered the palace; both were exterminated.

units.zh: 孝武甯康元年正月戊申，月奄心大星。
units.en: On wushen in the first month of Emperor Xiaowu’s Ningkang 1, the Moon occulted Antares.
units.literal: On wushen in the first month of Emperor Xiaowu’s Ningkang 1 the Moon occulted the great star of the Heart.

units.zh: 案上曰：「災不在王者，則在豫州。」
units.en: Examining the above, it said, "If the disaster is not in the king, then it is in Yuzhou."
units.literal: Investigating the superior gloss: “If calamity spares the king, it falls on Yu Province.

units.en: One reading said, "The ruler’s fate hates it."
units.literal: Another saying: “The ruler’s mandate finds it ill-omened.

units.zh: 三月丙午，月奄南斗第五星。
units.en: March bingwu occulted the Dipper’s fifth star.
units.literal: On bingwu in the third month the Moon occulted the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Great ministers will have anxiety, and there will be death."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great ministers grieve; there is death.

units.en: One reading said, "The general will die."
units.literal: Another saying: “Generals will die.

units.en: In the seventh month Huan Wen died.
units.literal: In the seventh month Huan Wen died.

units.en: September guisi Mars entered the Supreme Palace.
units.literal: On guisi in the ninth month Spark-Delight entered the Supreme Palace.

units.zh: 是時，女主臨朝，政事多缺。
units.en: The regent empress ruled imperfectly.
units.literal: At that time the chief lady held court; governance suffered many lapses.

units.zh: 二年閏月己未，月奄牽牛南星。
units.en: Year two leap month jiwei occulted the Herdsman’s south star.
units.literal: On jiwei in the intercalary month of the second year the Moon occulted the southern star of the Herdsman.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The Left General will die."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The general of the left will die.

units.zh: 十二月甲申，太白晝見，在氐。
units.en: December jiashen daylight Venus shone in the Base.
units.literal: On jiashen in the twelfth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Base.

units.en: The Base governs Yanzhou.
units.literal: The Base is Yanzhou’s celestial field.

units.zh: 三年五月丙午，北中郎將王坦之薨。
units.en: Third year fifth month Wang Tanzhi died.
units.literal: On bingwu in the fifth month of the third year General of the Northern Army Wang Tanzhi died.

units.zh: 三年六月辛卯，太白犯東井。
units.en: Third year sixth month xinmao Venus crossed the Eastern Well.
units.literal: On xinmao in the sixth month of the third year the Great White transgressed the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Qin territory will have war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Qin territory will have troops.

units.zh: 九月戊申，熒惑奄左執法。
units.en: September wushen Mars occulted the Left Enforcer.
units.literal: On wushen in the ninth month Spark-Delight occulted the Left Enforcer.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Those who enforce the law will die."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Those holding enforcement offices die.

units.en: In Taiyuan 1 Fu Jian took Liangzhou.
units.literal: In Taiyuan 1 Fu Jian conquered Liangzhou.

units.zh: 二年十月，尚書令王彪之卒。
units.en: Second year October Wang Biaozhi died.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the second year Minister Secretary Wang Biaozhi died.

units.zh: 太元元年四月丙戌，熒惑犯南斗第三星。
units.en: On bingxu in the fourth month of Taiyuan 1, Mars crossed the Dipper’s third star.
units.literal: On bingxu in the fourth month of Taiyuan 1 Spark-Delight transgressed the third star of the Southern Dipper.

units.en: Bingshen occulted the fourth star.
units.literal: On bingshen it again occulted the fourth star.

units.en: The prognostication said, "War will greatly arise, and the central states will have famine."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great armies arise and the Middle Kingdom starves.

units.en: One reading said, "There will be amnesty."
units.literal: Another saying: “There will be amnesty.

units.zh: 八月癸酉，太白晝見，在氐。
units.en: August guiyou daylight Venus shone in the Base.
units.literal: On guiyou in the eighth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Base.

units.en: That lodge marks Yanzhou.
units.literal: The Base is Yanzhou’s celestial field.

units.zh: 九月，熒惑犯哭泣星，遂入羽林。
units.en: September Mars crossed the Weepers and entered the imperial guards.
units.literal: In the ninth month Spark-Delight transgressed the Weeping Stars and then entered the Forbidden Guards.

units.zh: 占曰：「天子有哭泣事，中軍兵起。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "The Son of Heaven will have an occasion of weeping, and the central army will arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Son of Heaven has occasions for weeping; the central army rises.

units.en: November jiwei occulted the Base’s horn.
units.literal: On jiwei in the eleventh month the Moon occulted the horn of the Base.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be war under Heaven."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Under Heaven there will be troops.

units.en: One reading said, "The state will have anxiety."
units.literal: Another saying: “The state will have sorrow.

units.en: Year two February Mars stationed in the palace guard stars.
units.literal: In the second month of the second year Spark-Delight guarded the Forbidden Guards.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The palace troops will greatly arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Palace troops rise on a grand scale.

units.zh: 九月壬午，太白晝見，在角。
units.en: September renwu daylight Venus shone in the Horn.
units.literal: On renwu in the ninth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Horn.

units.en: The Horn maps Yanzhou.
units.literal: The Horn is Yanzhou’s celestial field.

units.en: Shengping 1 May proclaimed sweeping pardon.
units.literal: In the fifth month of Shengping 1 there was a great amnesty.

units.zh: 三年八月，秦人寇樊、鄧、襄陽、彭城。
units.en: Third year eighth month Former Qin hit strategic towns.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the third year Qin raiders struck Fan, Deng, Xiangyang, and Pengcheng.

units.zh: 四年二月，襄陽陷，朱序沒。
units.en: Fourth year February Xiangyang collapsed with Zhu Xu taken.
units.literal: In the second month of the fourth year Xiangyang fell and Zhu Xu was captured.

units.zh: 四月，魏興陷，賊聚廣陵、三河，眾五六萬。
units.en: April Weixing fell while rebels gathered fifty thousand plus.
units.literal: In the fourth month Weixing fell; bandits massed at Guangling and Sanhe—fifty or sixty thousand strong.

units.zh: 於是諸軍外次沖要，丹陽尹屯衛京都。
units.en: Hosts guarded passes as the capital prefect defended Jiankang.
units.literal: Then each army camped on exterior choke points while the metropolitan prefect garrisoned the capital.

units.zh: 六月，兗州刺史謝玄討賊，大破之。
units.en: June Xie Xuan routed the rebels.
units.literal: In the sixth month Inspector of Yanzhou Xie Xuan attacked the bandits and shattered them.

units.zh: 是時，中外連兵，比年荒儉。
units.en: Empire-wide war met year-on-year dearth.
units.literal: At that time interior and exterior alike were at arms and famine stalked successive years.

units.zh: 四年十一月丁巳，太白犯哭星。
units.en: Fourth year November dingsi Venus crossed the Weepers.
units.literal: On dingsi in the fourth year’s eleventh month the Great White transgressed the Weeping Stars.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The Son of Heaven will have an occasion of weeping."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Son of Heaven will have occasions for weeping.

units.zh: 五年七月丙子，辰星犯軒轅。
units.en: On bingzi in the seventh month of the fifth year, Mercury crossed Regulus.
units.literal: On bingzi in the seventh month of the fifth year the Dawn Star transgressed the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The female ruler bears it."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The principal consort will answer for it.

units.en: September guiwei buried Empress Wang.
units.literal: On guiwei in the ninth month Empress Wang died.

units.en: Sixth year ninth month bingzi.
units.literal: On bingzi in the ninth month of the sixth year.

units.en: Venus appeared by daylight.
units.literal: The Great White was seen in daytime.

units.zh: 七年十一月，太白又晝見，在斗。
units.en: Seventh year November daylight Venus returned in the Dipper.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of the seventh year the Great White was again seen in daytime in the Dipper.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Wu will have war and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Wu will suffer armies and mourning.

units.zh: 八年四月甲子，太白又晝見，在參。
units.en: Eighth year fourth month jiazi daylight Venus shone in Orion’s belt.
units.literal: On jiazi in the eighth year’s fourth month the Great White was again seen in daytime in the Triaster.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Wei will have war and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Wei will suffer armies and mourning.

units.zh: 是月，桓沖征沔漢，楊亮伐蜀，並拔城略地。
units.en: That month Huan Chong and Yang Liang advanced on multiple fronts.
units.literal: That month Huan Chong campaigned along the Han while Yang Liang attacked Shu; both took cities and territory.

units.zh: 八月，苻堅自將，號百萬，九月，攻沒壽陽。
units.en: August Fu Jian marched; September Shouchun fell.
units.literal: In the eighth month Fu Jian led hosts touted at a million; in the ninth month he captured Shouchun.

units.zh: 十月，劉牢之破苻堅將梁成，斬之，殺獲萬餘人。
units.en: October Liu Laozhi slew Liang Cheng and claimed myriad captives.
units.literal: In the tenth month Liu Laozhi defeated Fu Jian’s general Liang Cheng, beheaded him, and killed or captured over ten thousand.

units.zh: 謝玄等又破苻堅于淝水，斬其弟融，堅大眾奔潰。
units.en: Feishui saw Fu Jian shattered—Rong died and the horde routed.
units.literal: Xie Xuan and others defeated Fu Jian at the Fei River, cut down his brother Rong, and his grand army fled in panic.

units.zh: 九年六月，皇太后褚氏崩。
units.en: In the sixth month of the ninth year Empress Dowager Chu died.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the ninth year Empress Dowager Chu died.

units.zh: 八月，謝玄出屯彭城，經略中州矣。
units.en: August Xie Xuan encamped at Pengcheng to reclaim the north.
units.literal: In the eighth month Xie Xuan advanced to camp at Pengcheng, planning the Central Plains.

units.zh: 九年七月丙戌，太白晝見。
units.en: On bingxu in the seventh month of the ninth year, Venus was seen by day.
units.literal: On bingxu in the seventh month of the ninth year the Great White was seen in daytime.

units.en: November dingsi repeated daylight Venus.
units.literal: On dingsi in the eleventh month it again appeared by day.

units.zh: 十年四月乙亥，又晝見於畢昴。
units.en: Tenth year April yihai daylight Venus in Mao.
units.literal: On yihai in the tenth year’s fourth month it again appeared by day in Mao and the Net.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The state of Wei will have war and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Wei will have armies and mourning.

units.zh: 是時苻堅大眾奔潰，趙魏連兵相攻，堅為姚萇所殺。
units.en: Fu Jian’s collapse unleashed northern warfare until Yao Chang killed him.
units.literal: At that time Fu Jian’s masses fled in defeat; Zhao and Wei exchanged blows; Fu Jian died at Yao Chang’s hands.

units.zh: 十一年三月戊申，太白晝見，在東井。
units.en: Eleventh year March wushen daylight Venus in the Well.
units.literal: On wushen in the eleventh year’s third month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Qin will have war, and ministers will be strong."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Qin will have troops; ministers grow powerful.

units.zh: 六月甲申，又晝見於輿鬼。
units.en: June jiashen daylight Venus in the Ghosts.
units.literal: On jiashen in the sixth month it again appeared by day in the Ghosts.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Qin will have war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Qin will have troops.

units.zh: 時魏、姚萇、苻登連兵，相征不息。
units.en: Wei, Yao Chang, and Fu Deng traded blows without respite.
units.literal: At that time Wei, Yao Chang, and Fu Deng continually campaigned against one another.

units.en: Jiawu daylight Jupiter in the Stomach.
units.literal: On jiawu the Year Star was seen in daytime in the Stomach.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Lu will have war, and ministers will be strong."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Lu will have troops; ministers grow powerful.

units.zh: 十二年，慕容垂寇東阿，翟遼寇河上，姚萇假號安定，苻登自立隴上，呂光竊據涼土。
units.en: In the twelfth year Murong Chui raided Dong’e, Zhai Liao struck the Yellow River, Yao Chang assumed a title at Anding, Fu Deng set himself up on Longshang, and Lü Guang seized Liang territory.
units.literal: In the twelfth year Murong Chui raided Dong’e, Zhai Liao struck the Yellow River, Yao Chang styled himself at Anding, Fu Deng rose on Longshang, and Lü Guang seized Liangzhou.

units.zh: 十二年六月癸卯，太白晝見，在柳。
units.en: Twelfth year June guimao daylight Venus in the Willow.
units.literal: On guimao in the twelfth year’s sixth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Willow.

units.zh: 十月庚午，太白晝見，在斗。
units.en: October gengwu daylight Venus in the Dipper.
units.literal: On gengwu in the tenth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Dipper.

units.zh: 十三年正月丙戌，又晝見。
units.en: Thirteenth year New Year bingxu daylight Venus.
units.literal: On bingxu in the thirteenth year’s first month it again appeared by day.

units.zh: 十二月，熒惑在角亢，形色猛盛。
units.en: December Mars glared in Horn and Neck.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Spark-Delight stood in Horn and Neck with fierce color and brilliance.

units.zh: 占曰：「熒惑失其常，吏且棄其法，諸侯亂其政。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "When Mars loses its norm, clerks will abandon their laws, and the feudal lords will disorder their governments."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When Spark-Delight loses its norm, clerks abandon law and feudatories disorder government.

units.zh: 自是後，慕容垂、翟遼、姚萇、苻登、慕容永並阻兵爭強。
units.en: Afterward Murong Chui, Zhai Liao, Yao Chang, Fu Deng, and Murong Yong barricaded troops and vied for supremacy.
units.literal: Afterward Murong Chui, Zhai Liao, Yao Chang, Fu Deng, Murong Yong barricaded troops and vied for supremacy.

units.zh: 十四年正月，彭城妖賊又稱號於皇丘，劉牢之破滅之。
units.en: In the first month of the fourteenth year the Pengcheng spirit-bandits again assumed titles at Huangqiu, and Liu Laozhi destroyed them.
units.literal: In the first month of the fourteenth year Pengcheng spirit-bandits styled themselves at Huangqiu until Liu Laozhi destroyed them.

units.zh: 三月，張道破合鄉，圍泰山，向欽之擊走之。
units.en: March Zhang Dao raided until Xiang Qinzhi repulsed him.
units.literal: In the third month Zhang Dao broke Hexiang, besieged Taishan, and Xiang Qinzhi drove him off.

units.zh: 是年，翟遼又攻沒滎陽，侵略陳項。
units.en: Zhai Liao repeated strikes on the Central Plain.
units.literal: That year Zhai Liao again seized Xingyang and raided Chen and Xiang.

units.zh: 于時政事多弊，君道陵遲矣。
units.en: Government rotted and royal virtue sank.
units.literal: At that time governance suffered many abuses and sovereign conduct declined.

units.zh: 十四年四月乙巳，太白晝見於柳。
units.en: Fourteenth year April yisi daylight Willow Venus.
units.literal: On yisi in the fourteenth year’s fourth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Willow.

units.en: June xinmao daylight Venus in Wings.
units.literal: On xinmao in the sixth month it again appeared by day in the Wings.

units.en: On bingyin in the ninth month Venus was visible in daylight in Zhen.
units.literal: On bingyin in the ninth month it again appeared by day in Zhen.

units.en: December Mars entered the palace guard stars.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Spark-Delight entered the Forbidden Guards.

units.en: Every gloss matched earlier readings.
units.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.

units.zh: 十五年，翟遼掠司兗，眾軍累討不克，慕容垂又跨略并、冀等州。
units.en: Year fifteen Zhai Liao ravaged the east even as Murong Chui swallowed Bing-Ji.
units.literal: In the fifteenth year Zhai Liao pillaged Si and Yanzhou; hosts repeatedly campaigned without victory while Murong Chui seized Bing and Ji.

units.en: July baked under drought.
units.literal: In the seventh month drought struck.

units.zh: 八月，諸郡大水，兗州又蝗。
units.en: August floods and Yanzhou locusts compounded misery.
units.literal: In the eighth month commanderies flooded while Yanzhou suffered locusts.

units.zh: 十五年九月癸未，熒惑入太微。
units.en: Fifteenth year September guiwei Mars entered the Supreme Palace.
units.literal: On guiwei in the ninth month of the fifteenth year Spark-Delight entered the Supreme Palace.

units.en: October Venus entered the Forbidden Guards.
units.literal: In the tenth month the Great White entered the Forbidden Guards.

units.zh: 十六年四月癸卯朔，太白晝見。
units.en: Sixteenth year fourth month new moon guimao daylight Venus.
units.literal: On guimao new moon in the sixteenth year’s fourth month the Great White was seen in daytime.

units.zh: 十一月癸巳，月奄心前星。
units.en: November guisi occulted the Heart’s leading star.
units.literal: On guisi in the eleventh month the Moon occulted the forward star of the Heart.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The crown prince will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The heir apparent will suffer.

units.en: The heir lay chronically ill.
units.literal: At that time the heir apparent continually suffered grave illness.

units.zh: 十七年七月丁丑，太白晝見。
units.en: Seventeenth year July dingchou daylight Venus.
units.literal: On dingchou in the seventh month of the seventeenth year the Great White was seen in daytime.

units.en: October dingyou repeated daylight Venus.
units.literal: On dingyou in the tenth month it again appeared by day.

units.en: Eighteenth year June daylight Venus returned.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the eighteenth year it again appeared by day.

units.zh: 十九年五月，又晝見於柳。
units.en: Nineteenth year May daylight Venus in the Willow.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the nineteenth year it again appeared by day in the Willow.

units.zh: 六月辛酉，又晝見於輿鬼。
units.en: June xinyou daylight Venus in the Ghosts.
units.literal: On xinyou in the sixth month it again appeared by day in the Ghosts.

units.en: In the ninth month it again appeared in Zhen.
units.literal: In the ninth month it again appeared in Zhen.

units.zh: 二十年六年，熒惑入天囷。
units.en: Twentieth year sixth month Mars entered Celestial Granary.
units.literal: In the twentieth year’s sixth month Spark-Delight entered Celestial Granary.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be great famine."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great famine.

units.zh: 七月丁亥，太白晝見，在太微。
units.en: July dinghai daylight Venus inside the Supreme Palace.
units.literal: On dinghai in the seventh month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Supreme Palace.

units.zh: 占曰：「太白入太微，國有憂。
units.en: The prognostication said, "When Venus enters the Supreme Palace, the state will have anxiety.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When the Great White enters the Supreme Palace the state has sorrow.

units.en: Appearing by day means war and mourning."
units.literal: Appearance by daylight means armies and mourning.

units.zh: 十二月己巳，月犯楗閉及東西咸。
units.en: December jisi crossed Key-and-Bolt and the Harm stars.
units.literal: On jisi in the twelfth month the Moon transgressed Key-and-Bolt and Eastern and Western Harm.

units.zh: 占曰：「楗閉司心腹喉舌，東西咸主陰謀。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "Key-and-Bolt oversees the heart, belly, throat, and tongue; east and west both govern hidden plots."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Key-and-Bolt governs heart-and-belly and throat-and-tongue; Eastern and Western Harm govern secret plots.

units.zh: 二十一年二月壬申，太白晝見。
units.en: Twenty-first year February renshen daylight Venus.
units.literal: On renshen in the second month of the twenty-first year the Great White was seen in daytime.

units.zh: 三月癸卯，太白連晝見，在羽林。
units.en: March guimao prolonged daylight Venus in the Forbidden Guards.
units.literal: On guimao in the third month the Great White remained visible by day in the Forbidden Guards.

units.zh: 占曰：「有強臣，有兵喪，中軍兵起。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be strong ministers, war and mourning, and the central army will arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be overpowerful ministers, armies and mourning, and central-army mutiny.

units.en: March daylight Venus in the Stomach.
units.literal: In the third month the Great White was seen by day in the Stomach.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The central army will arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Central-army troops will arise.

units.en: April renwu Venus entered Celestial Granary.
units.literal: On renwu in the fourth month the Great White entered Celestial Granary.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means famine."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be famine.

units.en: June Jupiter crossed the Weepers.
units.literal: In the sixth month the Year Star transgressed the Weeping Stars.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be an occasion of weeping."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be occasions for weeping.

units.en: The emperor died that September.
units.literal: That ninth month the emperor died.

units.zh: 隆安元年，王恭等舉兵脅朝廷，於是內外戒嚴，殺王國寶以謝之。
units.en: Long’an 1 Wang Gong’s coercion forced executions including Wang Guobao.
units.literal: In Long’an 1 Wang Gong and others raised troops against the court; interior and exterior armed while Wang Guobao was executed as apology.

units.zh: 又連歲水旱，三方動，眾人饑。
units.en: Successive disasters and famine convulsed the realm.
units.literal: Floods and droughts struck year after year; three fronts stirred and multitudes starved.

units.zh: 安帝隆安元年正月癸亥，熒惑犯哭泣星。
units.en: Emperor An’s Long’an 1 New Year guihai Mars crossed the Weepers.
units.literal: On guihai in the first month of Emperor An’s Long’an 1 Spark-Delight transgressed the Weeping Stars.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be an occasion of weeping."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be occasions for weeping.

units.zh: 四月丁丑，太白晝見，在東井。
units.en: April dingchou daylight Venus in the Well.
units.literal: On dingchou in the fourth month the Great White was seen in daytime in the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Qin will have war and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Qin will have armies and mourning.

units.zh: 六月，姚興攻洛陽，郗恢遣兵救之。
units.en: June Yao Xing besieged Luoyang; Xi Hui sent aid.
units.literal: In the sixth month Yao Xing attacked Luoyang and Xi Hui dispatched relief troops.

units.en: That winter Yao Chang died; his son Zilüe succeeded.
units.literal: That winter Yao Chang died; his son Zilüe succeeded.

units.en: Prince of Wei Gui assumed the throne at Zhongshan.
units.literal: Prince Wei Gui assumed kingship at Zhongshan.

units.en: August Mars stationed on the Well axe.
units.literal: That eighth month Spark-Delight guarded the Well’s Battle-Axe.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Great ministers will be executed."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great ministers will be executed.

units.zh: 二年六月戊辰，攝提移度失常。
units.en: Second year June wuchen saw Sheti astride unusual motion.
units.literal: On wuchen in the sixth month of the second year Sheti shifted irregularly.

units.zh: 歲星晝見，在胃，兗州分野。
units.en: Daylight Jupiter in Stomach matched Yanzhou.
units.literal: The Year Star appeared by day in the Stomach—Yanzhou’s field.

units.zh: 是年六月，郗恢遣鄭啟方等以萬人伐慕容寶於滑臺，敗而還。
units.en: That June Xi Hui sent Zheng Qifang and others with ten thousand troops against Murong Bao at Huatai, and they returned defeated.
units.literal: That June Xi Hui sent Zheng Qifang with ten thousand troops against Murong Bao at Huatai and returned defeated.
