units.en: Leap month daylight Venus in palace guards.
units.literal: Intercalary month daylight Venus shone in the Forbidden Guards.

units.en: Dingchou crossed the eastern Upper Minister.
units.literal: On dingchou the Moon transgressed the eastern Upper Minister.

units.zh: 三年五月辛酉，月又奄東上相。
units.en: Third year fifth month xinyou occulted the eastern Upper Minister.
units.literal: On xinyou in the fifth month of the third year the Moon again occulted the eastern Upper Minister.

units.en: Xinwei Mercury crossed Regulus.
units.literal: On xinwei the Dawn Star transgressed the great star of the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: Same glosses as above.
units.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.

units.zh: 二年九月，庾楷等舉兵，表誅王愉等，於是內外戒嚴。
units.en: Yu Kai demanded Wang Yu’s head and triggered mobilization.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the second year Yu Kai and others rose in arms memorializing execution of Wang Yu; court and camp mobilized.

units.en: Luoyang collapsed to raiders in June year three.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the third year Luoyang fell to bandits.

units.zh: 桓玄破荊州，雍州殺殷仲堪等。
units.en: Huan Xuan seized Jingzhou, and Yongzhou killed Yin Zhongkan and others.
units.literal: Huan Xuan seized Jingzhou while Yongzhou executed Yin Zhongkan and others.

units.zh: 孫恩聚眾攻沒會稽，殺內史。
units.en: Sun En took Kuaiji and slew its governor.
units.literal: Sun En gathered hosts, seized Kuaiji, and killed the interior governor.

units.zh: 四年六月辛酉，月犯哭泣星。
units.en: Fourth year June xinyou lunar Weepers transit.
units.literal: On xinyou in the sixth month of the fourth year the Moon transgressed the Weeping Stars.

units.en: Fifth year New Year daylight Venus.
units.literal: In the fifth year’s first month the Great White was seen in daytime.

units.zh: 自去年十二月在斗晝見，至於是月乙卯。
units.en: Daylight Venus lingered in the Dipper from last December through this yimao.
units.literal: From the twelfth month of the previous year it had been visible by day in the Dipper until yimao of this month.

units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "The disaster is in Wu-Yue."
units.literal: Investigating the gloss: “Calamity lies in Wu and Yue.

units.zh: 七月癸亥，大角星散搖五色。
units.en: July guihai saw Arcturus flare in five hues.
units.literal: On guihai in the seventh month the Great Horn star scattered, flickering in five colors.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The king will scatter and go into exile."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The king will be scattered and lost.

units.en: Dingmao crossed Celestial Pass.
units.literal: On dingmao the Moon transgressed Celestial Pass.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The king will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The king will suffer.

units.zh: 九月庚子，熒惑犯少微，又守之。
units.en: September gengzi Mars hit and camped on Lesser Office.
units.literal: On gengzi in the ninth month Spark-Delight transgressed and then stationed at Lesser Office.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Unappointed scholars will be executed."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Recluses will be executed.

units.en: October jiazi crossed the eastern Secondary Minister.
units.literal: On jiazi in the tenth month the Moon transgressed the eastern Secondary Minister.

units.zh: 其年七月，太皇太后李氏崩。
units.en: That seventh month Grand Empress Dowager Li died.
units.literal: That seventh month Grand Empress Dowager Li died.

units.zh: 十月，妖賊大破高雅之于餘姚，死者十七八。
units.en: October bandits annihilated Gao Yazhi at Yuyao.
units.literal: In the tenth month spirit-bandits shattered Gao Yazhi at Yuyao with seventy or eighty percent casualties.

units.zh: 五年，孫恩攻侵郡縣，殺內史，至京口，進軍蒲洲，於是內外戒嚴。
units.en: Sun En’s fifth-year raids threatened Jiankang.
units.literal: In the fifth year Sun En attacked districts, slew governors, reached Jingkou, advanced to Pu Isle—court and camp armed anew.

units.zh: 恩遣別將攻廣陵，殺三千餘人，退據郁洲，是時劉裕又追破之。
units.en: En sent another general to attack Guangling, killing more than three thousand, then withdrew to Yu Isle, at which time Liu Yu again pursued and defeated him.
units.literal: En sent another column against Guangling, killing three thousand, then retreated to Yu Isle while Liu Yu routed him.

units.zh: 九月，桓玄表至，逆旨陵上。
units.en: September Huan Xuan’s arrogant memorial insulted the throne.
units.literal: In the ninth month Huan Xuan’s memorial arrived contrary and arrogant.

units.zh: 十月，司馬元顯大治水軍，將以伐玄。
units.en: In the tenth month Sima Yuanxian built a large river fleet intending to attack Xuan.
units.literal: In the tenth month Sima Yuanxian built river fleets to strike Xuan.

units.zh: 元興元年正月，盧循自稱征虜將軍，領孫恩餘眾，略有永嘉、晉安之地。
units.en: Yuanxing 1 Lu Xun claimed generalship over Sun En’s followers and carved out the Zhejiang coast.
units.literal: In the first month of Yuanxing 1 Lu Xun styled himself General Who Conquers Caitiffs, leading Sun En’s remnant bands to hold Yongjia and Jin’an.

units.en: The emperor donned armor for western expedition.
units.literal: In the second month the emperor in martial dress dispatched western armies.

units.zh: 三月，桓玄，克京都，殺司馬元顯，放太傅會稽王道子。
units.en: In the third month Huan Xuan took the capital, killed Sima Yuanxian, and banished Grand Tutor Prince of Kuaiji Daozi.
units.literal: In the third month Huan Xuan took the capital, executed Sima Yuanxian, and banished Grand Tutor Prince Kuaiji Daozi.

units.zh: 元興元年三月戊子，太白犯五諸侯，因晝見。
units.en: Yuanxing 1 March wuzi Venus crossed Five Feudatories by daylight.
units.literal: On wuzi in the third month of Yuanxing 1 the Great White transgressed the Five Feudatories and thereby appeared by day.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Feudal lords will be executed."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Among feudatories some will be executed.

units.en: July wuyin Mars stood in the Well.
units.literal: On wuyin in the seventh month Spark-Delight stood in the Eastern Well.

units.en: Mars crossed Ghosts and corpse-stars.
units.literal: Spark-Delight transgressed the Ghosts and the heaped corpses.

units.en: Same gloss as earlier.
units.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.

units.zh: 八月丙寅，太白奄右執法。
units.en: On bingyin in the eighth month Venus occulted the Right Enforcer.
units.literal: On bingyin in the eighth month the Great White occulted the Right Enforcer.

units.en: September guiwei Venus crossed Advancing Worthies.
units.literal: On guiwei in the ninth month the Great White transgressed Advancing Worthies.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Those who advance worthies will be executed."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Those recommended as worthies will be executed.

units.zh: 二年二月，歲星犯西上將。
units.en: Year two February Jupiter crossed western Upper First Minister.
units.literal: In the second month of the second year the Year Star transgressed the western Upper First Minister.

units.zh: 六月甲辰，月奄斗第四星。
units.en: On jiachen in the sixth month the Moon occulted the Dipper’s fourth star.
units.literal: On jiachen in the sixth month the Moon occulted the Dipper’s fourth star.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Great ministers will be executed within no more than three years."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great ministers will be executed within three years.

units.zh: 八月癸丑，太白犯房北第二星。
units.en: August guichou Venus crossed Room’s second northern star.
units.literal: On guichou in the eighth month the Great White transgressed the second northern star of Room.

units.zh: 九月己丑，歲星犯進賢，熒惑犯西上將。
units.en: September jichou Jupiter and Mars struck ministerial stars.
units.literal: On jichou in the ninth month the Year Star transgressed Advancing Worthies while Spark-Delight transgressed the western Upper First Minister.

units.en: October jiaxu Venus crossed the Weeper.
units.literal: On jiaxu in the tenth month the Great White transgressed the Weeping star.

units.zh: 十一月丁酉，熒惑犯東上相。
units.en: November dingyou Mars crossed eastern Upper Minister.
units.literal: On dingyou in the eleventh month Spark-Delight transgressed the eastern Upper Minister.

units.zh: 十二月乙巳，月奄軒轅第二星。
units.en: December yisi occulted Regulus’ companion.
units.literal: On yisi in the twelfth month the Moon occulted the second star of the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: All glosses matched prior entries.
units.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.

units.en: Winter saw Wei rout Yao Xing.
units.literal: That winter Wei shattered Yao Xing’s army.

units.zh: 二年十二月，桓玄篡位，放遷帝、後於尋陽，以永安何皇后為零陵君。
units.en: In the twelfth month of the second year Huan Xuan usurped the throne, banished the emperor and empress to Xunyang, and made Yong'an Empress He the Lady of Lingling.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year Huan Xuan usurped the throne, banished emperor and empress to Xunyang, and reduced Empress He to Lady of Lingling.

units.zh: 三年二月，劉裕盡誅桓氏。
units.en: In the second month of the third year Liu Yu wiped out the Huan clan.
units.literal: In the second month of the third year Liu Yu extirpated the Huan clan.

units.zh: 三年正月戊戌，熒惑逆行，犯太微西上相。
units.en: On wuxu in the first month of the third year retrograde Mars crossed the western Upper First Minister.
units.literal: On wuxu in the first month of the third year Spark-Delight retrograded and transgressed the Supreme Palace’s western Upper First Minister.

units.zh: 占曰：「天子戰于野，上相死。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "The Son of Heaven battles in the wilds, and the Upper Minister dies."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Son of Heaven battles in the field; the upper minister dies.

units.zh: 二月丙辰，熒惑逆行，在左執法西北。
units.en: February bingchen retrograde Mars lingered by Left Enforcer.
units.literal: On bingchen in the second month Spark-Delight retrograded northwest of the Left Enforcer.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Those who enforce the law will be executed."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Those holding enforcement offices will be executed.

units.zh: 四月甲午，月奄軒轅第二星。
units.en: On jiawu in the fourth month the Moon occulted the second star of Xuanyuan.
units.literal: On jiawu in the fourth month the Moon occulted the second star of the Chariot Shaft.

units.zh: 五月壬申，月奄斗第二星，填星入羽林。
units.en: May renshen moon occulted Dipper while Saturn entered palace guards.
units.literal: On renshen in the fifth month the Moon occulted the Dipper’s second star while the Station Star entered the Forbidden Guards.

units.en: Same readings as above.
units.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.

units.zh: 是年二月丙辰，劉裕殺桓修等。
units.en: Bingchen that February Liu Yu slew Huan Xiu.
units.literal: That second month’s bingchen Liu Yu executed Huan Xiu and others.

units.zh: 三月己末，破走桓玄，遣軍西討。
units.en: March jiwei defeated Xuan and opened western campaign.
units.literal: On jiwei in the third month he routed Huan Xuan and sent armies west.

units.zh: 辛巳，誅左僕射王愉，桓玄劫天子如江陵。
units.en: Xinsi killed Wang Yu even as Xuan dragged the emperor west.
units.literal: On xinsi he executed Left Deputy Director Wang Yu while Huan Xuan seized the emperor toward Jiangling.

units.zh: 五月，玄下至崢嶸洲，義軍破滅之。
units.en: May Zhengrong Isle destroyed Xuan.
units.literal: In the fifth month Xuan descended to Zhengrong Isle where loyalists annihilated him.

units.zh: 桓振又攻沒江陵，幽劫天子。
units.en: Huan Zhen retook Jiangling and held the emperor hostage.
units.literal: Huan Zhen again seized Jiangling and imprisoned the emperor.

units.en: In the seventh month Yong'an Empress He died.
units.literal: In the seventh month Empress Yong’an He died.

units.zh: 義熙元年三月壬辰，月奄左執法。
units.en: On renchen in the third month of Yixi 1 the Moon occulted the Left Enforcer.
units.literal: On renchen in the third month of Yixi 1 the Moon occulted the Left Enforcer.

units.en: Same gloss as above.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.en: Dingyou occulted the Heart’s front star.
units.literal: On dingyou the Moon occulted the forward star of the Heart.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Yuzhou will have disaster."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Yu Province will suffer disaster.

units.en: Venus crossed the Eastern Well.
units.literal: The Great White transgressed the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Qin will have war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Qin will have troops.

units.zh: 七月庚辰，太白晝見，在翼、軫。
units.en: July gengchen daylight Venus in Wings and Chariot.
units.literal: On gengchen in the seventh month the Great White was seen in daytime in Wings and Chariot.

units.zh: 占曰：「為臣強，荊州有兵喪。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "It means ministers are strong, and Jingzhou will have war and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Ministers grow powerful; Jingzhou will have armies and mourning.

units.zh: 八月丁巳，月犯斗第一星。
units.en: August dingsi crossed the Dipper’s first star.
units.literal: On dingsi in the eighth month the Moon transgressed the first star of the Dipper.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be war under Heaven."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Under Heaven there will be troops.

units.en: One reading said, "Great ministers will have anxiety."
units.literal: Another saying: “Great ministers will suffer.

units.en: September jiazi Mars crossed Lesser Office.
units.literal: On jiazi in the ninth month Spark-Delight transgressed Lesser Office.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Unappointed scholars will be executed."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Recluses will be executed.

units.en: Gengyin Mars hit the Right Enforcer.
units.literal: On gengyin Spark-Delight transgressed the Right Enforcer.

units.en: Guimao Mars hit the Left Enforcer.
units.literal: On guimao Spark-Delight transgressed the Left Enforcer.

units.en: Same readings as earlier.
units.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.

units.zh: 十一月丙戌，太白犯鉤鈐。
units.en: November bingxu Venus crossed Hook-and-Hasp.
units.literal: On bingxu in the eleventh month the Great White transgressed Hook-and-Hasp.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The throat and tongue will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Throat-and-tongue ministers will suffer.

units.zh: 十二月己卯，歲星犯天江。
units.en: December jimao Jupiter crossed Celestial River.
units.literal: On jimao in the twelfth month the Year Star transgressed Celestial River.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be war and disorder, and river crossings will not be passable."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be martial turmoil; river fords will not open.

units.zh: 十一月，荊州刺史魏詠之薨。
units.en: In the eleventh month Inspector of Jingzhou Wei Yongzhi died.
units.literal: In the eleventh month Inspector of Jingzhou Wei Yongzhi died.

units.zh: 二年二月，司馬國璠等攻沒弋陽。
units.en: In the second month of year two Sima Guofan and others captured Yiyang.
units.literal: In the second month of the second year Sima Guofan and others captured Yiyang.

units.zh: 四月，姚興伐仇池公楊盛，擊走之。
units.en: April Yao Xing struck Yang Sheng at Qiuchi.
units.literal: In the fourth month Yao Xing campaigned against Duke Yang Sheng of Qiuchi and drove him off.

units.zh: 九月，益州刺史司馬榮期為其參軍楊承祖所害。
units.en: In the ninth month Inspector of Yizhou Sima Rongqi was murdered by his adjutant Yang Chengzu.
units.literal: In the ninth month Inspector of Yizhou Sima Rongqi was murdered by his adjutant Yang Chengzu.

units.zh: 三年十二月，司徒揚州刺史王謐薨。
units.en: Third year December Wang Mi died.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the third year Minister of Education and Inspector of Yangzhou Wang Mi died.

units.zh: 四年正月，太保武陵王遵薨。
units.en: Fourth year New Year Prince Zun of Wuling died.
units.literal: In the first month of the fourth year Grand Guardian Prince Wuling Zun died.

units.en: March Kong Anguo passed away.
units.literal: In the third month Left Deputy Director Kong Anguo died.

units.zh: 自後政在劉裕，人主端拱而已。
units.en: Liu Yu ruled; the emperor was a figurehead.
units.literal: Thereafter power lay with Liu Yu while the sovereign sat hands folded.

units.en: Second year February Venus crossed the Dipper.
units.literal: In the second month of the second year the Great White transgressed the Southern Dipper.

units.en: The prognostication said, "War will arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Arms will arise.

units.en: Jichou crossed the Heart’s rear star.
units.literal: On jichou the Moon transgressed the rear star of the Heart.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Yuzhou will have disaster."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Yu Province will suffer disaster.

units.zh: 四月癸丑，月犯太微西上將。
units.en: April guichou crossed western Upper First Minister.
units.literal: On guichou in the fourth month the Moon transgressed the Supreme Palace’s western Upper First Minister.

units.en: Jiwei crossed Room’s second southern star.
units.literal: On jiwei the Moon transgressed the second southern star of Room.

units.en: Yichou Jupiter crossed Celestial River.
units.literal: On yichou the Year Star transgressed Celestial River.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be war and disorder, and river crossings will not be passable."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be martial turmoil; river fords will not open.

units.en: May guiwei crossed the Horn’s left spike.
units.literal: On guiwei in the fifth month the Moon transgressed the left horn.

units.zh: 占曰：「左將軍死，天下有兵。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "The Left General will die, and there will be war under Heaven."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The general of the left will die; under Heaven there will be troops.

units.en: Renyin Mars crossed the Base.
units.literal: On renyin Spark-Delight transgressed the Base.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Base is the lodging palace; the ruler of men will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Base is the lodging palace; the ruler will suffer.

units.zh: 六月庚午，熒惑犯房北第二星。
units.en: June gengwu Mars crossed Room’s second northern star.
units.literal: On gengwu in the sixth month Spark-Delight transgressed the second northern star of Room.

units.zh: 八月癸亥，熒惑犯南斗第五星。
units.en: August guihai Mars crossed the Dipper’s fifth star.
units.literal: On guihai in the eighth month Spark-Delight transgressed the fifth star of the Southern Dipper.

units.en: Dingsi crossed Establishment.
units.literal: On dingsi it transgressed the Establishment Stars.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be troops.

units.zh: 九月壬午，熒惑犯哭星，又犯泣星。
units.en: September renwu Mars crossed Weeper and Tear.
units.literal: On renwu in the ninth month Spark-Delight transgressed the Weeping Stars and again the Tear Stars.

units.zh: 是年二月甲戌，司馬國璠等攻沒弋陽。
units.en: Jiaxu that February saw another Yiyang coup.
units.literal: That second month’s jiaxu Sima Guofan and others captured Yiyang.

units.zh: 又，慕容超侵略徐、兗，三年正月，又寇北徐州，至下邳。
units.en: Murong Chao raided Xu and Yan; in the first month of the third year he again struck northern Xuzhou as far as Xiapi.
units.literal: Moreover Murong Chao raided Xu and Yan; in the third year’s first month he struck northern Xuzhou down to Xiapi.

units.en: December Wang Mi died.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Minister of Education Wang Mi died.

units.en: Fourth year New Year Prince Zun died.
units.literal: In the first month of the fourth year Prince Zun of Wuling died.

units.en: In the fifth year Murong Chao again raided north of the Huai.
units.literal: In the fifth year Murong Chao again raided north of the Huai.

units.zh: 四月，劉裕大軍討之，拔臨朐。
units.en: April Liu Yu seized Linqu.
units.literal: In the fourth month Liu Yu’s grand army campaigned against him and took Linqu.

units.en: Guanggu fell after siege.
units.literal: He then besieged Guanggu and captured it.

units.zh: 三年正月丙子，太白晝見，在奎。
units.en: Third year New Year bingzi daylight Venus in Striding Legs.
units.literal: On bingzi in the first month of the third year the Great White was seen in daytime in the Striding Legs.

units.en: February gengshen occulted the Heart’s rear star.
units.literal: On gengshen in the second month the Moon occulted the rear star of the Heart.

units.en: Same gloss.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.en: May guiwei crossed left Horn.
units.literal: On guiwei in the fifth month the Moon transgressed the left horn.

units.en: Jichou daylight Venus in Orion.
units.literal: On jichou the Great White was seen in daytime in the Triaster.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Yizhou will have war and mourning, and ministers will be strong."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Yizhou will have armies and mourning; ministers grow powerful.

units.zh: 八月己卯，太白犯左執法。
units.en: August jimao Venus crossed Left Enforcer.
units.literal: On jimao in the eighth month the Great White transgressed the Left Enforcer.

units.en: Xinmao Mars crossed Left Enforcer.
units.literal: On xinmao Spark-Delight transgressed the Left Enforcer.

units.zh: 九月壬子，熒惑犯進賢星。
units.en: September renzi Mars crossed Advancing Worthies.
units.literal: On renzi in the ninth month Spark-Delight transgressed Advancing Worthies.

units.zh: 是年八月，劉敬宣伐蜀，不克而旋。
units.en: Liu Jingxuan’s Shu expedition failed.
units.literal: That August Liu Jingxuan campaigned against Shu without success and withdrew.

units.zh: 四年三月，左僕射孔安國卒。
units.en: In the third month of the fourth year, Left Deputy Director Kong Anguo died.
units.literal: In the third month of the fourth year Left Deputy Director Kong Anguo died.

units.zh: 七月，司馬叔璠等攻沒鄒山，魯郡太守徐邕破走之。
units.en: In the seventh month Sima Shufan and others seized Zou Mountain until Lu Commandery prefect Xu Yin drove them off.
units.literal: In the seventh month Sima Shufan and others seized Zou Mountain until Lu Commandery prefect Xu Yin drove them off.

units.zh: 姚略遣眾征赫連勃勃，大為所破。
units.en: Yao Lue’s strike on Helian Bobo collapsed.
units.literal: Yao Lue dispatched troops against Helian Bobo and suffered crushing defeat.

units.zh: 五年，劉裕討慕容超，滅之。
units.en: Year five Liu Yu extinguished Murong Chao.
units.literal: In the fifth year Liu Yu campaigned against Murong Chao and destroyed him.

units.zh: 四年正月庚子，熒惑犯天關。
units.en: Fourth year New Year gengzi Mars crossed Celestial Pass.
units.literal: On gengzi in the first month of the fourth year Spark-Delight transgressed Celestial Pass.

units.zh: 五月丁未，月奄斗第二星。
units.en: May dingwei occulted second Dipper star.
units.literal: On dingwei in the fifth month the Moon occulted the Dipper’s second star.

units.en: Renzi Saturn crossed Celestial Granary.
units.literal: On renzi the Station Star transgressed Celestial Granary.

units.en: The prognostication said, "All under Heaven will have famine, and granary grain will be scarce."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Under Heaven will starve; granaries run low.

units.zh: 六月己丑，太白犯太微西上將。
units.en: June jichou Venus crossed western Upper First Minister.
units.literal: On jichou in the sixth month the Great White transgressed the Supreme Palace’s western Upper First Minister.

units.en: Yimao repeated strike on Left Enforcer.
units.literal: On yimao it again transgressed the Left Enforcer.

units.en: October wuzi Mars entered Forbidden Guards.
units.literal: On wuzi in the tenth month Spark-Delight entered the Forbidden Guards.

units.en: Same readings.
units.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.

units.zh: 五年，劉裕討慕容超，後南北軍旅運轉不息。
units.en: Year five Liu Yu’s war kept supply lines endless.
units.literal: In the fifth year Liu Yu campaigned against Murong Chao; afterward north–south convoys never rested.

units.en: Fifth year February jiazi crossed Mao.
units.literal: On jiazi in the fifth year’s second month the Moon transgressed the Hairy Head.

units.zh: 占曰：「胡不安，天子破匈奴。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "The Hu will be unsettled, and the Son of Heaven will defeat the Xiongnu."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Hu will be restless; the Son of Heaven will defeat the Xiongnu.

units.en: May wuxu Jupiter entered Forbidden Guards.
units.literal: On wuxu in the fifth month the Year Star entered the Forbidden Guards.

units.en: September renyin crossed Mao.
units.literal: On renyin in the ninth month the Moon transgressed the Hairy Head.

units.en: October Mars crossed Base.
units.literal: In the tenth month Spark-Delight transgressed the Base.

units.en: Leap month dingyou crossed Mao.
units.literal: On dingyou in the intercalary month the Moon transgressed the Hairy Head.

units.en: Xinhai Mars crossed Hook-and-Hasp.
units.literal: On xinhai Spark-Delight transgressed Hook-and-Hasp.

units.en: Jisi occulted Antares.
units.literal: On jisi the Moon occulted the great star of the Heart.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The king hates it."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The king finds it ill-omened.

units.zh: 是年四月，劉裕討慕容超。
units.en: April Liu Yu marched on Murong Chao.
units.literal: That fourth month Liu Yu campaigned against Murong Chao.

units.en: October Tuoba Gui died by assassination.
units.literal: In the tenth month Prince Wei Gui was assassinated.

units.zh: 六年五月，盧循逼郊甸，宮衛被甲。
units.en: Lu Xun threatened the capital fringe in year six.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the sixth year Lu Xun pressed the suburbs; palace guards donned armor.

units.zh: 六年三月丁卯，月奄房南第二星。
units.en: Sixth year March dingmao occulted Room’s second southern star.
units.literal: On dingmao in the third month of the sixth year the Moon occulted the second southern star of Room.

units.en: The omen impinges on the second minister, not the chief.
units.literal: The disaster falls on the secondary minister.

units.en: Jisi occulted fifth Dipper star.
units.literal: On jisi it again occulted the Dipper’s fifth star.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Dipper governs Wu, and war will arise in Wu territory."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Dipper governs Wu; Wu lands will raise troops.

units.en: Venus crossed Five Feudatories.
units.literal: The Great White transgressed the Five Feudatories.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Feudal lords will be executed."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Among feudatories some will be executed.

units.zh: 五月甲子，月奄斗第五星。
units.en: May jiazi occulted fifth Dipper.
units.literal: On jiazi in the fifth month the Moon occulted the Dipper’s fifth star.

units.en: Jihai occulted Mao’s third star.
units.literal: On jihai the Moon occulted the third star of the Hairy Head.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The state will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The state will have sorrow.

units.en: One reading said, "There will be a gathering in white garments."
units.literal: Another saying: “There will be a gathering in white.

units.zh: 六月己丑，月犯房南第二星。
units.en: June jichou crossed Room.
units.literal: On jichou in the sixth month the Moon transgressed the second southern star of Room.

units.en: Jiawu daylight Venus.
units.literal: On jiawu the Great White was seen in daytime.

units.en: July jihai crossed the Ghosts.
units.literal: On jihai in the seventh month the Moon transgressed the Ghosts.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The state will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The state will have sorrow.

units.en: One reading said, "Qin will have war."
units.literal: Another saying: “Qin will have troops.

units.zh: 八月壬午，太白犯軒轅大星。
units.en: August renwu Venus crossed Regulus.
units.literal: On renwu in the eighth month the Great White transgressed the great star of the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: Jiashen crossed the Heart’s forward star.
units.literal: On jiashen the Moon transgressed the forward star of the Heart.

units.en: The sign centers on Yu Province.
units.literal: Calamity lies in Yu Province.

units.en: Bingxu crossed fifth Dipper.
units.literal: On bingxu the Moon transgressed the Dipper’s fifth star.

units.en: Same gloss.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.en: Dinghai occulted Ox’s south star.
units.literal: On dinghai the Moon occulted the southern star of the Ox.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be great execution under Heaven."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Under Heaven great executions will occur.

units.en: Yiwei Venus crossed Lesser Office.
units.literal: On yiwei the Great White transgressed Lesser Office.

units.zh: 丙午，太白在少微而晝見。
units.en: Bingwu Venus lingered in Lesser Office by daylight.
units.literal: On bingwu the Great White stood in Lesser Office and appeared by day.

units.zh: 九月甲寅，太白犯左執法。
units.en: September jiayin Venus crossed Left Enforcer.
units.literal: On jiayin in the ninth month the Great White transgressed the Left Enforcer.

units.en: Dingchou Saturn crossed the Net.
units.literal: On dingchou the Station Star transgressed the Net.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be frontier war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be frontier troops.

units.zh: 是年三月，始興太守徐道覆反。
units.en: March Xu Daofu rose at Shixing.
units.literal: That third month Defender of Shixing Xu Daofu rebelled.

units.zh: 四月，盧循寇湘中，沒巴陵，率眾逼京畿。
units.en: April Lu Xun threatened Jiankang.
units.literal: In the fourth month Lu Xun raided Xiang middle lands, seized Baling, and drove toward the capital.

units.zh: 是月，左僕射孟昶懼王威不振，仰藥自殺。
units.en: Meng Chang committed suicide.
units.literal: That month Left Deputy Director Meng Chang feared royal prestige failing and swallowed poison.

units.zh: 七年十二月，劉蕃梟徐道覆首，杜慧度斬盧循，並傳首京都。
units.en: Year seven Liu Fan and Du Huidu ended the rebellion.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the seventh year Liu Fan displayed Xu Daofu’s head while Du Huidu executed Lu Xun and sent heads to the capital.

units.zh: 八年六月，劉道規卒，時為豫州刺史。
units.en: June year eight Liu Daogui died as Yuzhou inspector.
units.literal: In the eighth year’s sixth month Liu Daogui died while holding Yuzhou.

units.en: In the eighth month Empress Wang died.
units.literal: In the eighth month Empress Wang died.

units.zh: 九月，兗州刺史劉蕃、尚書左僕射謝混伏誅。
units.en: September Liu Fan and Xie Hun died.
units.literal: In the ninth month Inspector of Yanzhou Liu Fan and Left Deputy Director Xie Hun were executed.

units.zh: 劉裕西討劉毅，斬首徇之。
units.en: Liu Yu crushed Liu Yi.
units.literal: Liu Yu westward attacked Liu Yi and exposed his severed head.

units.zh: 十二月，遣益州刺史朱齡石伐蜀。
units.en: December Zhu Lingshi marched on Shu.
units.literal: In the twelfth month he dispatched Inspector of Yizhou Zhu Lingshi to conquer Shu.

units.zh: 七年四月辛丑，熒惑入輿鬼。
units.en: Seventh year fourth month xinchou Mars entered Ghosts.
units.literal: On xinchou in the fourth month of the seventh year Spark-Delight entered the Ghosts.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Qin will have war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Qin will have troops.

units.en: One reading said, "Yongzhou will have disaster."
units.literal: Another saying: “Yongzhou will suffer disaster.

units.en: June daylight Venus in Wings.
units.literal: In the sixth month the Great White was seen in daytime in Wings.

units.en: Jihai Saturn crossed Celestial Pass.
units.literal: On jihai the Station Star transgressed Celestial Pass.

units.en: The prognostication said, "A minister plots against the ruler."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Ministers plot against their lord.

units.zh: 八月，太白犯房南第二星。
units.en: August Venus crossed Room.
units.literal: In the eighth month the Great White transgressed the second southern star of Room.

units.zh: 十一月丙子，太白犯哭星。
units.en: November bingzi Venus crossed Weepers.
units.literal: On bingzi in the eleventh month the Great White transgressed the Weeping Stars.

units.en: July Zhu Lingshi took Shu.
units.literal: That seventh month Zhu Lingshi conquered Shu.

units.en: Shu rebelled again and was exterminated.
units.literal: Shu rebelled again and was exterminated.

units.zh: 八年七月癸亥，月奄房北第二星。
units.en: On guihai in the eighth year’s seventh month the Moon occulted the second northern star of Room.
units.literal: On guihai in the eighth year’s seventh month the Moon occulted the second northern star of Room.

units.en: Jiwei crossed Well axe.
units.literal: On jiwei the Moon transgressed the Well’s Battle-Axe.

units.en: August wushen crossed Weepers.
units.literal: On wushen in the eighth month the Moon transgressed the Weeping Stars.

units.en: October xinhai occulted Celestial Pass.
units.literal: On xinhai in the tenth month the Moon occulted Celestial Pass.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be troops.

units.zh: 十一月丁丑，填星犯東井。
units.en: November dingchou Saturn entered Well.
units.literal: On dingchou in the eleventh month the Station Star transgressed the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Great men will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great men will suffer.

units.zh: 十二月癸卯，填星犯井鉞。
units.en: December guimao Saturn crossed axe.
units.literal: On guimao in the twelfth month the Station Star transgressed the Well’s Battle-Axe.

units.en: August Empress Wang passed.
units.literal: That eighth month Empress Wang died.

units.zh: 九月，誅劉蕃、謝混，討滅劉毅。
units.en: In the ninth month Liu Fan and Xie Hun were executed, and Liu Yi was destroyed.
units.literal: In the ninth month Liu Fan and Xie Hun were executed and Liu Yi destroyed.

units.en: In the twelfth month Zhu Lingshi extinguished Shu.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Zhu Lingshi finished Shu.

units.en: Year nine February Mars entered Ghosts.
units.literal: In the ninth year’s second month Spark-Delight entered the Ghosts.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be war and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be armies and mourning.

units.en: Venus crossed South River.
units.literal: The Great White transgressed South River.

units.en: The prognostication said, "War will arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Arms will arise.

units.zh: 五月壬辰，太白犯右執法，晝見。
units.en: May renchen Venus crossed Right Enforcer by daylight.
units.literal: On renchen in the fifth month the Great White transgressed the Right Enforcer and appeared by day.

units.en: July gengwu occulted Hook-and-Hasp.
units.literal: On gengwu in the seventh month the Moon occulted Hook-and-Hasp.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Throat-and-tongue ministers will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Throat-and-tongue ministers will suffer.

units.zh: 九月庚午，歲星犯軒轅大星。
units.en: September gengwu Jupiter crossed Regulus.
units.literal: On gengwu in the ninth month the Year Star transgressed the great star of the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: Jichou crossed left Horn.
units.literal: On jichou the Moon transgressed the left horn.

units.en: Liu Yu dictated policy amid endless campaigns.
units.literal: At that time Liu Yu monopolized orders and warfare never ceased.

units.en: Year ten Liu Yu attacked Sima Xiuzhi.
units.literal: In the tenth year Yu campaigned against Sima Xiuzhi.

units.zh: 王師不利，休之等奔長安。
units.en: Royal troops lost; Xiuzhi ran to Chang’an.
units.literal: Imperial armies fared poorly; Xiuzhi fled to Chang’an.

units.en: Tenth year New Year dingmao crossed Net.
units.literal: On dingmao in the first month of the tenth year the Moon transgressed the Net.

units.zh: 占曰：「將相有以象坐罪者。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "Generals and chancellors will have those who are convicted according to their images."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Generals and ministers will suffer punishment fitting their seats.

units.en: February jiyou crossed Room’s north star.
units.literal: On jiyou in the second month the Moon transgressed the northern star of Room.

units.zh: 五月壬寅，月犯牽牛南星。
units.en: May renyin crossed Herdsman south.
units.literal: On renyin in the fifth month the Moon transgressed the southern star of the Herdsman.

units.en: Yichou Jupiter crossed Regulus.
units.literal: On yichou the Year Star transgressed the great star of the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: Same glosses.
units.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.

units.en: June bingshen occulted Base.
units.literal: On bingshen in the sixth month the Moon occulted the Base.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Generals will die from it, and the state will have those who are executed."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Generals will die; the state will execute someone.

units.en: July gengchen crossed Celestial Pass.
units.literal: On gengchen in the seventh month the Moon transgressed Celestial Pass.

units.en: The prognostication said, "War will arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Arms will arise.

units.en: Mars crossed Well axe.
units.literal: Spark-Delight transgressed the Well’s Battle-Axe.

units.en: Saturn entered Ghosts and stationed.
units.literal: The Station Star transgressed the Ghosts and then guarded it.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Great men will have anxiety, and the ancestral temple will be changed."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great men will suffer; ancestral temples will change.

units.zh: 八月丁酉，月奄牽牛南星。
units.en: August dingyou occulted Herdsman south.
units.literal: On dingyou in the eighth month the Moon occulted the southern star of the Herdsman.

units.en: Same reading.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.en: September Saturn crossed Ghosts.
units.literal: In the ninth month the Station Star transgressed the Ghosts.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The ruler of men will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The ruler will suffer.

units.en: Dingsi Venus entered Forbidden Guards.
units.literal: On dingsi the Great White entered the Forbidden Guards.

units.en: December jiyou crossed Western Harm.
units.literal: On jiyou in the twelfth month the Moon transgressed Western Harm.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be hidden plots."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be secret plots.

units.zh: 十一年，林邑冠交州，距敗之。
units.en: In the eleventh year Linyi raided Jiaozhou and was repulsed.
units.literal: In the eleventh year Linyi raided Jiaozhou and was repulsed.

units.zh: 十一年三月丁巳，月入畢。
units.en: Eleventh year March dingsi moon entered Net.
units.literal: On dingsi in the third month of the eleventh year the Moon entered the Net.

units.en: The prognostication said, "War will arise under Heaven."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Under Heaven armies will arise.

units.en: One reading said, "There will be frontier war."
units.literal: Another saying: “There will be frontier troops.

units.en: Jimao Mars entered Ghosts.
units.literal: On jimao Spark-Delight entered the Ghosts.

units.zh: 閏月丙午，填星又入輿鬼。
units.en: Leap month bingwu Saturn re-entered Ghosts.
units.literal: On bingwu in the intercalary month the Station Star again entered the Ghosts.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means drought, great epidemic, and disorderly ministers."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be drought, great pestilence, and traitorous ministers.

units.en: May guimao Mars entered Supreme Palace.
units.literal: On guimao in the fifth month Spark-Delight entered the Supreme Palace.

units.en: Jiachen crossed Right Enforcer.
units.literal: On jiachen it transgressed the Right Enforcer.

units.en: June jiwei Venus crossed Eastern Well.
units.literal: On jiwei in the sixth month the Great White transgressed the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Qin will have war."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Qin will have troops.

units.en: Wuyin crossed Ghosts.
units.literal: On wuyin it transgressed the Ghosts.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The state will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The state will have sorrow.

units.en: July xinchou crossed Net.
units.literal: On xinchou in the seventh month the Moon transgressed the Net.

units.en: Same gloss.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.en: August renzi crossed Base.
units.literal: On renzi in the eighth month the Moon transgressed the Base.

units.en: Same gloss.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.zh: 庚申，太白順行，從右掖門入太微。
units.en: Gengshen Venus entered Supreme Palace right gate.
units.literal: On gengshen the Great White moved direct motion from the right-side gate into the Supreme Palace.

units.en: Dingmao occulted Left Enforcer.
units.literal: On dingmao it occulted the Left Enforcer.

units.en: November guihai moon entered Net.
units.literal: On guihai in the eleventh month the Moon entered the Net.

units.en: Same gloss.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.en: Yiwei moon entered Ghosts veiled.
units.literal: On yiwei the Moon entered the Ghosts with a halo.

units.zh: 十二年五月甲申，歲星留房心之間，宋之分野。
units.en: Twelfth year May Jupiter stalled between Room and Heart—Song’s domain.
units.literal: On jiashen in the fifth month of the twelfth year the Year Star lingered between Room and Heart—Song’s celestial field.

units.en: Liu Yu was enfeoffed Duke of Song.
units.literal: Liu Yu first received investiture as Duke of Song.

units.zh: 六月壬子，太白順行入太微右掖門。
units.en: June renzi Venus entered right gate.
units.literal: On renzi in the sixth month the Great White moved direct into the Supreme Palace’s right-side gate.

units.en: Jisi crossed Net.
units.literal: On jisi the Moon transgressed the Net.

units.en: Same gloss.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.en: July moon crossed Ox.
units.literal: In the seventh month the Moon transgressed the Ox stars.

units.en: October bingxu moon entered Net.
units.literal: On bingxu in the tenth month the Moon entered the Net.

units.zh: 十三年五月丙子，月犯軒轅。
units.en: Thirteenth year May bingzi crossed Chariot Shaft.
units.literal: On bingzi in the fifth month of the thirteenth year the Moon transgressed the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: Dinghai crossed Herdsman.
units.literal: On dinghai it transgressed the Herdsman.

units.en: Guisi Mars crossed Right Enforcer.
units.literal: On guisi Spark-Delight transgressed the Right Enforcer.

units.en: August jiyou crossed Herdsman.
units.literal: On jiyou in the eighth month the Moon transgressed the Herdsman.

units.en: Dingmao crossed Supreme Palace.
units.literal: On dingmao the Moon transgressed the Supreme Palace.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The ruler of men will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The ruler of men will have anxiety.”

units.en: September renchen Mars crossed Chariot Shaft.
units.literal: On renchen in the ninth month Spark-Delight transgressed the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: October wushen crossed Net.
units.literal: On wushen in the tenth month the Moon transgressed the Net.

units.en: Same readings.
units.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.

units.en: Moon crossed Winnowing Basket.
units.literal: The Moon transgressed the Winnowing Basket.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The state will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The state will have sorrow.

units.en: Jiayin crossed Net.
units.literal: On jiayin the Moon transgressed the Net.

units.en: Same gloss.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.zh: 乙卯，填星犯太微，留積七十餘日。
units.en: Yimao Saturn tarried in Supreme Palace.
units.literal: On yimao the Station Star transgressed the Supreme Palace and lingered more than seventy days.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It is a warning of a lost ruler."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Warning of a lord’s demise.

units.en: Renxu crossed Supreme Palace.
units.literal: On renxu the Moon transgressed the Supreme Palace.

units.zh: 十四年三月癸巳，太白犯五諸侯。
units.en: Fourteenth year March guisi Venus crossed Five Feudatories.
units.literal: On guisi in the third month of the fourteenth year the Great White transgressed the Five Feudatories.

units.en: May gengzi crossed Supreme Palace.
units.literal: On gengzi in the fifth month the Moon transgressed the Supreme Palace.

units.en: July jiachen Mars crossed Ghosts.
units.literal: On jiachen in the seventh month Spark-Delight transgressed the Ghosts.

units.zh: 占曰：「秦有兵，又為旱，為兵喪。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "Qin will have war, and it also means drought, war, and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Qin will have troops; moreover drought and martial mourning.

units.zh: 亦曰：「大人憂，宗廟改，亦為亂臣。」
units.en: It also said, "Great men will have anxiety, the ancestral temple will change, and it also means disorderly ministers."
units.literal: It also says: “Great men will suffer; ancestral temples will change; likewise traitorous ministers.

units.zh: 時劉裕擅命，軍旅數興，饑旱相屬，其後卒移晉室。
units.en: Liu Yu’s dictatorship, endless wars, and dearth ended Jin.
units.literal: At that time Liu Yu monopolized orders; armies rose repeatedly; famine and drought followed until he finally shifted the Jin house.

units.en: Dingsi crossed Eastern Well.
units.literal: On dingsi the Moon transgressed the Eastern Well.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Army generals will die."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Army commanders will die.

units.en: August jiazi Venus crossed Chariot Shaft.
units.literal: On jiazi in the eighth month the Great White transgressed the Chariot Shaft.

units.zh: 癸酉，填星入太微，犯右執法，因留太微中，積二百餘日乃去。
units.en: Guiyou Saturn toured Supreme Palace two hundred days.
units.literal: On guiyou the Station Star entered the Supreme Palace, transgressed the Right Enforcer, lingered inside more than two hundred days, then departed.

units.zh: 占曰：「填星守太微，亡君之戒，有徙王。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "When Saturn guards the Supreme Palace, it is a warning of a lost ruler, and there will be a shifted king."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When the Station guards the Supreme Palace it warns of a fallen lord and shifting kings.

units.zh: 九月乙未，太白入太微，犯左執法。
units.en: September yiwei Venus struck Left Enforcer.
units.literal: On yiwei in the ninth month the Great White entered the Supreme Palace and transgressed the Left Enforcer.

units.en: Dingsi moon entered Supreme Palace.
units.literal: On dingsi the Moon entered the Supreme Palace.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Great men will have anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great men will suffer.

units.en: October jiashen moon entered Supreme Palace.
units.literal: On jiashen in the tenth month the Moon entered the Supreme Palace.

units.zh: 癸巳，熒惑入太微，犯西蕃上將，仍順行，至左掖門內，留二十日，乃逆行。
units.en: Guisi Mars toured Supreme Palace gates.
units.literal: On guisi Spark-Delight entered the Supreme Palace, transgressed the western Upper First Minister, moved direct to inside the left-side gate, lingered twenty days, then retrograded.

units.zh: 義熙十二年七月，劉裕伐姚泓。
units.en: In Yixi 12, seventh month, Liu Yu attacked Yao Hong.
units.literal: In the seventh month of Yixi 12 Liu Yu campaigned against Yao Hong.

units.zh: 十三年八月，禽姚泓，司、兗、秦、雍悉平。
units.en: Year thirteen August Hong fell—northwest subdued.
units.literal: In the eighth month of the thirteenth year he captured Yao Hong and pacified Si, Yan, Qin, and Yong.

units.zh: 十四年，劉裕還彭城，受宋公。
units.en: Year fourteen Liu Yu accepted Song dukedom.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year Liu Yu returned to Pengcheng and took the Duke of Song patent.

units.zh: 十一月，左僕射前將軍劉穆之卒。
units.en: November Liu Muzhi died.
units.literal: In the eleventh month Left Deputy Director and Forward General Liu Muzhi died.

units.zh: 明年，西虜寇長安，雍州刺史朱齡石諸軍陷沒，官軍舍而東。
units.en: The next year western barbarians raided Chang’an; Inspector of Yongzhou Zhu Lingshi’s hosts were lost and the imperial armies abandoned the west and went east.
units.literal: The next year western barbarians raided Chang’an; Inspector Zhu Lingshi’s hosts were lost and imperial armies abandoned the west.

units.en: December the emperor died.
units.literal: In the twelfth month the emperor died.

units.zh: 恭帝元熙元年正月丙午，三月壬寅，五月丙申，月皆犯太微，占悉同上。
units.en: Three lunar Supreme Palace transits that year echoed earlier glosses.
units.literal: In Yuanxi 1 of Emperor Gong on bingwu of the first month, renyin of the third month, and bingshen of the fifth month the Moon each transgressed the Supreme Palace—the interpretations all matched foregoing entries.

units.en: Yimao Mercury crossed Regulus.
units.literal: On yimao the Dawn Star transgressed the Chariot Shaft.

units.en: June gengchen Venus crossed Supreme Palace.
units.literal: On gengchen in the sixth month the Great White transgressed the Supreme Palace.

units.zh: 七月己卯，月犯太微，太白晝見。
units.en: July jimao moon and daylight Venus.
units.literal: On jimao in the seventh month the Moon transgressed the Supreme Palace while the Great White appeared by day.

units.zh: 自義熙元年至是，太白經天者九，日蝕者四，皆從上始，革代更王，臣失君之象也。
units.en: Nine Venus sky-spanning events and four eclipses marked usurpation.
units.literal: From Yixi 1 until now the Great White spanned the sky nine times and solar eclipses occurred four times—all beginning above—images of dynastic change and ministers losing their lord.

units.en: That night Venus crossed Weepers.
units.literal: That night the Great White transgressed the Weeping Stars.

units.zh: 十二月丁巳，月、太白俱入羽林。
units.en: December dingsi moon and Venus in Forbidden Guards.
units.literal: On dingsi in the twelfth month the Moon and Great White both entered the Forbidden Guards.

units.zh: 二年二月庚午，填星犯太微。
units.en: Year two February gengwu Saturn crossed Supreme Palace.
units.literal: On gengwu in the second month of the second year the Station Star transgressed the Supreme Palace.

units.en: Same readings.
units.literal: The interpretations all match the foregoing.

units.en: Year one July Liu Yu became Prince of Song.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the first year Liu Yu received the title Prince of Song.

units.en: June witnessed abdication to Liu Song.
units.literal: That sixth month the emperor abdicated to Song.

units.en: Anomalous and guest stars.
units.literal: Anomalous stars and guest stars.

units.zh: 魏文帝黃初三年九月甲辰，客星見太微左掖門內。
units.en: Wei Huangchu 3 ninth month jiachen guest star inside Supreme Palace.
units.literal: In the third year of Huangchu of Emperor Wen of Wei, ninth month jiachen, a guest star appeared inside the left-side gate of the Supreme Palace.

units.zh: 占曰：「客星出太微，國有兵喪。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "When a guest star emerges from the Supreme Palace, the state will have war and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When a guest star emerges from the Supreme Palace the state suffers armies and mourning.

units.en: October Wei marched against Sun Quan.
units.literal: In the tenth month the emperor campaigned south against Sun Quan.

units.en: Endless warfare followed.
units.literal: Afterward campaigns recurred endlessly.

units.zh: 六年十月乙未，有星孛於少微，歷軒轅，占：「為兵喪，除舊布新之象。」
units.en: In the sixth year, tenth month, yiwei, there was a comet at Lesser Office, passing through Xuanyuan; the prognostication said, "It means war and mourning, the image of removing the old and spreading the new."
units.literal: On yiwei in the sixth year’s tenth month a broom star appeared at Lesser Office, crossing the Chariot Shaft; divination: armies and mourning, clearing away the old for the new.

units.zh: 時帝軍廣陵，辛丑，親御甲胃觀兵。
units.en: Guangling review followed the comet.
units.literal: At that time the emperor’s army was at Guangling; on xinchou he donned armor and reviewed troops.

units.en: He died the following May.
units.literal: The next fifth month the emperor died.

units.zh: 明帝太和六年十一月丙寅，有星孛於翼，近太微上將星。
units.en: Wei Taihe 6 November comet in Wings.
units.literal: On bingyin in the eleventh month of Taihe 6 of Emperor Ming a broom star appeared in Wings near the Supreme Palace Upper First Minister.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means war and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be armies and mourning.

units.zh: 甘氏曰：「孛彗所當之國，是受其殃。
units.en: Gan’s text said, "The state against which a comet or broom star is directed receives its calamity.
units.literal: Gan De says: “Whatever country a broom or comet strikes receives its calamity.

units.zh: 翼又楚分野，孫權封略也。」
units.en: Wings is also the allotment of Chu and the territory enfeoffed to Sun Quan."
units.literal: Wings moreover marks Chu’s field—Sun Quan’s domain.

units.en: Following year Wu lost in Liaodong.
units.literal: The next year Sun Quan suffered defeat in Liaodong.

units.en: Next Zhuge Liang marched Qinchuan.
units.literal: The year after Zhuge Liang entered Qinchuan.

units.zh: 孫權發兵，緣江淮屯要衝，權自圍新城以應亮，天子東征權。
units.en: Sun Quan mobilized along the Jiang-Huai chokepoints and besieged Xincheng to support Liang, while the Son of Heaven campaigned east against Quan.
units.literal: Sun Quan mobilized troops along Yangzi–Huai chokepoints and besieged Xincheng to aid Liang while the Son of Heaven campaigned east against Quan.

units.zh: 青龍四年十月甲申，有星孛於大辰，長三尺。
units.en: Qinglong 4 jiashen comet at Great Chronogram.
units.literal: On jiashen in the fourth year of Qinglong a broom star appeared at Great Chronogram three feet long.

units.en: Yiyou eastern comet.
units.literal: On yiyou another broom appeared in the east.

units.zh: 十一月己亥，彗星見，犯宦者天紀星。
units.en: November comet crossed court asterisms.
units.literal: On jihai in the eleventh month a comet appeared transgressing Eunuch and Celestial Discipline stars.

units.zh: 占曰：「大辰為天王，天下有喪。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "Great Chen is the Heavenly King, and all under Heaven will have mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great Chronogram is the Celestial King; under Heaven there will be mourning.

units.zh: 劉向《五紀論》曰：「《春秋》，星孛於東方，不言宿者，不加宿也。
units.en: Liu Xiang’s Treatise on the Five Regulators said, "In the Spring and Autumn, when a star became a comet in the east and no lodge is named, it is because it did not attach to a lodge.
units.literal: Liu Xiang’s “Treatise on the Five Regulators” says: “The Spring and Autumn records a eastern comet without naming its lodge because no lodge should be added.

units.zh: 宦者在天市，為中外有兵。
units.en: The Eunuch stars are in the Celestial Market and mean war within and without.
units.literal: Eunuchs hang in the celestial market—meaning arms interior and exterior.

units.zh: 天紀為地震，孛彗主兵喪。」
units.en: The Celestial Discipline means earthquakes; comets and broom stars govern war and mourning."
units.literal: Celestial Discipline means earthquakes; broom stars mean armies and mourning.

units.en: Jingchu 1 June earthquake.
units.literal: In the sixth month of Jingchu 1 there was an earthquake.

units.en: September Zhu Ran besieged Jiangxia.
units.literal: In the ninth month Wu general Zhu Ran besieged Jiangxia.

units.en: Empress Mao passed.
units.literal: Empress Mao died.

units.en: In the first month of the second year they campaigned against Gongsun Yuan (Wenyi).
units.literal: In the first month of the second year he campaigned against Gongsun Yuan.

units.en: In the first month of the third year, Emperor Ming died.
units.literal: In the first month of year three Emperor Ming died.

units.zh: 景初二年八月，彗星見張，長三尺，逆西行，四十一日滅。
units.en: August comet in Zhang.
units.literal: In Jingchu 2 eighth month a comet appeared in Zhang three feet long, retrograding west, vanishing after forty-one days.

units.en: Same gloss.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.en: Zhang equals Zhou.
units.literal: Zhang marks Zhou’s celestial field.

units.zh: 十月癸巳，客星見危，逆行，在離宮北、騰蛇南。
units.en: October guest star by Rest Palace.
units.literal: On guisi in the tenth month a guest star appeared in Rooftop, retrograding north of Rest Palace and south of Coiling Serpent.

units.en: Jiachen crossed lineage stars.
units.literal: On jiachen it transgressed Patrimonial Stars.

units.en: Jiuyou it disappeared.
units.literal: On jiuyou it vanished.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Where a guest star emerges there will be war and mourning.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Wherever guest stars emerge arms and mourning follow.

units.en: Emptiness and Rooftop are ancestral temples and also graves.
units.literal: Emptiness and Rooftop mean ancestral temples and likewise tombs.

units.zh: 客星近離宮，則宮中將有大喪，就先君於宗廟之象也。」
units.en: When a guest star approaches the Detached Palace, the palace will have great mourning; it is the image of going to the former lord in the ancestral temple."
units.literal: Guest stars near Rest Palace mean great mourning will strike the palace—an image of joining earlier rulers in the shrine.

units.en: In the first month of the third year the emperor died.
units.literal: In the first month of year three the emperor died.

units.zh: 少帝正始元年十月乙酉，彗星見西方，在尾，長三丈，拂牽牛，犯太白。
units.en: Wei Zhengshi comet in Tail.
units.literal: On yiyou in the tenth month of Zhengshi 1 of Shaodi a comet appeared in the west at Tail three zhang long, brushing the Herdsman and transgressing the Great White.

units.en: November comet entered Forbidden Guards.
units.literal: On jiazi in the eleventh month it advanced to strike the Forbidden Guards.

units.zh: 占曰：「尾為燕，又為吳，牛亦吳越之分。
units.en: The prognostication said, "Tail is Yan and also Wu, and Ox is also the allotment of Wu-Yue.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Tail is Yan and also Wu; Ox likewise marks Wu-Yue.

units.zh: 太白為上將，羽林中軍兵。
units.en: Venus is the supreme general, and the Feathered Forest is the central army.
units.literal: The Great White is the upper general; Forbidden Guards are central troops.

units.en: It means Wu-Yue will have mourning, and the central army will move."
units.literal: Wu-Yue will mourn while central armies stir.

units.zh: 二年五月，吳遣三將寇邊。
units.en: Year two May Wu raided borders.
units.literal: In the fifth month of the second year Wu dispatched three generals to raid the frontier.

units.en: Wu heir Deng died.
units.literal: Crown Prince Deng of Wu died.

units.zh: 六月，宣帝討諸葛恪於皖。
units.en: June Sima Yi attacked Zhuge Ke.
units.literal: In the sixth month Xuandi campaigned against Zhuge Ke at Wan.

units.en: Man Chong, Grand Commandant, passed away.
units.literal: Grand Commandant Man Chong died.

units.zh: 六年八月戊午，彗星見七星，長二尺，色白，進至張，積二十三日滅。
units.en: Zhengshi 6 eighth month: comet in the Seven Stars.
units.literal: On wuwu in the sixth year’s eighth month a comet appeared in the Seven Stars two feet long, white, advancing to Zhang, vanishing after twenty-three days.

units.zh: 七年十一月癸亥，又見軫，長一尺，積百五十六日滅。
units.en: Seventh year November comet in Chariot.
units.literal: On guihai in the eleventh month of the seventh year it again appeared in the Chariot one foot long, lasting 156 days.

units.zh: 九年三月，又見昴，長六尺，色青白，芒西南指。
units.en: Ninth year third month comet in Mao.
units.literal: In the third month of the ninth year it again appeared in the Hairy Head six feet long, bluish white, tail pointing southwest.

units.zh: 七月，又見翼，長二尺，進至軫，積四十二日滅。
units.en: July comet Wings to Chariot.
units.literal: In the seventh month it again appeared in Wings two feet long, reaching the Chariot, disappearing after forty-two days.

units.zh: 案占曰：「七星張為周分野，翼軫為楚，昴為趙魏。
units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "Seven Stars and Extended Net are the allotment of Zhou; Wings and Chariot are Chu; Mao is Zhao and Wei.
units.literal: Investigating the gloss: “Seven Stars and Zhang are Zhou’s field; Wings and Chariot are Chu; Mao is Zhao and Wei.

units.zh: 彗所以除舊布新，主兵喪也。」
units.en: Comets are how the old is removed and the new spread; they govern war and mourning."
units.literal: Comets purge old and spread new; they preside over armies and mourning.

units.zh: 嘉平元年，宣帝誅曹爽兄弟及其党與，皆夷三族，京師嚴兵。
units.en: Jiaping 1 Sima Yi purged Cao Shuang.
units.literal: In Jiaping 1 Xuandi executed Cao Shuang’s brothers and faction to the third kin, tightening arms at the capital.

units.zh: 三年，誅楚王彪，又襲王淩於淮南。
units.en: Year three killed Cao Biao and crushed Wang Ling.
units.literal: In the third year he executed Prince Chu Biao and struck Wang Ling in Huainan.

units.en: Huainan matches Chu.
units.literal: Huainan is eastern Chu.

units.en: Wei imperial kin were caged at Ye.
units.literal: Wei princes were confined at Ye.

units.zh: 嘉平三年十一月癸亥，有星孛于營室，西行，積九十日滅。
units.en: Jiaping 3 November comet in Encampment.
units.literal: On guihai in the third year of Jiaping a broom star appeared in Encampment moving west, fading after ninety days.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be war and mourning.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be armies and mourning.

units.en: Encampment is the rear palace, and the rear palace will have disorder."
units.literal: Encampment governs the rear palace—the inner chambers will soon riot.

units.zh: 四年二月丁酉，彗星見西方，在胃，長五六丈，色白，芒南指，貫參，積二十日滅。
units.en: Fourth year February western comet.
units.literal: On dingyou in the fourth year’s second month a comet appeared in the west in Stomach five or six zhang long, white tail south, piercing Triaster, gone in twenty days.

units.zh: 五年十一月，彗星又見軫，長五丈，在太微左執法西，東南指，積百九十日滅。
units.en: Fifth year November long comet by Supreme Palace.
units.literal: In the fifth year’s eleventh month a comet again appeared in the Chariot five zhang west of the Supreme Palace Left Enforcer, pointing southeast, lasting 190 days.

units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "Stomach is the allotment of Yanzhou.
units.literal: Investigating the gloss: “Stomach is Yanzhou’s field.

units.en: Triaster governs war.
units.literal: Triaster governs arms.

units.en: The Supreme Palace is the Son of Heaven’s court.
units.literal: The Supreme Palace is the Son of Heaven’s courtyard.

units.en: The Enforcer is those who hold government.
units.literal: Enforcers represent those holding government.

units.zh: 孛彗為兵喪，除舊布新之象。」
units.en: Comets and broom stars are the image of war and mourning, removing the old and spreading the new."
units.literal: Broom stars mean armies and mourning—purging old for new.

units.zh: 正元元年二月，李豐、豐弟翼、後父張緝等謀亂，皆誅，皇后亦廢。
units.en: In Zhengyuan 1, Li Feng, his brother Yi, and the empress’s father Zhang Ji plotted; they were executed and the empress was deposed.
units.literal: In the second month of Zhengyuan 1 Li Feng, his brother Yi, father-in-law Zhang Ji, and others plotted sedition; all were executed and the empress deposed.

units.en: Emperor demoted to Prince of Qi.
units.literal: In the ninth month the emperor was deposed as Prince of Qi.

units.zh: 高貴鄉公正元元年十一月，白氣出南斗側，廣數丈，長竟天。
units.en: White aura by Dipper.
units.literal: In the eleventh month of Zhengyuan 1 of the Duke of Gaoguixiang white vapor issued beside the Southern Dipper several zhang wide stretching the whole sky.

units.zh: 王肅曰：「蚩尤之旗也，東南其有亂乎！」
units.en: Wang Su said, "It is Chiyou’s banner. Will there be disorder in the southeast?"
units.literal: Wang Su said: “This is Chiyou’s banner—will the southeast riot?

units.zh: 二年正月，有彗星見於吳楚分，西北竟天。
units.en: Year two comet over Wu-Chu.
units.literal: In the second year’s first month a comet appeared in Wu-Chu field spanning the northwest sky.

units.zh: 鎮東大將軍毋丘儉等據淮南叛，景帝討平之。
units.en: Guanqiu Jian’s Huainan revolt fell.
units.literal: General Who Guards the East Guanqiu Jian rebelled in Huainan until Emperor Jing suppressed him.

units.zh: 案占：「蚩尤旗見，王者征伐四方。」
units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "When Chiyou’s banner appears, the king campaigns against the four quarters."
units.literal: Investigating the gloss: “When Chiyou’s banner appears the king campaigns everywhere.

units.zh: 自後又征淮南，西平巴蜀。
units.en: Further Huainan and Shu expeditions.
units.literal: Afterward he again campaigned Huainan and pacified Ba-Shu westward.

units.zh: 是歲，吳主孫亮五鳳元年也。
units.en: It matched Wu’s fifth Phoenix year.
units.literal: That year was Sun Liang’s Wu calendar fifth Phoenix year.

units.en: Dipper-Ox govern Wu-Yue.
units.literal: Ox and Dipper mark Wu-Yue.

units.zh: 案占：「吳有兵喪，除舊布新之象也。」
units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "Wu will have war and mourning; it is the image of removing the old and spreading the new."
units.literal: Investigating the gloss: “Wu will suffer armies and mourning—purging the old.

units.zh: 太平三年，孫綝盛兵圍宮，廢亮為會稽王，故《國志》又書于吳也。
units.en: Sun Lin deposed Sun Liang.
units.literal: In Taiping 3 Sun Lin surrounded the palace with hosts, deposing Liang as Prince of Kuaiji—so Wu annals record it.

units.zh: 淮南江東同揚州地，故于時變見吳、楚。
units.en: Huainan and Wu share Yangzhou omens.
units.literal: Huainan and Jiangdong share Yangzhou ground—omens showed in Wu and Chu alike.

units.zh: 楚之分則魏之淮南，多與吳同災。
units.en: Huainan echoed Wu.
units.literal: Chu’s partition includes Wei’s Huainan, sharing Wu’s calamities.

units.zh: 是以毋丘儉以孛為己應，遂起兵而敗。
units.en: Jian misread the comet and lost.
units.literal: Hence Guanqiu Jian took the comet as his own sign, rose, and was ruined.

units.zh: 後三年，即魏甘露二年，諸葛誕又反淮南，吳遣將救之。
units.en: the second year of Ganlu Zhuge Dan revolted.
units.literal: Three years later in Wei’s second year of Ganlu Zhuge Dan rebelled again in Huainan while Wu sent rescuers.

units.zh: 及城陷，誕眾與吳兵死沒各數萬人，猶前長星之應也。
units.en: Siege deaths fulfilled the comet.
units.literal: When the city fell tens of thousands of Dan’s men and Wu troops perished—matching the earlier long comet.

units.zh: 甘露二年十一月，彗星見角，色白。
units.en: the second year of Ganlu November comet in Horn.
units.literal: In the second year of Ganlu eleventh month a comet appeared in Horn, white.

units.zh: 占曰：「彗星見兩角間色白者，軍起不戰，邦有大喪。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "When a comet appears between the two Horn stars and is white, armies arise but do not fight, and the state has great mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When a comet appears between the horns white, armies arise without pitched battle and the state meets great mourning.

units.zh: 景元元年，高貴鄉公為成濟所害。
units.en: Cao Mao died at Cheng Ji’s hands.
units.literal: In Jingyuan 1 the Duke of Gaoguixiang fell to Cheng Ji’s assassins.

units.zh: 四年十月丁丑，客星見太微中，轉東南行，歷軫宿，積七日滅。
units.en: Guest star crossed Supreme Palace.
units.literal: On dingchou in the fourth year’s tenth month a guest star appeared inside the Supreme Palace, drifting southeast through Chariot, gone in seven days.

units.zh: 占曰：「客星出太微，有兵喪。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "When a guest star emerges from the Supreme Palace, there will be war and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Guest stars from the Supreme Palace mean armies and mourning.

units.zh: 景元元年，高貴鄉公被害。
units.en: Jingyuan 1 regicide.
units.literal: In Jingyuan 1 the Duke of Gaoguixiang was murdered.

units.zh: 元帝景元三年十一月壬寅，彗星見亢，色白，長五寸，轉北行，積四十五日滅。
units.en: Wei Jingyuan 3 comet in Neck.
units.literal: On renyin in the third year of Emperor Yuan of Wei’s Jingyuan era eleventh month a comet appeared in Neck white five cun, turning north, fading after forty-five days.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means war and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be armies and mourning.

units.zh: 一曰：「彗星見亢，天子失德。」
units.en: One reading said, "When a comet appears at Neck, the Son of Heaven has lost virtue."
units.literal: Another saying: “When a comet appears in Neck the Son of Heaven loses virtue.”

units.zh: 四年，鍾會、鄧艾伐蜀，克之。
units.en: Year four Shu fell.
units.literal: In the fourth year Zhong Hui and Deng Ai conquered Shu.

units.en: Both met execution.
units.literal: Both generals rebelled and were executed.

units.zh: 咸熙二年五月，彗星見王良，長丈餘，色白，東南指，積十二日滅。
units.en: Xianxi 2 May comet at Wangliang.
units.literal: In Xianxi 2 fifth month a comet appeared at Wangliang over one zhang white pointing southeast, gone in twelve days.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Wangliang is the Son of Heaven’s four-horse team.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Wangliang is the Son of Heaven’s chariot team.

units.zh: 彗星掃之，禪代之表，除舊布新之象也。
units.en: Comet sweep means abdication omen.
units.literal: When a comet sweeps it, tables foretell abdication—renewing the mandate.

units.en: White comets signal mourning.
units.literal: White color means mourning.

units.zh: 王良在東壁宿，又并州之分野。」
units.en: Wangliang is in the lodge Eastern Wall, and is also the allotment of Bingzhou."
units.literal: Wangliang lies by Eastern Wall—in Bingzhou’s field.

units.en: August Emperor Wen died.
units.literal: In the eighth month Emperor Wen died.

units.en: December Sima Yan accepted Wei abdication.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Emperor Wu received Wei’s abdication.

units.zh: 武帝泰始四年正月丙戌，彗星見軫，青白色，西北行，又轉東行。
units.en: Jin the fourth year of Taishi comet in Chariot.
units.literal: On bingxu in the fourth year of Taishi New Year a comet appeared in Chariot bluish-white moving northwest then east.

units.zh: 占曰：「為兵喪，軫又楚分野。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "It means war and mourning, and Chariot is also the allotment of Chu."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be armies and mourning; Chariot is Chu’s field.

units.en: March Empress Dowager Wang died.
units.literal: In the third month Empress Dowager Wang died.

units.en: October Wu struck Jiangxia.
units.literal: In the tenth month Wu raided Jiangxia and Xiangyang.

units.en: Fifth year ninth month comet in Purple Palace.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the fifth year a broom star trespassed Purple Forbidden.

units.en: Same gloss.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.en: Purple Palace equals throne enclosure.
units.literal: Purple Forbidden is the Son of Heaven’s inner palace.

units.en: Tenth year Yang empress died.
units.literal: In the tenth year Empress Wu Yuan Yang died.

units.zh: 十年十二月，有星孛於軫。
units.en: Tenth year December comet in Chariot.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the tenth year a broom star appeared in Chariot.

units.zh: 占曰：「天下兵起，軫又楚分野。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "War arises under Heaven, and Chariot is also the allotment of Chu."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Under Heaven armies arise; Chariot again marks Chu.

units.zh: 咸寧二年六月甲戌，星孛於氐。
units.en: Xianning 2 June comet at Base.
units.literal: On jiaxu in Xianning 2 sixth month a broom star appeared at Base.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The Son of Heaven loses virtue and government changes.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Son of Heaven loses virtue and governance shifts.

units.en: Base is also the allotment of Yanzhou."
units.literal: Base moreover marks Yanzhou.

units.en: July comet at Great Horn.
units.literal: In the seventh month a broom star appeared at Great Horn.

units.en: Great Horn is regnal seat.
units.literal: Great Horn is the imperial throne.

units.zh: 八月，星孛太微，至翼、北斗、三台。
units.en: August comet through palace asterisms.
units.literal: In the eighth month a broom star crossed Supreme Palace reaching Wings, Dipper, Three Steps.

units.zh: 占曰：「太微，天子庭，大人惡之。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "The Supreme Palace is the Son of Heaven’s court, and great men hate it."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Supreme Palace is the Son of Heaven’s courtyard—great men dread it.

units.en: One reading said, "There will be a changed king.
units.literal: Another saying: “There will be change of king.

units.en: Wings is Chu.
units.literal: Wings again marks Chu.

units.zh: 北斗主殺罰，三台為三公。」
units.en: Northern Dipper governs killing and punishment, and the Three Terraces are the Three Dukes."
units.literal: The Dipper governs punishments; Three Steps are the Three Dukes.

units.en: Third year New Year western comet.
units.literal: In the third year’s first month a broom star appeared in the west.

units.en: March comet in Stomach.
units.literal: In the third month a broom star appeared in Stomach.

units.en: Stomach matches Xuzhou.
units.literal: Stomach marks Xuzhou.

units.en: April comet at Maid.
units.literal: In the fourth month a broom star struck Maid.

units.en: Maid is harem.
units.literal: Maid governs the rear palace.

units.en: May eastern comet.
units.literal: In the fifth month another broom star appeared in the east.

units.en: July Purple Palace comet.
units.literal: In the seventh month a broom star trespassed Purple Forbidden.

units.en: The above said, "All under Heaven changes rulers."
units.literal: The superior gloss says: “Under Heaven the ruler will change.

units.zh: 四年四月，蚩尤旗見東井。
units.en: Fourth year Chiyou banner in Well.
units.literal: In the fourth year Chiyou’s banner appeared in Eastern Well.

units.zh: 後二年，傾三方伐吳，是其應也。
units.en: Later Wu conquest matched omen.
units.literal: Two years later the three-sided assault on Wu fulfilled it.

units.en: Fifth year March Willow comet.
units.literal: In the fifth year’s third month a broom star appeared in Willow.

units.en: April Maid comet.
units.literal: In the fourth month another appeared at Maid.

units.en: July Purple Palace comet.
units.literal: In the seventh month it trespassed Purple Forbidden.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Outer ministers overbear the ruler.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Outer ministers bully their lord.

units.en: Willow equals Three Rivers.
units.literal: Willow marks Three Rivers field.

units.zh: 大角、太微、紫宮、女御並為王者。」
units.en: Great Horn, the Supreme Palace, the Purple Palace, and the Female Attendants all stand for the king."
units.literal: Great Horn, Supreme Palace, Purple Forbidden, and Maid all image kings.

units.en: Next year Wu fell.
units.literal: The next year Wu perished—exactly its fulfillment.

units.en: Comets mean war deaths.
units.literal: Broom stars preside over armies and mourning.

units.zh: 征吳之役，三河、徐、兗之兵悉出，交戰于吳楚之地，吳丞相都督以下梟戮十數，偏裨行陣之徒馘斬萬計，皆其徵也。
units.en: Conquest carnage matched every comet.
units.literal: The Wu campaign mobilized Three Rivers, Xu, and Yanzhou troops clashing in Wu-Chu—Wu’s commanders decapitated by the dozen and tens of thousands slain in the ranks answered every sign.

units.zh: 太康二年八月，有星孛于張。
units.en: Taikang 2 August Zhang comet.
units.literal: In Taikang 2 eighth month a broom star appeared in Zhang.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means war and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be armies and mourning.

units.en: November comet at Xuanyuan.
units.literal: In the eleventh month a broom star appeared at Zhan Yuan.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The rear palace bears it."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The rear palace will answer for it.

units.zh: 四年三月戊申，星孛於西南。
units.en: Fourth year March southwest comet.
units.literal: On wushen in the fourth year’s third month a broom star appeared in the southwest.

units.zh: 是年，齊王攸、任城王陵、琅邪王伷、新都王該薨。
units.en: Prince Sima You of Qi, Sima Ling of Rencheng, Sima Zhou of Langye, and Sima Gai of Xindu all died that year.
units.literal: That year Prince You of Qi, Prince Ling of Rencheng, Prince Zhou of Langye, and Prince Gai of Xindu died.

units.zh: 八年九月，星孛於南斗，長數十丈餘日滅。
units.en: Eighth year ninth month Dipper comet.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the eighth year a broom star appeared in Southern Dipper dozens of zhang long lasting many days.

units.zh: 占曰：「斗主爵祿，國有大憂。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "Dipper governs titles and salaries, and the state will have great anxiety."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Dipper governs rank stipends—the state faces great sorrow.

units.zh: 一曰：「孛于斗，王者疾病，天下易政，大亂兵起。」
units.en: One reading said, "When there is a comet at Dipper, the king becomes ill, all under Heaven changes government, and great disorder and war arise."
units.literal: Another saying: “A comet in the Dipper means royal illness, altered governance, and great rebellion.

units.zh: 太熙元年四月，客星在紫宮。
units.en: Taixi 1 April guest star in Purple Palace.
units.literal: In Taixi 1 fourth month a guest star stood in Purple Forbidden.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means war and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be armies and mourning.

units.zh: 太康未，武帝耽宴遊，多疾病。
units.en: Late Taikang Wu feasted into illness.
units.literal: Near Taikang’s end Emperor Wu indulged feasting and fell chronically ill.

units.en: Jiyou that month ended Emperor Wu.
units.literal: That month on jiyou the emperor died.

units.zh: 永平元年，賈后誅楊駿及其黨與，皆夷三族，楊太后亦見弑。
units.en: Yongping purge slew Yang clan.
units.literal: In Yongping 1 Empress Jia executed Yang Jun and faction to third kin—even Empress Dowager Yang was murdered.

units.zh: 又誅汝南王亮、太保衛瓘、楚王瑋，王室兵喪之應也。
units.en: Further kin slaughter followed.
units.literal: She also killed Prince Runan Liang, Grand Guardian Wei Guan, Prince Chu Wei—responses of martial mourning for the royal house.

units.zh: 惠帝元康五年四月，有星孛於奎，至軒轅、太微，經三台、太陵。
units.en: Yuan-kang 5 comet crossed capital stars.
units.literal: In Yuan-kang 5 fourth month a broom star appeared in Striding Legs reaching Chariot and Supreme Palace crossing Three Steps and Great Mound.

units.zh: 占曰：「奎為魯，又為庫兵，軒轅為後宮，太微天子庭，三台為三司，太陵有積尸死喪之事。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "Legs is Lu and also arsenal troops; Xuanyuan is the rear palace; the Supreme Palace is the Son of Heaven’s court; the Three Terraces are the Three Offices; Great Mound has affairs of piled corpses, death, and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Striding Legs is Lu and armory stores; Chariot Shaft is harem; Supreme Palace the court; Three Steps the Three Dukes; Great Mound holds piled corpses and death.

units.en: Armory fire and Qiang revolt.
units.literal: Afterward the arsenal burned and Qiang rebelled west.

units.zh: 後五年，司空張華遇禍，賈后廢死，魯公賈謐誅。
units.en: Later Zhang Hua and Jia clan fell.
units.literal: Five years later Minister of Works Zhang Hua met disaster; Empress Jia was deposed and killed; Duke Lu Jia Mi executed.

units.en: Next year Sima Lun seized throne.
units.literal: The next year Prince Zhao Lun usurped.

units.zh: 於是三王興兵討倫，兵士戰死十餘萬人。
units.en: Princely coalition slaughtered tens of thousands.
units.literal: Then the Three Princes rose against Lun—over a hundred thousand soldiers died.

units.zh: 永康元年三月，妖星見南方。
units.en: Yongkang 1 March southern astral demon.
units.literal: In Yongkang 1 third month an evil star appeared in the south.

units.zh: 占曰：「妖星出，天下大兵將起。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "When a baleful star emerges, great war under Heaven is about to arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When evil stars emerge great armies will arise.

units.zh: 是月賈后殺太子，趙王倫尋廢殺后，斬司空張華，又廢帝自立。
units.en: Jia killed heir; Lun purged court.
units.literal: That month Empress Jia killed the heir; Prince Zhao Lun soon deposed and murdered her, executed Zhang Hua, and enthroned himself.

units.zh: 於是三王並起，迭總天權。
units.en: Princes vied for power.
units.literal: Then three princes rose, trading supreme authority.

units.zh: 其十二月，彗星出牽牛之西，指天市。
units.en: December comet Herdsman to market.
units.literal: That twelfth month a comet emerged west of Herdsman pointing at Celestial Market.

units.zh: 占曰：「牛者七政始，彗出之，改元易號之象也。
units.en: The prognostication said, "Ox is the beginning of the seven regulators; when a comet emerges from it, it is the image of changing the era and altering the title.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Ox begins the seven regulators; a comet there means changing era and reign title.

units.zh: 天市一名天府，一名天子旗，帝坐在其中。」
units.en: The Celestial Market is also called the Celestial Treasury and also the Son of Heaven’s Banner; the imperial seat is within it."
units.literal: Celestial Market is also called Celestial Treasury and Son of Heaven’s banner—the throne sits within.

units.zh: 明年，趙王倫篡位，改元，尋為大兵所滅。
units.en: Lun’s coup collapsed.
units.literal: The next year Prince Zhao Lun usurped, changed the era, then fell to great armies.

units.en: Year two April Qi comet.
units.literal: In the second year’s fourth month a comet appeared in Qi field.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Qi will have war and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Qi will suffer armies and mourning.

units.zh: 是時，齊王冏起兵討趙王倫。
units.en: Qi prince attacked Lun.
units.literal: Then Prince Qi Jiong rose against Prince Zhao Lun.

units.zh: 倫滅，冏擁兵不朝，專權淫奢。
units.en: Jiong tyrannized Luoyang.
units.literal: After Lun fell Jiong kept armies outside court, monopolizing power in arrogance and luxury.

units.en: Jiong executed next year.
units.literal: The next year he was executed.

units.zh: 太安元年四月，彗星晝見。
units.en: Tai’an 1 April daytime comet.
units.literal: In Tai’an 1 fourth month a comet appeared by day.

units.zh: 二年三月，彗星見東方，指三台。
units.en: Tai’an 2 March eastern comet.
