units.literal: In Tai’an 2 third month a comet appeared in the east pointing at Three Steps.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It is the image of war and mourning.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Image of armies and mourning.

units.en: The Three Terraces are the Three Dukes."
units.literal: Three Steps mean Three Dukes.

units.zh: 三年正月，東海王越執太尉、長沙王乂，張方又殺之。
units.en: Yue arrested Yi; Fang killed him.
units.literal: In the third year’s first month Prince Donghai Yue seized Grand Commandant Prince Changsha Yi and Zhang Fang murdered him.

units.zh: 永興元年五月，客星守畢。
units.en: Yongxing 1 May guest star at Net.
units.literal: In Yongxing 1 fifth month a guest star guarded the Net.

units.en: The prognostication said, "The Son of Heaven’s line of heirs will be cut off."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Son of Heaven will lack heirs.

units.en: One reading said, "Great ministers will be executed."
units.literal: Another saying: “Great ministers will be executed.

units.zh: 時諸王擁兵，其後惠帝失統，終無繼嗣。
units.en: Princely armies left Hui without heir.
units.literal: At that time princes wielded arms; later Emperor Hui lost control and finally had no successor.

units.zh: 二年八月，有星孛于昴畢。
units.en: Year two August Mao-Net comet.
units.literal: In the second year’s eighth month a broom star appeared in Mao and Net.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means war and mourning.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be armies and mourning.

units.en: Mao and Net are also the allotment of Zhao and Wei."
units.literal: Mao and Net again mark Zhao and Wei.

units.zh: 十月丁丑，有星孛於北斗。
units.en: October Dingchou Dipper comet.
units.literal: On dingchou in the tenth month a broom star appeared in Northern Dipper.

units.zh: 占曰：「琁璣更授，天子出走。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "The rotating mechanism is handed over anew, and the Son of Heaven flees."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “The Dipper’s pearl will be reassigned—the Son of Heaven flees.

units.zh: 又曰：「強國發兵，諸侯爭權。」
units.en: It also said, "Strong states send out armies, and feudal lords contend for power."
units.literal: Another saying: “Strong states raise armies while feudatories vie for power.

units.en: Each prince war answered sky.
units.literal: Afterward princes exchanged blows—each omen matched.

units.en: Hui died next year.
units.literal: The next year Emperor Hui died.

units.zh: 成帝咸和四年七月，有星孛於西北，犯斗，二十三日滅。
units.en: Xianhe 4 July northwest comet.
units.literal: In Xianhe 4 seventh month a broom star appeared northwest transgressing Dipper gone in twenty-three days.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means war and disorder."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be martial turmoil.

units.zh: 十二月，郭默殺江州刺史劉胤，荊州刺史陶侃討默，斬之。
units.en: Guo Mo fell to Tao Kan.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Guo Mo killed Inspector Liu Yin; Tao Kan campaigned and beheaded Mo.

units.en: Shi Le claimed kingship.
units.literal: At that time Shi Le first styled himself king.

units.zh: 咸康二年正月辛巳，彗星夕見西方，在奎。
units.en: Xiankang 2 New Year evening comet in Legs.
units.literal: On xinsi in Xiankang 2 New Year a comet appeared at dusk west in Striding Legs.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means war and mourning.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be armies and mourning.

units.en: Legs also means frontier troops."
units.literal: Striding Legs also govern frontier troops.

units.zh: 三年正月，石季龍僭天王位。
units.en: Shi Hu crowned Heavenly King.
units.literal: In the third year’s first month Shi Jilong arrogated Heavenly Kingship.

units.zh: 四年，石季龍伐慕容皝，不克。
units.en: Shi Hu failed vs Murong Huang.
units.literal: In the fourth year Shi Jilong campaigned against Murong Huang unsuccessfully.

units.zh: 既退，皝追擊之，又破麻秋。
units.en: Murong Huang routed Ma Qiu.
units.literal: On retreat Huang pursued and crushed Ma Qiu.

units.en: Submission matched border omen.
units.literal: Huang then acknowledged Jin suzerainty—fitting frontier warfare.

units.zh: 六年二月庚辰，有星孛於太微。
units.en: Sixth year February Supreme Palace comet.
units.literal: On gengchen in the sixth year’s second month a broom star appeared in Supreme Palace.

units.en: March Empress Du died.
units.literal: In the seventh year’s third month Empress Du died.

units.zh: 康帝建元元年十一月六日，彗星見亢，長七尺，白色。
units.en: In Jianyuan 1 eleventh month a comet appeared in Neck.
units.literal: On the sixth day of the eleventh month of the first year of Jianyuan a comet appeared in Neck, seven chi long and white.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Neck is the court and governs war and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Horn is court—presiding armies and mourning.

units.en: Emperor Kang died year two.
units.literal: In the second year Emperor Kang died.

units.zh: 穆帝永和五年十一月乙卯，彗星見於亢。
units.en: Yonghe 5 November Neck comet.
units.literal: On yimao in Yonghe 5 eleventh month a comet appeared in Neck.

units.en: Tail west, white, one zhang.
units.literal: Its tail pointed west white one zhang.

units.zh: 六年正月丁丑，彗星又見於亢。
units.en: Year six January Neck comet.
units.literal: On dingchou in the sixth year’s first month a comet again appeared in Horn.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means war, mourning, and epidemic disease."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Armies and mourning; pestilence.

units.zh: 其五年八月，褚裒北征，兵敗。
units.en: Chu Pou lost north.
units.literal: That fifth year’s eighth month Chu Pou’s northern expedition failed.

units.zh: 十一月，冉閔殺石遵，又盡殺胡十餘萬人，於是中土大亂。
units.en: Ran Min’s purge devastated north.
units.literal: In the eleventh month Ran Min killed Shi Zun and slaughtered Hu beyond a hundred thousand—central plains dissolved.

units.en: December Chu Pou died.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Chu Pou died.

units.en: Plague swept the year.
units.literal: That year great pestilence raged.

units.zh: 升平二年五月丁亥，彗星出天船，在胃。
units.en: Shengping 2 May comet from Boat.
units.literal: On dinghai in Shengping 2 fifth month a comet emerged from Celestial Boat in Stomach.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means war and mourning, removing the old and spreading the new.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Armies and mourning—renewing the mandate.

units.en: If it emerges at Celestial Boat, outer barbarians invade."
units.literal: Emerging from Celestial Boat means outer tribes invade.

units.en: One reading said, "It means great flood."
units.literal: Another saying: “Great floods.

units.en: In the fourth year, in the fifth month, there were great floods under Heaven.
units.literal: In the fourth year’s fifth month under Heaven great floods.

units.en: Emperor Mu died.
units.literal: In the fifth year Emperor Mu died.

units.zh: 哀帝興甯元年八月，有星孛於角亢，入天市。
units.en: Xingning 1 August comet Horn to Market.
units.literal: In Xingning 1 eighth month a broom star appeared at Horn and Neck entering Celestial Market.

units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "It means war and mourning."
units.literal: Investigating the gloss: “Armies and mourning.

units.en: Year three January empress died.
units.literal: In the third year’s first month Empress Wang died.

units.en: February emperor died.
units.literal: In the second month the emperor died.

units.zh: 三月，慕容恪攻沒洛陽，沈勁等戰死。
units.en: In the third month Murong Ke seized Luoyang, and Shen Jin and others died in battle.
units.literal: In the third month Murong Ke seized Luoyang—Shen Jin and others fell in battle.

units.zh: 海西太和四年二月，客星見紫宮西垣，至七月乃滅。
units.en: Haixi Taihe 4 guest star western palace.
units.literal: In Taihe 4 second month of Haixi a guest star appeared at Purple Forbidden’s western wall lasting until July.

units.zh: 占曰：「客星守紫宮，臣弑主。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "When a guest star guards the Purple Palace, ministers assassinate the ruler."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When guest stars guard Purple Forbidden ministers assassinate their lord.

units.zh: 六年，桓溫廢帝為海西公。
units.en: Huan Wen demoted emperor.
units.literal: In the sixth year Huan Wen deposed the emperor as Duke of Haixi.

units.zh: 孝武甯康二年正月丁巳，有星孛於女虛，經氐、亢、角、軫、翼、張。
units.en: Ningkang 2 sweeping comet.
units.literal: On dingsi in Ningkang 2 first month a broom star appeared at Maid and Emptiness, crossing Base, Neck, Horn, Chariot, Wings, and Zhang.

units.zh: 至三月丙戌，彗星，見於氐。
units.en: March comet at Base.
units.literal: By third month bingxu another comet appeared at Base.

units.zh: 九月丁丑，有星孛於天市。
units.en: September market comet.
units.literal: On dingchou in the ninth month a broom star appeared at Celestial Market.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It means war and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Armies and mourning.

units.zh: 太元元年七月，苻堅破涼州，虜張天錫。
units.en: In Taiyuan 1, in the seventh month, Fu Jian took Liangzhou and captured Zhang Tianxi.
units.literal: In Taiyuan 1 seventh month Fu Jian conquered Liangzhou and captured Zhang Tianxi.

units.zh: 太元十一年三月，客星在南斗，至六月乃沒。
units.en: Taiyuan 11 Dipper guest star.
units.literal: In Taiyuan 11 third month a guest star stood in Southern Dipper until the sixth month.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be war and amnesty."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “There will be troops and amnesty.

units.zh: 是後司、雍、兗、冀常有兵役。
units.en: Heartland wars persisted.
units.literal: Afterward Si, Yong, Yan, and Ji constantly knew campaigns.

units.zh: 十二年正月大赦，八月又大赦。
units.en: Two amnesties year twelve.
units.literal: Twelfth year January great amnesty; August another.

units.zh: 十五年七月壬申，有星孛於北河戍，經太微、三台、文昌，入北斗，色白，長十餘丈。
units.en: Massive comet crossed court.
units.literal: On renshen in the fifteenth year’s seventh month a broom star appeared at Northern River Guard crossing Supreme Palace, Three Steps, and Civilizing spanning Dipper white over ten zhang.

units.en: August entered Purple Palace.
units.literal: On wuxu in the eighth month it entered Purple Forbidden then vanished.

units.zh: 占曰：「北河戍一名胡門，胡有兵喪。
units.en: The prognostication said, "Northern River Guard is also called the Hu Gate; the Hu will have war and mourning.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Northern River Guard is also Barbarian Gate—northern tribes suffer armies and mourning.

units.zh: 掃太微，入紫微，王者當之。
units.en: Comet threatens sovereign.
units.literal: Sweeping Supreme Palace into Purple Forbidden strikes the king.

units.zh: 三台為三公，文昌為將相，將相三公有災。
units.en: Ministers endangered.
units.literal: Three Steps are Three Dukes; Civilizing governs generals and ministers—all suffer disaster.

units.en: If it enters Northern Dipper, feudal lords will be killed."
units.literal: Entering Dipper means feudatories executed.

units.zh: 一曰：「掃北斗，強國發兵，諸侯爭權，大人憂。」
units.en: One reading said, "If it sweeps Northern Dipper, strong states send out armies, feudal lords contend for power, and great men have anxiety."
units.literal: Another saying: “Sweeping Dipper makes strong states raise armies, feudatories contend, and great men grieve.

units.en: The emperor died in year twenty-one.
units.literal: Year twenty-one the emperor died.

units.zh: 隆安元年，王恭、殷仲堪、桓玄等並發兵，表以誅王國寶為名。
units.en: Long’an 1 coalition demanded Wang Guobao’s head.
units.literal: In Long’an 1 Wang Gong, Yin Zhongkan, Huan Xuan and others all rose in arms, memorializing execution of Wang Guobao.

units.zh: 朝廷順而殺之，並斬其從弟緒，司馬道子由是失勢，禍亂成矣。
units.en: Imperial compliance killed Guobao; chaos followed.
units.literal: The court yielded, executed him and his cousin Xu, and Minister Daozi lost power—disaster ensued.

units.zh: 十八年二月，客星在尾中，至九月乃滅。
units.en: Year eighteen guest star in Tail.
units.literal: In the second month of the eighteenth year a guest star remained in Tail until September.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Yan will have war and mourning."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Yan will have armies and mourning.

units.zh: 二十年，慕容垂息寶伐魏，為所破，死者數萬人。
units.en: Murong Bao’s Wei campaign failed.
units.literal: In the twentieth year Murong Bao, son of Chui, campaigned against Wei, was defeated, and tens of thousands died.

units.zh: 二十一年，垂死，國遂衰亡。
units.en: Chui’s death ended Yan.
units.literal: In the twenty-first year Chui died and the state then declined to ruin.

units.zh: 二十年九月，有蓬星如粉絮，東南行，歷女虛，至哭星。
units.en: Broom star crossed north sky.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the twentieth year a broom star like powder-floss moved southeast through Girl and Emptiness to the Weepers.

units.zh: 占曰：「蓬星見，不出三年，必有亂臣戮死於市。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "When a broom star appears, within no more than three years there will certainly be disorderly ministers killed in the marketplace."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When a broom star appears, within three years a traitor will be executed in the market.

units.en: Wang Guobao subverted court.
units.literal: At that time Wang Guobao slandered the court.

units.en: Emperor died year twenty-one September.
units.literal: In the ninth month of the twenty-first year the emperor died.

units.zh: 隆安元年，王恭等興兵，而朝廷殺王國寶、王緒。
units.en: Long’an opened with executions.
units.literal: In Long’an 1 Wang Gong and others raised arms while the court executed Wang Guobao and Wang Xu.

units.zh: 安帝隆安四年二月己丑，有星孛於奎，長三丈，上至閣道、紫宮西蕃，入北斗魁，至三台，三月，遂經於太微帝坐端門。
units.en: On jichou in the second month of Long’an 4 a comet passed through the palace stars.
units.literal: On jichou in the fourth year of Long’an a broom star appeared in Striding Legs three zhang long up to Censor Path and Supreme Palace’s western bastion, into Dipper’s handle, then Three Steps, and by the third month traversed the Supreme Palace throne and Portal Gate.

units.zh: 占曰：「彗星掃天子庭閣道，易主之象。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "A comet sweeping the Son of Heaven’s court and Gallery Road is the image of changing rulers."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Comets sweeping the court and Censor Path portend change of ruler.

units.en: Comet crossed Three Steps and Dipper.
units.literal: It traversed Three Steps and entered the Dipper.

units.en: Same as prior entry.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the previous article.

units.zh: 十二月戊寅，有星孛于貫索、天市、天津。
units.en: December comet in market stars.
units.literal: On wuyin in the twelfth month a broom star appeared in Rope, Market, and Celestial Ford.

units.zh: 占曰：「貴臣獄死，內外有兵喪。
units.en: The prognostication said, "Noble ministers die in prison, and within and without there is war and mourning.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Noble ministers die in prison; interior and exterior know arms and mourning.

units.zh: 天津為賊斷，王道天下不通。」
units.en: The Celestial Ford is cut by bandits, and the king’s road under Heaven is not passable."
units.literal: Celestial Ford severed means bandits block the kingly way and all under Heaven cannot pass.

units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "The disaster is in Wu-Yue."
units.literal: Investigating the gloss: “Calamity lies in Wu and Yue.

units.zh: 五年二月，有孫恩兵亂，攻侵郡國。
units.en: Year five Sun En uprising.
units.literal: In the fifth year’s second month Sun En’s bands rioted, storming commanderies.

units.zh: 於是內外戒嚴，營陣屯守，柵斷淮口。
units.en: Mobilization blocked Huai crossings.
units.literal: Interior and exterior armed; camps and stockades choked the Huai mouth.

units.zh: 九月，桓玄表至，逆旨陵上。
units.en: Huan Xuan’s arrogant memorial.
units.literal: In the ninth month Huan Xuan’s memorial arrived impertinent and defiant.

units.zh: 其後玄遂篡位，亂京都，大饑，人相食，百姓流亡，皆其應也。
units.en: Xuan’s usurpation brought famine and flight.
units.literal: Afterward Xuan usurped, threw the capital into chaos, great famine, cannibalism, and mass exile—each omen matched.

units.zh: 元興元年十月，有客星色白如粉絮，在太微西，至十二月入太微。
units.en: Yuanxing guest star into Supreme Palace.
units.literal: In the tenth month of Yuanxing 1 a guest star white as powder-floss sat west of the Supreme Palace, entering the palace by December.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Troops enter the Son of Heaven’s court."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Soldiers enter the Son of Heaven’s courtyard.

units.zh: 二年十二月，桓玄篡位，放遷帝、后於尋陽，以永安何皇后為零陵君。
units.en: In the twelfth month of the second year Huan Xuan usurped, banished the emperor and empress to Xunyang, and made Yong’an Empress He Lady of Lingling.
units.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year Huan Xuan usurped, banished sovereign and empress to Xunyang, and demoted Empress He.

units.zh: 三年二月，劉裕盡誅桓氏。
units.en: Liu Yu wiped out Huans.
units.literal: In the third year’s second month Liu Yu extirpated the Huans.

units.zh: 義熙十一年五月甲申，彗星二出天市，掃帝坐，在房心北。
units.en: Two comets swept throne stars.
units.literal: On jiashen in the eleventh year of Yixi two comets emerged from Celestial Market sweeping the throne north of Room and Heart.

units.en: Room-Heart govern Liu Song.
units.literal: Room and Heart mark Song’s field.

units.zh: 案占：「得彗柄者興，除舊布新，宋興之象。」
units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "Who obtains the comet’s handle rises; removing the old and spreading the new is the image of Song rising."
units.literal: Investigating the gloss: “Whom the comet’s handle favors rises—purging old for new is Song’s omen.

units.zh: 十四年五月庚子，有星孛於北斗魁中。
units.en: Fourteenth year May comet in Dipper.
units.literal: On gengzi in the fourteenth year’s fifth month a broom star appeared inside Dipper’s handle.

units.zh: 七月癸亥，彗星出太微西，柄起上相星下，芒漸長至十餘丈，進掃北斗、紫微、中台。
units.en: July comet swept throne.
units.literal: On guihai in the seventh month a comet issued west of Supreme Palace from Upper Minister, tail lengthening ten zhang, sweeping Dipper, Purple Forbidden, and Central Step.

units.zh: 占曰：「彗出太微，社稷亡，天下易王；
units.en: The prognostication said, "When a comet emerges from the Supreme Palace, the altars of state perish and all under Heaven changes kings;
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Comets from Supreme Palace mean altars fall and kings change.

units.en: if it enters Northern Dipper and Purple Tenuity, the imperial palace is empty."
units.literal: Entering Dipper and Purple Forbidden empties the imperial palace.

units.zh: 十四年，劉裕還彭城，受宋公。
units.en: Liu Yu accepted Song dukedom.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year Liu Yu returned to Pengcheng and took the Duke of Song investiture.

units.en: Emperor died December.
units.literal: In the twelfth month the emperor died.

units.zh: 恭帝元年正月戊戌，有星孛於太微西蕃。
units.en: Gongdi New Year comet.
units.literal: On wuxu in Gongdi year one New Year a broom star appeared on Supreme Palace’s western bastion.

units.en: The prognostication said, "It is a sign of revolution."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Portent of dynastic revolution.

units.en: Song seized empire.
units.literal: That year Song possessed all under Heaven.

units.en: Meteoric showers and falls.
units.literal: Shooting stars and meteor falls.

units.zh: 蜀後主建興十三年，諸葛亮帥大眾伐魏，屯于渭南。
units.en: In the thirteenth year of Jianxing under the Later Lord of Shu, Zhuge Liang led a major campaign against Wei and camped south of the Wei River.
units.literal: In the thirteenth year of Jianxing under the Later Lord of Shu, Zhuge Liang led a great host against Wei and camped south of the Wei River.

units.zh: 有長星赤而芒角，自東北西南流，投亮營，三投再還，往大還小。
units.en: Long red meteor struck Shu camp.
units.literal: A long red star with horns moved northeast to southwest into Zhuge Liang’s camp—three times returning, shrinking each pass.

units.zh: 占曰：「兩軍相當，有大流星來走軍上及墜軍中者，皆破敗之徵也。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "When two armies face one another, if a great meteor comes and runs above an army or falls within the army, all are signs of defeat."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When armies face each other and great meteors fly over or into camps, both suffer defeat.

units.zh: 九月，亮卒於軍，焚營而退，群帥交怨，多相誅殘。
units.en: Liang died; Shu retreat chaotic.
units.literal: In September Zhuge Liang died in army; they burned camp and withdrew while commanders turned on one another.

units.zh: 魏明帝景初二年，宣帝圍公孫文懿于襄平。
units.en: In the second year of Jingchu under Emperor Ming of Wei, Sima Yi besieged Gongsun Yuan at Xiangping.
units.literal: In the second year of Jingchu under Emperor Ming of Wei, Emperor Xuan besieged Gongsun Yuan at Xiangping.

units.zh: 八月丙寅夜，有大流星長數十丈，白色有芒鬣，從首山東北流，墜襄平城東南。
units.en: On the night of bingyin in the eighth month, a great meteor tens of zhang long, white with a bristled tail, streamed northeast from Mount Shou and fell southeast of the city of Xiangping.
units.literal: On bingyin night in the eighth month a great meteor tens of zhang long, white with a maned tail, flowed northeast from Mount Shou and fell southeast of Xiangping city.

units.zh: 占曰：「圍城而有流星來走城上及墜城中者破。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "When a city is besieged and a meteor comes and runs above the city or falls within the city, it is broken."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “When besieging a city, meteors flying onto the walls or inside mean the city breaks.

units.zh: 又曰：「星墜，當其下有戰場。」
units.en: It also said, "When a star falls, beneath it there will be a battlefield."
units.literal: It also says: “Where stars fall becomes a battlefield.

units.en: It also said, "Wherever a star falls, the state changes surnames."
units.literal: It also says: “Whatever land stars fall upon changes surname.

units.zh: 九月，文懿突圍走，至星墜所被斬，屠城，坑其眾。
units.en: In the ninth month Wenyi broke out of the siege, fled to where the star had fallen, and was beheaded; the city was slaughtered and his multitude buried alive.
units.literal: In September Yuan broke out, fled to the fall site, was beheaded, the city slaughtered and buried alive.

units.zh: 元帝景元四年六月，有大流星二並如斗，見西方，分流南北，光照地，隆隆有聲。
units.en: In the sixth month of the fourth year of Jingyuan under Emperor Yuan, two great meteors like dippers appeared in the west, split north and south, lit the ground, and rumbled loudly.
units.literal: In the sixth month of the fourth year of Jingyuan under Emperor Yuan, two great meteors like dippers appeared in the west, split north and south, lit the ground, and rumbled loudly.

units.zh: 案占：「流星為貴使，星大者使大。」
units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "A meteor is a noble envoy; when the star is large, the envoy is great."
units.literal: Investigating the gloss: “Meteors are noble envoys—the larger the star the greater the envoy.

units.zh: 是年，鍾、鄧克蜀，二星蓋二帥之象。
units.en: Twin meteors matched two generals.
units.literal: That year Zhong and Deng conquered Shu—the two stars mirrored two commanders.

units.zh: 二帥相背，又分流南北之應。
units.en: Split flow matched rivalry.
units.literal: Two commanders opposed each other—fitting north–south split.

units.zh: 鍾會既叛，三軍憤怒，隆隆有聲，兵將怒之徵也。
units.en: Thunder echoed mutiny.
units.literal: After Zhong Hui rebelled three armies raged with thunder—noise of angry soldiers.

units.zh: 武帝泰始四年七月，星隕如雨，皆西流。
units.en: In the seventh month of the fourth year of Taishi under Emperor Wu, stars fell like rain, all streaming westward.
units.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year of Taishi under Emperor Wu, stars fell like rain, all streaming westward.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Falling stars mean the common people rebel.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Star falls mean commoners rebel.

units.en: Flowing west is the image of the people of Wu returning to Jin."
units.literal: Westward flow meant Wu men submitting to Jin.

units.zh: 二年，吳夏口督孫秀率部曲二千餘人來降。
units.en: Sun Xiu defected to Jin.
units.literal: In the second year Wu’s Xiakou commander Sun Xiu led more than two thousand retainers (buqu) to defect.

units.zh: 太康九年八月壬子，星隕如雨。
units.en: In the ninth year of Taikang, August meteor shower.
units.literal: In the ninth year of Taikang, on renzi in August stars fell like rain.

units.en: The Biography of Liu Xiang says, "It is the image of those below removing those above."
units.literal: Liu Xiang’s tradition says: “Image of inferiors casting off superiors.

units.zh: 後三年，帝崩而惠帝立，天下自此亂矣。
units.en: Hui’s accession opened turmoil.
units.literal: Three years later the emperor died and Emperor Hui succeeded—under Heaven then slid into chaos.

units.zh: 惠帝元康四年九月甲午，枉矢東北行，竟天。
units.en: On jiawu in the ninth month of the fourth year of Yuankang under Emperor Hui, Crooked Arrow crossed the sky to the northeast.
units.literal: On jiawu in the ninth month of the fourth year of Yuankang under Emperor Hui, Crooked Arrow streaked northeast across the whole sky.

units.zh: 六年六月丙午夜，有枉矢自斗魁東南行。
units.en: Sixth year Crooked Arrow from Dipper.
units.literal: On bingwu midnight in the sixth year Crooked Arrow issued from Dipper handle southeastward.

units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "Using disorder to attack disorder.
units.literal: Investigating the gloss: “Chaos attacks chaos.

units.zh: 北斗主執殺，出斗魁，居中執殺者，不直之象也。」
units.en: Northern Dipper governs holding and killing; when it emerges from the bowl of Dipper and the one who holds and kills occupies the center, it is the image of injustice."
units.literal: The Northern Dipper governs holding and killing; emerging from the Dipper bowl, the one who holds and kills occupying the center, is the image of injustice.

units.zh: 是後，趙王殺張、裴，廢賈后，以理太子之冤，因自篡盜，以至屠滅，以亂伐亂之應也。
units.en: Sima Lun’s purge mirrored omen.
units.literal: Afterward Prince Zhao slew Zhang and Pei, deposed Empress Jia to redress the heir—then seized power himself until extinction—chaos answering chaos.

units.zh: 一曰，氐帥齊萬年反之應也。
units.en: Alternate gloss: Qi Wannian.
units.literal: Another reading ties it to Di chieftain Qi Wannian’s rebellion.

units.zh: 太安二年十一月辛巳，有星晝隕中天北下，光變白，有聲如雷。
units.en: In the second year of Tai'an, Day bolide with thunder.
units.literal: In the second year of Tai'an, on xinsi in the eleventh month a star daytime-fell north mid-sky turning white with thunder.

units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "Its name is Camp Head.
units.literal: Investigating the gloss: “Called Camp Leader.

units.zh: 營首所在，下有大兵，流血。」
units.en: Where Camp Head is located, below there will be great war and flowing blood."
units.literal: Where Camp Leader falls great armies spill blood below.

units.zh: 明年，劉元海、石勒攻略并州，多所殘滅。
units.en: The next year Liu Yuanhai and Shi Le attacked and plundered Bingzhou, with much slaughter.
units.literal: The next year Liu Yuan and Shi Le ravaged Bingzhou with slaughter.

units.zh: 王浚起燕代，引鮮卑攻掠鄴中，百姓塗地。
units.en: Wang Jun’s raid devastated Hebei.
units.literal: Wang Jun rose in Yan-Dai leading Xianbei raids on Ye—people lay slaughtered.

units.en: Thunder signified rage.
units.literal: Thunder noise meant wrath.

units.zh: 永興元年七月乙丑，星隕有聲。
units.en: In the first year of Yongxing, July noisy meteor falls.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongxing, on yichou in July stars fell with noise.

units.en: October repeat.
units.literal: In the second year’s October stars again fell with noise.

units.en: Same gloss.
units.literal: The interpretation matches the foregoing.

units.en: Heartland fell.
units.literal: Afterward central Xia fell.

units.zh: 光熙元年五月，枉矢西南流。
units.en: In the first year of Guangxi, May southwest Crooked Arrow.
units.literal: In the first year of Guangxi, in May Crooked Arrow flowed southwest.

units.zh: 是時，司馬越西破河間兵，奉迎大駕，尋收繆胤、何綏等，肆無君之心，天下惡之。
units.en: Sima Yue’s arrogance matched omen.
units.literal: At that time Sima Yue crushed Hejian forces westward, welcomed the imperial carriage, then seized Miao Yin and He Sui—heartless to his sovereign—and all under Heaven despised him.

units.zh: 及死而石勒焚其尸柩，是其應也。
units.en: Shi Le burned Yue’s corpse.
units.literal: When he died Shi Le burned his coffin—exact fulfillment.

units.zh: 懷帝永嘉元年九月辛卯，有大星如日，自西南流于東北，小者如斗，相隨，天盡赤，聲如雷。
units.en: On xinmao in the ninth month of the first year of Yongjia under Emperor Huai, a giant bolide crossed from southwest to northeast, followed by smaller dipper-sized stars, with the whole sky red and thunderous.
units.literal: On xinmao in the ninth month of the first year of Yongjia under Emperor Huai, a great star as bright as the sun streamed from southwest to northeast; lesser stars like dippers followed it, the sky turned entirely red, and the sound was like thunder.

units.zh: 占曰：「流星為貴使，星大者使大。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "A meteor is a noble envoy; when the star is large, the envoy is great."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Meteors are noble envoys—great stars mean great envoys.

units.zh: 是年五月，汲桑殺東燕王騰，遂據河北。
units.en: Ji Sang killed Sima Teng.
units.literal: That May Ji Sang killed Prince Teng of Eastern Yan and seized Hebei.

units.zh: 十一月，始遣和郁為征北將軍，鎮鄴西。
units.en: Court posted He Yu north.
units.literal: In November He Yu first dispatched north as general—stationed west of Ye.

units.zh: 田甄等大破汲桑，斬于樂陵。
units.en: Tian Zhen slew Ji Sang.
units.literal: Tian Zhen crushed Ji Sang at Leling.

units.zh: 於是以甄為汲郡太守，弟蘭钜鹿太守。
units.en: Zhen brothers rewarded.
units.literal: Zhen became Ji Administrator and brother Lan Julu prefect.

units.zh: 小星相隨者，小將別帥之象也。
units.en: Small meteors minor leaders.
units.literal: Lesser stars following meant lesser commanders’ omens.

units.zh: 司馬越忿魏郡以東平原以南皆党于桑，以賞甄等，於是侵掠赤地。
units.en: Sima Yue, angry that the lands east of Wei commandery and south of Pingyuan had sided with Sang, used rewards to Zhen and then raided until the ground was scorched.
units.literal: Sima Yue resented Wei commandery east of Wei plain south allying with Sang—rewarded Zhen—then raided until land scorched.

units.en: Thunder meant wrath.
units.literal: Thunder noise signified rage.

units.zh: 四年十月庚子，大星西北墜，有聲。
units.en: Fourth year giant meteor.
units.literal: On gengzi in the fourth year’s tenth month a great star fell northwest with noise.

units.en: Emperor captured at Pingyang.
units.literal: Soon the emperor suffered shame at Pingyang.

units.zh: 元帝太興三年四月壬辰，枉矢出虛、危，沒翼、軫。
units.en: On renchen in the fourth month of the third year of Taixing under Emperor Yuan, Crooked Arrow crossed from Emptiness and Rooftop to Wings and Chariot.
units.literal: On renchen in the fourth month of the third year of Taixing under Emperor Yuan, Crooked Arrow issued from Emptiness and Rooftop and vanished in Wings and Chariot.

units.zh: 占曰：「枉矢所觸，天下之所伐。
units.en: The prognostication said, "Where Crooked Arrow touches is what all under Heaven will attack.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Whatever Crooked Arrow strikes the realm campaigns against.

units.en: Wings and Chariot are the allotment of Jingzhou."
units.literal: Wings and Chariot mark Jingzhou.

units.zh: 太寧二年，王敦殺譙王承及甘卓，而敦又梟夷，枉矢觸翼之應也。
units.en: In the second year of Taining, Wang Dun killed Prince Cheng of Qiao and Gan Zhuo, and Dun himself was then destroyed; this matched Crooked Arrow touching Wings.
units.literal: In the second year of Taining, Wang Dun killed Prince Cheng of Qiao and Gan Zhuo, and Dun himself was then destroyed; this was the response of Crooked Arrow touching Wings.

units.zh: 永昌元年七月甲午，有流星大如甕，長百餘丈，青赤色，從西方來，尾分為百餘岐，或散。
units.en: On jiawu in the seventh month of the first year of Yongchang, a meteor appeared, as large as a jar and over a hundred zhang long, tinged blue-green and red; it advanced from the west, and its tail divided into more than a hundred branching streaks, some of which scattered apart.
units.literal: On jiawu in the seventh month of the first year of Yongchang, there was a meteor as large as a jar, more than a hundred zhang long, blue-green and red in color; it came from the west, its tail split into more than a hundred forked trails, and in places dispersed.

units.zh: 時王敦之亂，百姓流亡之應也。
units.en: Meteor matched Dun revolt.
units.literal: It answered Wang Dun’s turmoil and mass exile.

units.zh: 成帝咸康三年元月辛末，流星大如二斗魁，色青赤，光耀地，出奎中，沒婁北。
units.en: On xinwei in the first month of the third year of Xiankang under Emperor Cheng, a blue-green and red meteor as large as two dipper bowls shone on the ground, emerged from Striding Legs, and vanished north of Bond.
units.literal: On xinwei in the first month of the third year of Xiankang under Emperor Cheng, a meteor as large as two dipper bowls, blue-green and red in color, lit the ground, emerged from Striding Legs, and vanished north of Bond.

units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "It means famine, and the five grains will not be stored."
units.literal: Investigating the gloss: “Means famine—five grains unstored.

units.en: Drought that month.
units.literal: That month great drought and famine.

units.zh: 六年二月庚午朔，有流星大如斗，光耀地，出天市，西行人太微。
units.en: Meteor Market to palace.
units.literal: On gengwu new moon in the sixth year’s second month a meteor like a dipper brilliant emerged from Celestial Market entering Supreme Palace west.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Great men bear it."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great men will answer for it.

units.en: Emperor Cheng died.
units.literal: In the eighth year’s sixth month Emperor Cheng died.

units.zh: 穆帝永和八年六月辛巳，日未入，有流星大如三斗魁，從辰巳上，東南行。
units.en: On xinsi in the sixth month of the eighth year of Yonghe under Emperor Mu, before sunset, a meteor as large as three dipper bowls moved southeast from the chen-si direction.
units.literal: On xinsi in the sixth month of the eighth year of Yonghe under Emperor Mu, before sunset, a meteor as large as three dipper bowls moved southeast from the chen-si direction.

units.zh: 晷度推之，在箕、斗之間，蓋燕分也。
units.en: Meteor in Yan sector.
units.literal: Shadow reckoning placed it between Winnowing Basket and Dipper—Yan field.

units.en: Examining the prognostication, it said, "It means Camp Head.
units.literal: Investigating the gloss: “Called Camp Leader.

units.en: Below Camp Head, blood flows in torrents."
units.literal: Beneath Camp Leader blood flows in torrents.

units.zh: 是時，慕容雋僭稱大燕，攻伐無已。
units.en: Murong Jun raided ceaselessly.
units.literal: Then Murong Jun styled Great Yan and campaigned endlessly.

units.zh: 十年四月癸未，流星大如斗，色赤黃，出織女，沒造父，有聲如雷。
units.en: Large meteor Weaving to Zaofu.
units.literal: On guiwei in the tenth year’s fourth month a meteor like a dipper red-yellow emerged from Weaving Maid vanishing at Zaofu with thunder.

units.zh: 占曰：「燕齊有兵，百姓流亡。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "Yan and Qi will have war, and the common people will flee and go into exile."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Yan and Qi have arms; commoners flee.

units.zh: 其年十二月，慕容雋遂據臨漳，盡有幽、并、青、冀之地。
units.en: Jun conquered north.
units.literal: That December Murong Jun seized Linzhang holding You, Bing, Qing, and Ji.

units.zh: 緣河諸將奔散，河津隔絕。
units.en: River defenses collapsed.
units.literal: River generals scattered; fords closed.

units.en: Murong Ke struck Qi.
units.literal: Murong Ke attacked Qi.

units.zh: 升平二年十一月，枉矢自東南流於西北，其長半天。
units.en: In the second year of Shengping, November long Crooked Arrow.
units.literal: In the second year of Shengping, in November Crooked Arrow flowed southeast to northwest half the sky long.

units.zh: 四年十月庚戌，天狗見西南。
units.en: Celestial Dog in southwest.
units.literal: On gengxu in the fourth year’s tenth month Celestial Dog appeared southwest.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be great war and flowing blood."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great warfare and flowing blood.

units.zh: 海西太和四年十月壬申，有大流星西下，有聲如雷。
units.en: In Haixi's Taihe 4.10, on renshen, a great meteor fell westward with a thunderous roar.
units.literal: In the tenth month of Taihe 4 under the Duke of Haixi, on renshen day, a great meteor descended in the west with a sound like thunder.

units.zh: 明年，遣使免袁真為庶人。
units.en: The next year, envoys demoted Yuan Zhen to commoner.
units.literal: The next year envoys demoted Yuan Zhen to commoner.

units.zh: 桓溫在壽春，真病死，息瑾代立，求救於苻堅。
units.en: Huan Wen was at Shouchun; Zhen died of illness, his son Jin succeeded and sought aid from Fu Jian.
units.literal: Huan Wen at Shouchun—Zhen died ill; son Jin succeeded seeking Fu Jian’s aid.

units.en: Wen beat Fu Jian.
units.literal: Wen defeated Fu Jian’s army.

units.en: Shouchun fell.
units.literal: In the sixth year Shouchun fell.

units.zh: 孝武太元六年十月乙卯，有奔星東南經翼、軫，聲如雷。
units.en: On yimao in the tenth month of the sixth year of Taiyuan under Emperor Xiaowu, a shooting star thundered southeast through Wings and Chariot.
units.literal: On yimao in the tenth month of the sixth year of Taiyuan under Emperor Xiaowu, a shooting star streaked southeast through Wings and Chariot, with a sound like thunder.

units.zh: 占曰：「楚地有兵，軍破，百姓流亡。」
units.en: The prognostication said, "Chu territory will have war, the army will be broken, and the common people will flee and go into exile."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Chu will have arms—armies break and people flee.

units.zh: 十二月，苻堅荊州刺史梁成、襄陽太守閻震率眾伐竟陵，桓石虔擊大破之，生擒震，斬首七千，獲生口萬人。
units.en: In the twelfth month Liang Cheng, Fu Jian’s inspector of Jing Province, and Yan Zhen, prefect of Xiangyang, led their forces against Jingling. Huan Shiqian engaged them and broke them completely: he seized Yan Zhen alive, took seven thousand heads, and captured ten thousand people.
units.literal: In the twelfth month Fu Jian’s inspector of Jing Province Liang Cheng and Xiangyang prefect Yan Zhen led troops to attack Jingling; Huan Shiqian attacked them and inflicted a crushing defeat, capturing Yan Zhen alive, beheading seven thousand, and taking ten thousand prisoners.

units.en: Thunder signified commander wrath.
units.literal: Thunder meant angry commanders.

units.zh: 十三年閏月戊辰，天狗東北下，有聲。
units.en: Celestial Dog meteor.
units.literal: On wuchen in intercalary month of the thirteenth year Celestial Dog fell northeast with noise.

units.en: The prognostication said, "There will be a great battle and flowing blood."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great battles and flowing blood.

units.zh: 自是後，慕容垂、翟遼、姚萇、苻登、慕容永並阻兵爭強。
units.en: After this, Murong Chui, Zhai Liao, Yao Chang, Fu Deng, and Murong Yong each held troops and contended for supremacy.
units.literal: Afterward Murong Chui, Zhai Liao, Yao Chang, Fu Deng, Murong Yong barricaded troops.

units.zh: 十四年正月，彭城妖賊又稱偽號於皇丘，劉牢之破滅之。
units.en: Huangqiu bandits fell.
units.literal: In the fourteenth year’s first month Pengcheng spirit-bandits styled a reign at Huangqiu until Liu Laozhi destroyed them.

units.zh: 三月，張道破合鄉、太山，向欽之擊走之。
units.en: In the third month Zhang Dao took Hexiang and Taishan; Xiang Qinzhi attacked and drove him off.
units.literal: In March Zhang Dao seized Hexiang and Taishan until Xiang Qinzhi repulsed him.

units.zh: 安帝隆安五年三月甲寅，流星赤色，眾多西行，經牽牛、虛、危、天津、閣道，貫太微、紫宮。
units.en: On jiayin in the third month of the fifth year of Long'an under Emperor An, a red meteor storm moved west through Herdsman, Emptiness, Rooftop, Celestial Ford, and Censor Path, piercing the Supreme Palace and Purple Forbidden.
units.literal: On jiayin in the third month of the fifth year of Long'an under Emperor An, many red meteors moved west through Herdsman, Emptiness, Rooftop, Celestial Ford, and Censor Path, piercing the Supreme Palace and Purple Forbidden.

units.zh: 占曰：「星庶人類，眾多西行，眾將西流之象。
units.en: The prognostication said, "Stars are of the category of common people; many going west is the image of many generals flowing west.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Stars are masses—many westbound mean hosts drifting west.

units.zh: 經天子庭，主弱臣強，諸侯兵不制。」
units.en: Passing through the Son of Heaven’s court means the ruler is weak, ministers are strong, and the armies of the feudal lords cannot be controlled."
units.literal: Crossing court means weak sovereign and strong ministers—feudatories uncontrollable.

units.zh: 其年五月，孫恩侵吳郡，殺內史。
units.en: Sun En struck Wu.
units.literal: That May Sun En attacked Wu Commandery killing the governor.

units.en: June reached Jingkou.
units.literal: In June he reached Jingkou.

units.zh: 於是內外戒嚴，營陣屯守，劉裕追破之。
units.en: Liu Yu crushed Sun En.
units.literal: Interior and exterior armed while Liu Yu pursued and broke him.

units.zh: 元興元年七月，大饑，人相食。
units.en: Yuanxing famine cannibalism.
units.literal: In Yuanxing 1 seventh month great famine—people ate each other.

units.zh: 浙江以東流亡十六七，吳郡、吳興戶口減半，又流奔而西者萬計。
units.en: East of the Zhe River, six or seven people in ten were driven into exile; in Wu Commandery and Wuxing the population on the registers had fallen by half, and those who streamed westward to escape were counted in the tens of thousands.
units.literal: East of the Zhe River sixty or seventy percent of the people were displaced; in Wu Commandery and Wuxing registered households were halved; moreover those who fled westward numbered in the tens of thousands.

units.zh: 十月，桓玄遣將擊劉軌，破走之。
units.en: Xuan struck Liu Gui.
units.literal: In October Huan Xuan sent generals against Liu Gui routing him.

units.en: Gui fled Qingzhou.
units.literal: Gui fled to Qingzhou.

units.en: Cloud vapors.
units.literal: Cloud vapors.

units.zh: 惠帝永興元年十二月壬寅夜，有赤氣亙天，砰隱有聲。
units.en: On renyin night in the twelfth month of the first year of Yongxing under Emperor Hui, red vapor spanned the sky with a muffled rumble.
units.literal: On renyin night in the twelfth month of the first year of Yongxing under Emperor Hui, red vapor spanned heaven, with a dull rumbling sound.

units.zh: 二年十月丁丑，赤氣見北方，東西竟天。
units.en: Northern red band.
units.literal: On dingchou in the second year’s tenth month red vapor appeared north spanning east–west.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Both mean great war.
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Both mean great armies.

units.en: A hidden booming sound is the image of anger."
units.literal: Dull thunder meant wrath.

units.zh: 是後，四海雲擾，九服交兵。
units.en: Empire-wide warfare.
units.literal: Afterward the four seas churned and nine circuits fought.

units.zh: 光熙元年十二月甲申，有白氣若虹，中天北下至地，夜見五日乃滅。
units.en: In Guangxi 1, on jiashen in the twelfth month, a white vapor like a rainbow hung from mid-heaven down north to earth and was seen at night for five days before vanishing.
units.literal: In the first year of Guangxi, on jiashen in December white vapor like a rainbow hung north–south from zenith to earth five nights.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Great war will arise."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Great armies arise.

units.zh: 明年，王彌起青徐，汲桑亂河北，毒流天下。
units.en: Wang Mi and Ji Sang uprisings.
units.literal: The next year Wang Mi rose in Qing-Xu while Ji Sang ravaged Hebei—poison spread.

units.zh: 懷帝永嘉三年十一月乙亥，有白氣如帶，出南北方各二，起地至天，貫參伐中。
units.en: On yihai in the eleventh month of the third year of Yongjia under Emperor Huai, belt-like white vapors rose from north and south from earth to heaven, piercing Orion's Battle.
units.literal: On yihai in the eleventh month of the third year of Yongjia under Emperor Huai, white vapor like belts emerged in two streams each from the south and north, rising from earth to heaven and piercing the middle of Orion's Battle.

units.en: The prognostication said, "Great war will arise under Heaven."
units.literal: The omen-text says: “Under Heaven great armies arise.

units.zh: 四年三月，司馬越收繆胤等。
units.en: In the third month of the fourth year, Sima Yue arrested Miao Yin and others.
units.literal: In March of the fourth year Sima Yue seized Miao Yin.

units.en: Tripartite war.
units.literal: Moreover three fronts fought without cease.

units.zh: 五年三月，司馬越死于甯平城，石勒攻破其眾，死者十餘萬人。
units.en: Yue died at Ningping.
units.literal: In March of the fifth year Sima Yue died at Ningping—Shi Le shattered his host—over a hundred thousand dead.

units.zh: 六月，京都焚滅，帝如虜庭。
units.en: Luoyang fell—emperor captive.
units.literal: In June the capital burned and the emperor went to barbarian court.

units.zh: 愍帝建興元年十月己巳夜，有赤氣曜於西北。
units.en: On jisi night in the tenth month of the first year of Jianxing under Emperor Min, a red glow appeared in the northwest.
units.literal: On jisi night in the tenth month of the first year of Jianxing under Emperor Min, red vapor glowed in the northwest.

units.zh: 荊州刺史陶侃討杜弢之党於石城，戰敗。
units.en: Tao Kan lost at Shicheng.
units.literal: Inspector of Jingzhou Tao Kan campaigned against Du Tao’s faction at Shicheng and was defeated.
